model_requirements.description: An institutional asset manager that invests pension assets on behalf of several participating pension plans. As a sophisticated institutional buy-side allocator, this company conducts deep, fundamental buy-side analysis across diversified asset classes—including public equities, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, natural resources, and credit investments—with a core focus on long-term risk-adjusted returns and capital preservation. Their investment analysis is highly rigorous, utilizing proprietary macroeconomic modeling, extensive operational and financial due diligence, and comprehensive Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) integration to evaluate direct investments, co-investments, and external fund managers. Because they manage long-duration liabilities for pension beneficiaries, their internal research teams leverage their massive scale and permanent capital advantage to originate off-market deals globally, stress-test macroeconomic sensitivities, and actively manage portfolio assets post-acquisition to unlock operational efficiency and sustainable value.

model.core_business_processes: Deal Origination and Sourcing (off-market and proprietary deal pipeline across asset classes), Investment Due Diligence (operational, financial, legal, and commercial diligence), Macroeconomic and Quantitative Research Modeling (scenario analysis, stress-testing, sensitivity analysis), Asset Allocation and Portfolio Construction (strategic and tactical allocation across diversified asset classes), Investment Committee Review and Approval Governance, External Manager Selection and Monitoring (fund manager underwriting, GP evaluation, fund commitments), Direct Investment and Co-Investment Execution (deal structuring, SPV setup, capital deployment), ESG Integration and Responsible Investment Analysis, Portfolio Risk Management (market, credit, liquidity, currency, concentration risk measurement), Valuation and NAV Determination (periodic fair-value marking of private and public holdings), Post-Acquisition Asset Management and Value Creation (operational improvement of portfolio companies), Liability-Driven Investment and Actuarial Matching (matching long-duration pension liabilities to asset cash flows), Performance Measurement and Attribution Reporting, Treasury and Cash Flow Management (net contribution investing, capital calls, distributions, FX hedging), Regulatory and Compliance Reporting, Trade Execution and Settlement (public market order management and settlement)

model.operational_systems_of_records: Portfolio Management System (e.g., BlackRock Aladdin or SimCorp Dimension - position keeping, risk analytics, IBOR), Order and Execution Management System (e.g., Charles River IMS - OMS/EMS, compliance pre-trade checks), Private Markets Management Platform (e.g., eFront or iLEVEL - private equity, real estate, infrastructure fund administration and capital account tracking), Investment Accounting and ABOR System (e.g., SimCorp or State Street fund accounting - NAV, GL posting), Risk Analytics Platform (e.g., MSCI RiskMetrics / BarraOne - factor risk, stress testing, VaR), Market Data Platform (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal / BPIPE, Refinitiv Eikon - pricing, reference data, analytics), ESG Data and Ratings Platform (e.g., MSCI ESG, Sustainalytics - ESG scores and controversies), CRM and Deal Pipeline System (e.g., DealCloud, Salesforce Financial Services Cloud - origination and relationship management), General Ledger and ERP (e.g., Oracle Financials GL/AP/AR/FA or SAP S/4HANA - corporate finance), Data Warehouse and Analytics (e.g., Snowflake / Databricks lakehouse with master data management), Custody and Settlement System (e.g., global custodian State Street/BNY Mellon messaging via SWIFT), Treasury Management System (cash management, FX hedging, collateral management), Performance and Attribution System (GIPS-compliant performance calculation engine), Document Management and Data Room (diligence artifact repository), Actuarial and ALM System (liability modeling and asset-liability matching), HRIS and Workforce Management (e.g., Workday - human capital)
model.industry_governing_body: Applicable regulators and standards vary by jurisdiction; representative bodies include: national pension regulator / superannuation authority, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive (AIFMD), CFA Institute Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS), Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI), Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) / International Accounting Standards Board (IASB), Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) / US GAAP, International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO), Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (counterparty exposure guidance), Financial Action Task Force (FATF - AML/KYC), International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA), Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), SWIFT messaging standards, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX financial controls), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data privacy laws, local actuarial standards boards

attributes.name: prior_service_start_date

attributes.name: receipt_date

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: service_credit_years

attributes.name: simcorp_transaction_reference

attributes.name: source_plan_administrator

attributes.name: source_plan_confirmation_ref

attributes.name: source_plan_jurisdiction

attributes.name: source_plan_name

attributes.name: source_plan_registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued registration number of the source pension plan as assigned by the tax authority or applicable regulator.
attributes.references: applicable tax law; tax authority registered plans unit

attributes.name: source_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating plan: Defined Benefit (DB), Defined Contribution (DC), individual retirement account, group retirement savings plan, or profit-sharing plan.
attributes.references: applicable tax law; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the transfer by the source plan administrator prior to remittance, if applicable.

attributes.name: transfer_amount

attributes.name: transfer_amount_base_equivalent

attributes.name: transfer_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the currency in which the transfer amount is denominated (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transfer-in transaction was formally initiated and submitted by the source plan administrator.
attributes.references: prudential regulator guidance; applicable tax law

attributes.name: transfer_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the transfer assets were physically remitted to the fund: wire transfer, cheque, in-kind asset transfer, or electronic funds transfer (EFT).
attributes.references: State Street / Northern Trust Custody Platform; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer-in transaction from initiation through to final receipt and posting.
attributes.references: prudential regulator guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standards

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer-in by mechanism: commuted value from a defined benefit plan, service credit recognition, retirement savings account conversion, direct plan-to-plan transfer, or group transfer.
attributes.references: applicable tax law; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this transfer-in record, supporting audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data loading.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date used to determine the commuted value or asset value of the transferred pension entitlement from the source plan.

attributes.name: vesting_status
attributes.description: Vesting status of the member's entitlement in the source plan at the time of transfer, determining the transferable benefit amount.

products.name: transfer_out

attributes.name: transfer_out_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pension transfer-out transaction record within the fund's IBOR/ABOR system.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Commuted value calculations for pension transfers require specific actuarial assumptions (discount rate, mortality table).

attributes.name: cash_transfer_id

attributes.name: contributor_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to beneficiary.contributor_pool. Business justification: Transfer-out records specify which contributor pool the member is leaving. Normalizing STRING to FK.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan member (beneficiary) initiating the transfer-out of their accrued entitlement upon termination of employment.

attributes.name: pension_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan (one per participating plan) from which the transfer-out is being processed.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to portfolio.portfolio. Business justification: Transfers out of a plan need portfolio context for tax and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: accrued_service_years
attributes.description: The total years of pensionable service accrued by the member as at the termination date, used as the basis for the commuted value actuarial calculation.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: aml_cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer-out transaction has passed the required Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) screening prior to fund disbursement.

attributes.name: aml_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and KYC review was completed for this transfer-out transaction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transfer-out was formally approved by the pension administration team following actuarial valuation and compliance review.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The identifier or name of the pension administration officer who approved the transfer-out transaction, supporting governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; SOC 2; ISO 27001

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: The total commuted value transfer amount expressed in the fund's base currency (Base Currency), after applying the applicable FX rate for cross-currency transfers.

attributes.name: best_average_salary
attributes.description: The member's best average salary figure used in the defined benefit formula to determine the accrued pension entitlement underlying the commuted value calculation.

attributes.name: commuted_value_amount
attributes.description: The actuarially determined commuted value (CV) of the member's accrued pension entitlement as at the valuation date, representing the lump-sum equivalent of the deferred pension.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the commuted value and transfer amounts are denominated (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The actuarial discount rate (as a decimal) applied in the commuted value calculation to present-value the projected pension cash flows, per actuarial standards.

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member formally elected to transfer their commuted value or pension credit out of the fund rather than defer or take an annuity.

attributes.name: election_deadline_date
attributes.description: The statutory or plan-rule deadline by which the member must elect the transfer-out option; failure to elect by this date may result in a deferred pension default.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The FX rate applied to convert the transfer amount to the fund's base currency where the receiving plan is denominated in a foreign currency.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code in Oracle Financials to which the commuted value transfer disbursement is posted for fund accounting and liability reduction.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the transfer-out transaction was first created in the pension administration system, serving as the primary audit creation timestamp.

attributes.name: is_cross_border
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer-out involves a cross-border remittance to a foreign registered pension plan, triggering additional regulatory and FX requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the transfer-out record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: member_consent_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the signed member consent or election form authorizing the transfer-out, stored in the document management system for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; GDPR Article 7; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: mortality_table_code
attributes.description: The actuarial mortality table code (e.g., RP-2014, UP-94) used in the commuted value calculation to project member life expectancy.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards Board; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for pension administration officers to record exceptions, special circumstances, or supplementary information relevant to this transfer-out transaction.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the commuted value funds are remitted to the receiving institution or directly to the member for the taxable portion.

attributes.name: receiving_country_code

attributes.name: receiving_institution_lei

attributes.references: ISDA; FSB LEI Initiative; ISO 17442; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: receiving_institution_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution or pension plan administrator receiving the transferred commuted value funds on behalf of the member.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; FATF AML/CTF; KYC

attributes.name: receiving_plan_number
attributes.description: The account or plan registration number at the receiving institution to which the commuted value funds are directed. Classified as confidential financial data.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; FATF AML/CTF; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: receiving_plan_type
attributes.description: Type of registered plan or account to which the commuted value is being transferred (e.g., locked-in retirement account, another pension plan). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IRA|locked_in_account|DC_PLAN|DB_PLAN|foreign_pension — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; tax authority

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business reference number assigned to this transfer-out transaction, used in member correspondence and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: registered_transfer_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the commuted value transferred on a tax-sheltered basis directly into the member's registered receiving plan (locked-in account, another pension plan, etc.), net of any taxable portion.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; tax authority; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_ref
attributes.description: The reference number of the regulatory filing or notification submitted to the applicable pension regulator (e.g., the national pension regulator) in connection with this transfer-out.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: settlement_instructions_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) on file for the receiving institution, used to route the wire transfer or EFT payment accurately.
attributes.references: State Street / Northern Trust Custody and Fund Administration Platform; ISDA SSI

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the originating pension administration or ABOR system (e.g., SimCorp Dimension) for reconciliation and data lineage tracing.

attributes.name: tax_slip_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required tax reporting slip (e.g., an annual pension income slip) has been issued to the member for the taxable portion of the commuted value transfer.

attributes.name: tax_slip_year

attributes.name: taxable_portion_amount

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the commuted value funds were transferred out of the fund to the receiving registered plan or locked-in retirement account.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for the transfer-out, indicating whether the member voluntarily resigned, was involuntarily terminated, or is transferring between registered plans.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer-out transaction from initiation through to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|pending_valuation|approved|funds_transferred|completed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer-out by the nature of the entitlement being transferred: commuted value of accrued pension, pension credit portability, or lump-sum commuted value.

attributes.name: valuation_date

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount

products.name: retirement_election

attributes.name: benefit_option_id

attributes.name: contributor_pool_id

attributes.name: designated_beneficiary_id

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan member (beneficiary) who submitted this retirement election. Links to the beneficiary master record.

attributes.name: pension_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan under which this retirement election is made (e.g., the participating plans plan).

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to portfolio.portfolio. Business justification: Retirement elections are plan-specific; linking to portfolio supports election processing and benefit payout.

attributes.name: survivor_designated_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated survivor or beneficiary record who will receive survivor pension benefits upon the member's death under the elected pension option.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: administrator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the pension administrator during review and processing of the retirement election, capturing exceptions, clarifications, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the member's bank account designated for direct deposit of pension payments. Full account details held in secure payment system.

attributes.name: best_average_earnings
attributes.description: The member's highest average pensionable earnings over the defined averaging period (typically best 5 years), used as the salary base in the defined benefit pension formula.

attributes.name: bridge_benefit_amount

attributes.name: bridge_benefit_elected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member elected to receive a bridge benefit (temporary supplement payable until state pension eligibility age) as part of their retirement package.

attributes.name: bridge_benefit_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bridge benefit ceases, typically when the member reaches state pension eligibility age (age 65) or upon earlier death.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: commutation_amount
attributes.description: The lump-sum transfer value amount elected by the member for commutation of a portion of their defined benefit pension entitlement.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: commutation_elected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member elected to commute a portion of their pension to a lump-sum transfer value, reducing the ongoing annuity amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this retirement election record was first created in the system of record.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this retirement election record (e.g., USD, GBP).

attributes.name: disability_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member's disability was formally certified by a qualified medical authority, required for disability retirement type elections.

attributes.name: early_retirement_reduction_rate

attributes.name: effective_retirement_date

attributes.name: election_channel

attributes.name: election_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the retirement election form used by the member, ensuring the correct plan rules and options were presented at the time of election.

attributes.name: election_received_date
attributes.description: The date the pension administrator physically or electronically received the completed retirement election form from the member.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: election_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business reference number assigned to this retirement election, used in member correspondence and administrative processing.

attributes.name: election_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the retirement election from initial submission through administrative approval or rejection.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: election_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the member formally submitted the retirement election to the pension administrator. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the first pension benefit payment to the member following retirement election approval.

attributes.name: gross_annual_pension
attributes.description: The calculated gross annual pension benefit payable to the member before any reductions, indexation, or survivor benefit adjustments.

attributes.name: guaranteed_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years for which pension payments are guaranteed regardless of the member's death, applicable when the guaranteed period pension option is elected (e.g., 5, 10, 15 years).

attributes.name: indexation_type
attributes.description: The type of cost-of-living indexation applied to the pension: full CPI, partial CPI, fixed rate, or none. Determines how the pension is adjusted annually for inflation.

attributes.name: is_irrevocable

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this retirement election record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: member_age_at_retirement
attributes.description: The member's age in whole years as of the effective retirement date. Used for actuarial factor selection and early retirement penalty determination.

attributes.name: member_consent_obtained

attributes.name: member_date_of_birth

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: survivor_relationship

attributes.name: bank_reference_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: days_late

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: employer_contact_email

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount

attributes.name: file_reference_number

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description

attributes.name: remittance_reference_number

attributes.name: remittance_status

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a pension benefit option available to members at retirement. Primary key for the benefit_option reference entity.

attributes.name: contributor_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to beneficiary.contributor_pool. Business justification: Benefit options are defined per contributor pool. The contributor_pool_code STRING should be normalized to a FK.

attributes.name: actuarial_basis_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the actuarial assumptions basis (mortality table, discount rate set, and valuation methodology) used to calculate reduction factors and transfer values for this option (e.g., 'RP2014_SCALE_MP_2021').
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards Board; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS 19

attributes.name: actuarial_basis_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current actuarial basis (mortality table and assumptions) referenced by actuarial_basis_code became effective for this benefit option. Supports liability valuation versioning.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards Board; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS 19

attributes.name: benefit_option_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit option. Inactive or deprecated options may still apply to members who elected them historically. Grandfathered options are closed to new elections.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: bridge_benefit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit option includes a bridge benefit component, which supplements pension income until the member reaches the state pension eligibility age.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable state pension legislation

attributes.name: bridge_benefit_end_age
attributes.description: Age at which the bridge benefit component ceases (typically 65, aligned with state pension eligibility). Null if bridge_benefit_eligible is false.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable state pension legislation

attributes.name: commutation_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lump-sum commutation (partial or full conversion of the annuity to a present value cash payment) is permitted under this benefit option. Subject to applicable tax law limits.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable tax law; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: commutation_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of the pension's actuarial present value that may be commuted to a lump sum under this option (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Null if commutation_allowed is false.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable tax law; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit option record was first created in the system of record. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; ISO 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: death_benefit_type
attributes.description: Type of death benefit payable if the member dies before or after pension commencement under this option. Drives beneficiary designation requirements and actuarial reserve calculations.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: default_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit option is the plan default applied when a member does not make an explicit election within the election window. Typically the joint and survivor annuity for married members.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: early_retirement_reduction
attributes.description: Indicates whether an actuarial reduction applies to the pension amount when this option is elected before the member's unreduced retirement age. Relevant for early retirement planning analytics.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: early_retirement_reduction_rate
attributes.description: Annual actuarial reduction rate applied per year of early retirement before the unreduced retirement age (e.g., 0.03000 = 3% per year). Null if early_retirement_reduction is false.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this benefit option became available for member election within the applicable contributor pool. Used for eligibility determination and actuarial liability calculations.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS 19

attributes.name: election_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's election of this benefit option is irrevocable once made. True for most annuity forms post-commencement. Drives member counselling and governance requirements.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: election_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the member's retirement date within which this benefit option must be elected. Governs member communication timelines and plan administration workflows.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this benefit option was closed to new elections. Null if the option remains open. Supports grandfathering logic and liability-driven investment (LDI) horizon analysis.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: guaranteed_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years for which pension payments are guaranteed regardless of the member's survival (e.g., 5, 10, 15 years). Applicable only to guaranteed period options. Null for non-guaranteed options.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: indexation_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum annual indexation rate applied to pension payments under this option (e.g., 0.0800 = 8% cap). Null if indexation_type is full_cpi or none. Used in actuarial liability modelling and LDI stress testing.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: indexation_floor_pct
attributes.description: Minimum annual indexation rate guaranteed under this option (e.g., 0.0000 = no negative indexation). Null if indexation_type is none. Relevant for liability-driven investment (LDI) and actuarial liability matching.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: indexation_type
attributes.description: Type of cost-of-living indexation applied to pension payments under this option. Full CPI = 100% of Consumer Price Index; Partial CPI = capped or floored CPI; Fixed Rate = predetermined annual increase; None = flat payment.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: ldi_liability_category
attributes.description: Classification of the pension liability stream generated by this benefit option for liability-driven investment (LDI) and asset-liability management (ALM) purposes. Drives duration matching and hedging strategy.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: max_retirement_age
attributes.description: Maximum age by which a member must commence this benefit option. Typically aligned with tax-law mandatory commencement rules (e.g., a statutory maximum age). Null if no upper bound applies.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable tax law; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: member_facing_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of this benefit option as presented in member communications, pension statements, and retirement counselling materials. Supports member education and disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: min_retirement_age
attributes.description: Minimum age at which a member is eligible to elect this benefit option. Varies by contributor pool and option type (e.g., early retirement options may have different thresholds).
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; applicable tax law

attributes.name: min_service_years
attributes.description: Minimum years of pensionable service required for a member to be eligible to elect this benefit option. Used in eligibility screening during retirement counselling.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: option_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the benefit option within the pension plan (e.g., SLA, JSA_50, JSA_100, GP5, BRIDGE). Used in member communications and plan documents.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: option_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit option as presented to plan members (e.g., 'Single Life Annuity', 'Joint and Survivor 60% Annuity', 'Bridge Benefit', 'Guaranteed Period 10-Year').
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the benefit option structure. Drives actuarial valuation methodology and member eligibility rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if additional types are added]
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS 19 Employee Benefits; Actuarial Standards Board

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which pension payments are disbursed to the member under this option. Monthly is standard for most pension plans.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: payment_timing
attributes.description: Indicates whether pension payments under this option are made at the beginning (in advance) or end (in arrears) of each payment period. Affects actuarial present value calculations.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards Board; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: pension_adjustment_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pension Adjustment (PA) must be reported on the member's annual tax slip slip for years in which this benefit option accrues. Relevant for registered pension plan tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: applicable tax law; tax authority annual tax slip Reporting; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: plan_text_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section or clause in the pension plan text or legislation that governs this benefit option (e.g., 'a section of the governing plan statute'). Supports regulatory audit.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; IFRS 19

attributes.name: reduction_factor_pct
attributes.description: Actuarially determined reduction applied to the member's base pension amount when electing this option, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.050000 = 5% reduction for joint and survivor coverage). Derived from actuarial tables.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards Board; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; IFRS 19

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory approval or registration of this benefit option with the applicable pension regulator (e.g. registration number). Supports compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Integer controlling the display sequence of benefit options in member-facing portals, retirement counselling tools, and administrative systems. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: spousal_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether spousal or common-law partner consent is required for the member to elect this option. Typically required when waiving joint and survivor coverage. Regulatory compliance field.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation; Pension Benefits Act

attributes.name: survivor_fraction_pct
attributes.description: For joint and survivor annuity options, the fraction of the member's pension payable to the surviving spouse or beneficiary upon the member's death (e.g., 0.5000, 0.6000, 0.6667, 1.0000). Null for non-joint options.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; Actuarial Standards Board; IFRS 19

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the income tax treatment applicable to pension payments under this option (e.g., 'REGISTERED_PENSION_PLAN_RPP', 'retirement_account_transfer'). Aligns with tax authority reporting requirements.
attributes.references: applicable tax law; the national pension regulator; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: transfer_value_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether a member electing this option is eligible to receive a transfer value (commuted value transferred to a locked-in retirement account) instead of the annuity. Typically available before pension commencement.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; the national pension regulator; Pension Benefits Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this benefit option record. Used for change detection, data synchronisation, and audit trail maintenance across the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; ISO 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5

products.name: overpayment_recovery
products.description: Transactional record tracking instances where benefit payments were made in excess of entitlement (due to death notification delays, calculation errors, or eligibility changes) and the subsequent recovery process.

attributes.name: overpayment_recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each overpayment recovery record in the pension fund beneficiary domain.

attributes.name: designated_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan member who received the overpayment. Links to the beneficiary master record.

attributes.name: benefit_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original benefit payment transaction that resulted in the overpayment.

attributes.name: contributor_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to beneficiary.contributor_pool. Business justification: Overpayment recovery records have contributor_pool STRING. Recovery rules may vary by pool. Normalizing to FK.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan member who received the overpayment. Links to the beneficiary master record.

attributes.name: rule_breach_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rule_breach. Business justification: Overpayments often constitute compliance breaches requiring formal tracking. Pension regulators require breach documentation for overpayment incidents.

attributes.name: actual_recovery_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery was fully completed or formally closed, whether through full repayment, write-off, or legal settlement.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standard

attributes.name: amount_recovered_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount successfully recovered from the beneficiary or their estate as of the most recent update to this record.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: case_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the case owner documenting key events, member communications, and decisions throughout the recovery lifecycle.

attributes.name: case_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the pension administration officer assigned as the primary owner of this recovery case.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this overpayment recovery record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this overpayment recovery record (e.g., USD, GBP).

attributes.name: detection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the overpayment was first identified, either through system reconciliation, audit, or member notification.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary formally raised a dispute against the overpayment recovery claim.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: dispute_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the formal dispute process, indicating whether the recovery claim was upheld, partially upheld, dismissed, or withdrawn.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: dispute_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary or their estate has formally disputed the overpayment claim or the recovery amount.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was formally resolved, either in favour of the fund or the beneficiary.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: estate_claim_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the claim filed against the deceased beneficiary's estate for recovery of overpaid pension benefits.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: expected_recovery_end_date
attributes.description: Projected date by which the full net recoverable amount is expected to be collected based on the agreed recovery plan.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standard

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Oracle Financials GL account code to which the overpayment recovery transaction is posted for accounting and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; FASB ASC 715; Oracle Financials Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gross_overpayment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount paid to the beneficiary in excess of their entitlement over the overpayment period, before any adjustments or recoveries.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; operational resilience guidance; FASB ASC 715

attributes.name: hardship_waiver_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the overpayment formally waived due to the beneficiary's demonstrated financial hardship, reducing the net recoverable balance.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: hardship_waiver_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial hardship waiver has been granted to the beneficiary, reducing or suspending the recovery obligation.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: instalment_amount
attributes.description: Periodic instalment amount agreed with the beneficiary for repayment of the overpayment, applicable when recovery method is instalment plan.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: instalment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which recovery instalments are scheduled to be deducted or received from the beneficiary.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this overpayment recovery record, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: legal_action_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal legal proceedings were initiated to recover the outstanding overpayment balance.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: legal_action_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal legal proceedings have been initiated to recover the overpayment from the beneficiary or their estate.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: member_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary was formally notified of the overpayment and the fund's intent to recover the amount.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; GDPR Article 13; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: net_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount the fund is entitled to recover from the beneficiary after tax adjustments, representing the actual recovery target.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; operational resilience guidance

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the overpayment notification was communicated to the beneficiary or their legal representative.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining amount yet to be recovered, calculated as net recoverable amount minus amount recovered to date.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: overpayment_cause
attributes.description: Root cause category explaining why the benefit was paid in excess of entitlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death_notification_delay|calculation_error|eligibility_change|duplicate_payment|rate_error|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: overpayment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the overpayment ceased, either because the benefit was corrected, suspended, or the member's entitlement was updated.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: overpayment_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the benefit payments began to exceed the member's entitlement, marking the beginning of the overpayment period.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: overpayment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benefit type that was overpaid, distinguishing pension, survivor, disability, or lump-sum payments.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the overpayment is being recovered, such as deduction from ongoing benefit, lump-sum repayment, or estate claim.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: recovery_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique reference number assigned to this overpayment recovery case, used in member correspondence and audit trails.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standard

attributes.name: recovery_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery process formally commenced, i.e., when the first deduction or repayment was initiated.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standard

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the overpayment recovery case. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identified|notified|in_recovery|disputed|recovered|written_off|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Internal Pension Administration Standard

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which this overpayment recovery case was reported to the relevant regulatory authority, where reporting is required.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this overpayment recovery case must be reported to a regulatory body such as Pension regulator or a local pension regulator.
attributes.references: operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: responsible_team
attributes.description: Internal team or department responsible for managing and progressing this overpayment recovery case.

attributes.name: simcorp_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this overpayment recovery case as recorded in SimCorp Dimension ABOR/Investment Accounting module.
attributes.references: SimCorp Dimension ABOR; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: tax_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Tax withheld or adjustments applied to the gross overpayment amount, reflecting net recoverable amount after tax treatment.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net recoverable amount formally written off as irrecoverable, approved per the fund's write-off policy.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; operational resilience guidance; FASB ASC 715

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the write-off of the irrecoverable overpayment amount was formally approved and recorded.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; operational resilience guidance

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Reason for writing off the irrecoverable balance, such as deceased with no estate, financial hardship, or statute-barred debt.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19; operational resilience guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

products.name: member_document
products.description: Master record of official documents associated with a plan member's pension file: enrollment forms, beneficiary designation forms, retirement applications, marriage certificates, divorce orders (for pension division), disability certifications, death
products.reference: Member File Document / Pension File Record

attributes.name: member_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each member document record in the pension file management system. Primary key for the member_document entity.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan member whose file this document belongs to. Links the document to the beneficiary master record.

attributes.name: pension_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pension plan (one per participating plan) under which this document was filed.

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer member_document record that replaces this document when a member submits an updated version (e.g., revised beneficiary designation). Null if not superseded.

attributes.name: access_restriction_level
attributes.description: Operational access control level specifying which staff roles may view or process this document. Enforced by the document management system's role-based access control (RBAC) configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document constitutes or amends a beneficiary designation for death benefit purposes. Triggers update of the beneficiary entitlement record upon acceptance.
attributes.references: applicable pension benefits legislation; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: certified_copy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is a certified true copy authenticated by a notary, commissioner of oaths, or equivalent authority. Relevant for legal admissibility in pension division proceedings.

attributes.name: contains_phi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document contains protected health information (PHI) such as medical diagnoses or disability assessments. Triggers enhanced access restrictions and audit logging.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; applicable privacy law; Local Health Information Privacy Legislation

attributes.name: contains_pii_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document contains personally identifiable information (PII) subject to privacy legislation. Drives access controls, masking requirements, and breach notification obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; applicable privacy law; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this member document record was first created in the pension administration system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per data governance standards.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Information security classification of the document content per the fund's data governance policy: restricted (PII/PHI), confidential (sensitive business), internal, or public.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; third-party risk management guidance; SOC 2

attributes.name: digital_repository_path
attributes.description: Logical path or URI to the document's digital file in the pension fund's secure document management system or content repository. Confidential due to system access sensitivity.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; Internal Records Management Policy

attributes.name: disability_certification_type
attributes.description: For disability-related documents, classifies whether this is an initial certification, a periodic renewal, or a termination of disability status. Not applicable for non-disability documents.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: document_category
attributes.description: Broad grouping of the document for records management and retrieval: identity (ID proofs), entitlement (benefit rights), legal_order (court orders), medical (disability/death), financial (contribution/payment), administrative (forms/applications).
attributes.references: Internal Records Management Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The official date appearing on the document itself (e.g., date of signing, date of issuance by a court or authority). Distinct from the date the document was received by the fund.
attributes.references: applicable pension benefits legislation; IFRS Foundation

attributes.name: document_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the content, purpose, or special circumstances of the document, used by pension administrators for context during file review.

attributes.name: document_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-2 language code of the document's primary language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French). Determines translation requirements for multilingual pension administration.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to the document upon receipt or generation, used for correspondence and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: prudential regulator guidance; Internal Records Management Policy

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document within the pension file workflow: received upon intake, under_review during verification, verified/accepted once validated, rejected if invalid, superseded if replaced, archived for closed files.
attributes.references: prudential regulator guidance; Internal Document Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the document as it appears on the physical or digital record (e.g., 'Retirement Application Form – Plan 1').

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document by its business purpose (e.g., enrollment_form, beneficiary_designation, retirement_application, marriage_certificate, divorce_order, disability_certification, death_certificate, power_of_attorney, transfer_request).
attributes.references: applicable pension benefits legislation; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the document's instructions or legal effect become operative for pension entitlement purposes (e.g., effective date of a beneficiary designation change or pension division order).
attributes.references: applicable pension benefits legislation; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document ceases to be valid or requires renewal (e.g., a temporary disability certification or a power of attorney with a defined term). Null for permanent documents.
attributes.references: prudential regulator guidance; Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Digital file format of the stored document (e.g., PDF, TIFF, JPEG). Relevant for long-term preservation standards and accessibility compliance in pension records management.

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the digital document file in kilobytes. Used for storage capacity planning and to flag unusually large or small files that may indicate scanning quality issues.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government body, court, institution, or organization that issued or certified the document (e.g., 'a family court', 'the plan administrator', 'a participating employer').
attributes.references: applicable pension benefits legislation; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction that issued the document. Required for foreign documents subject to apostille or notarization requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATF Recommendations; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: issuing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Province, state, or sub-national jurisdiction of the issuing authority where applicable (e.g., 'New York', 'California'). Relevant for pension division orders and legal documents.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; applicable pension benefits legislation

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this member document record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: member_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member was formally notified of the document processing outcome. Used to measure compliance with regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: Local Pension Regulators and Actuarial Standards Boards; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: member_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has been formally notified of the document's acceptance, rejection, or any required follow-up action. Supports SLA compliance and member communication tracking.

attributes.name: implementation_date

attributes.name: is_indexation_shared

attributes.name: legal_counsel_reference

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, legal qualifications, or administrative remarks associated with the pension division order.

attributes.name: order_status

attributes.name: order_type

attributes.name: pension_credit_start_date

attributes.name: plan_type

products.reference: Barra Factor Exposure / CAPM Factor Loading

attributes.name: equity_factor_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the factor exposure record.

attributes.name: equity_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Reference to the benchmark index used for relative factor exposure analysis. Null if absolute exposure only.

attributes.name: factor_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the factor model used for exposure calculation.

attributes.name: listed_security_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equity security for which factor exposures are calculated.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio for which factor exposures are calculated. Null if exposure is at security level only.

attributes.name: active_exposure
attributes.description: The difference between portfolio factor exposure and benchmark factor exposure, representing active positioning relative to benchmark.
attributes.references: GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards), Active Management Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual adjustments or overrides applied to the calculated factor exposure. Null if no adjustments made.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the factor exposure record was approved for use in risk reporting and portfolio management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the risk analyst or portfolio manager who approved the factor exposure calculation or adjustment.

attributes.name: beta_to_market
attributes.description: The beta coefficient representing the sensitivity of the security or portfolio to market movements. Core metric in CAPM (Capital Asset Pricing Model).
attributes.references: CAPM (Capital Asset Pricing Model), CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate the factor exposure: regression analysis, covariance matrix, portfolio optimization, or performance attribution.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the factor exposure calculation was performed.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the factor exposure calculation, data quality issues, or analytical insights.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Confidence level for the factor exposure calculation, typically expressed as a percentage such as 95% or 99%.

attributes.name: contribution_to_risk
attributes.description: The contribution of this factor exposure to the overall portfolio risk, measured in percentage or basis points (bps).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which factor returns and exposures are denominated.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or vendor providing the factor exposure data, such as MSCI Barra, Bloomberg, FactSet, BlackRock Aladdin, or internal calculation.

attributes.name: exposure_date
attributes.description: The date for which the factor exposure is calculated and reported.

attributes.name: exposure_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile rank of the factor exposure relative to peer universe or historical distribution. Range 0 to 100.

attributes.name: exposure_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the magnitude of exposure to the factor. Standardized exposure score, typically z-score normalized.

attributes.name: exposure_weight
attributes.description: Portfolio weight applied to the security when calculating portfolio-level factor exposure. Null for security-level exposures.

attributes.name: factor_category
attributes.description: Classification of the factor into broad categories: style factors, industry factors, country factors, currency factors, market factors, or macroeconomic factors.

attributes.name: factor_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the factor model used, such as Barra GEM4, USE4, EUE3, or CAPM variant.

attributes.name: factor_name
attributes.description: Name of the risk factor, such as market beta, size, value, momentum, quality, low volatility, growth, leverage, liquidity, earnings yield, or sector-specific factors.
attributes.references: MSCI Barra Factor Taxonomy, CAPM (Capital Asset Pricing Model) Framework

attributes.name: factor_return
attributes.description: The return attributed to this factor over the exposure period, expressed as a percentage or decimal.

attributes.name: factor_volatility
attributes.description: The volatility or standard deviation of the factor return, representing the risk associated with the factor itself.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which factor exposures are calculated and reported: daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor exposure record is currently active and should be used in risk reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of historical data used in the factor exposure calculation, such as 60, 90, 252, or 504 days.

attributes.name: marginal_contribution_to_risk
attributes.description: Marginal contribution to total portfolio risk from this factor exposure, representing the change in risk if exposure changes by one unit.

attributes.name: outlier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the factor exposure value is identified as a statistical outlier requiring review or adjustment.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: Probability value indicating the statistical significance of the factor exposure. Values below 0.05 typically indicate significance at 95% confidence level.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score for the factor exposure calculation, ranging from 0 to 100, based on data completeness, timeliness, and model fit.

attributes.name: r_squared
attributes.description: Coefficient of determination indicating the proportion of variance in security returns explained by the factor model. Range 0 to 1.
attributes.references: Statistical Analysis Standards, MSCI Barra Model Diagnostics

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factor exposure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this factor exposure record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: t_statistic

attributes.name: wire_instructions_reference

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method

domains.name: naturalresource

products.name: resource_asset

attributes.name: resource_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the natural resource asset. Primary key for timberland parcels, farmland tracts, mining concessions, energy assets (upstream oil & gas, renewables), and other physical resource holdings.

attributes.name: asset_manager_gp_profile_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manager.gp_profile. Business justification: Asset manager assignment is required for performance reporting and regulatory compliance.

tag_set.value: Asset Manager Gp Profile Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Audit findings related to asset operations.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: Certifications (ISO, etc.) for asset.

attributes.name: country_outlook_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.country_outlook. Business justification: Country risk assessment for each asset is driven by the country outlook.

attributes.name: gips_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.gips_compliance_record. Business justification: GIPS compliance record for asset performance reporting.

attributes.name: operator_actor_id

attributes.name: policy_document_id

attributes.name: project_investment_id

attributes.name: sfdr_disclosure_id
