attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost paid to acquire the resource asset, including purchase price and direct acquisition expenses, in base currency (USD).
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pension fund acquired ownership or control of the natural resource asset.

attributes.name: annual_production_capacity
attributes.description: Estimated annual production or harvest capacity of the resource asset in the unit specified by production_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: area_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total_area field.

attributes.name: asset_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-recognized unique code or registration number for the resource asset (e.g., cadastral parcel ID, mining concession number, lease block identifier, title deed reference).
attributes.references: Local Land Registry and Resource Regulatory Standards

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the natural resource asset (e.g., 'Cascade Timberland Tract', 'Permian Basin Block 7', 'Iowa Farmland Portfolio A').

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current operational and ownership status of the resource asset within the portfolio.
attributes.references: IFRS 5 Non-current Assets Held for Sale

attributes.name: carbon_footprint
attributes.description: Estimated annual greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions attributable to the resource asset, measured in tonnes of CO2 equivalent.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol, TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures)

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the resource asset is physically located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resource asset record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values associated with this asset.

attributes.name: current_valuation
attributes.description: Most recent fair market value or Net Asset Value (NAV) of the resource asset in base currency (USD).
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards)

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this resource asset data originated (e.g., 'eFront', 'SimCorp Dimension', 'Internal Asset Register').

attributes.name: depletion_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the resource asset over its productive life.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, FASB ASC 932 Extractive Activities

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Discount rate or Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) used in valuation models for this resource asset, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental or sustainability certifications held by the resource asset (e.g., FSC for timberland, ISO 14001, LEED, organic certification for farmland).
attributes.references: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: esg_rating
attributes.description: Overall ESG rating or score assigned to the resource asset by internal or external ESG assessment (e.g., MSCI ESG rating, internal sustainability score).
attributes.references: PRI (Principles for Responsible Investment), TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures)

attributes.name: estimated_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining productive life of the resource asset in years, based on current reserve estimates and production rates.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or jurisdiction where the resource asset is located (e.g., 'North America', 'Latin America', 'Asia Pacific').

attributes.name: insurance_coverage
attributes.description: Total insurance coverage amount for the resource asset, including property, liability, and operational risk insurance, in base currency (USD).

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: Investment strategy or mandate under which this resource asset was acquired (e.g., 'Core Natural Resources', 'Opportunistic Energy', 'Sustainable Timberland').

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection, audit, or operational review of the resource asset.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the resource asset centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the resource asset centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next physical inspection, audit, or operational review of the resource asset.

attributes.name: operator_lei
attributes.description: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier for the operator of the resource asset.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity responsible for day-to-day operations and management of the resource asset (may be the pension fund or a third-party operator).

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of economic interest or ownership held by the pension fund in this resource asset (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: ownership_structure
attributes.description: Legal structure of the pension fund's ownership interest in the resource asset.

attributes.name: permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the primary regulatory permit or concession for the resource asset.

attributes.name: production_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for annual_production_capacity (e.g., 'barrels_per_day', 'tonnes_per_year', 'megawatt_hours').

attributes.name: productive_area
attributes.description: Portion of total area that is actively productive or economically harvestable, in the same unit as total_area.

attributes.name: regulatory_permits
attributes.description: Key regulatory permits, licenses, or concessions held for the operation of the resource asset (e.g., mining permit, drilling license, water rights).

attributes.name: reserve_classification
attributes.description: Confidence classification of the reserve estimate per industry standards (e.g., PRMS for oil & gas, JORC for mining).
attributes.references: PRMS (Petroleum Resources Management System), JORC Code

attributes.name: reserve_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated proven or probable reserves of the resource (e.g., barrels of oil, cubic meters of timber, tonnes of ore) in the unit specified by reserve_unit_of_measure.
attributes.references: PRMS (Petroleum Resources Management System), JORC Code (Mining)

attributes.name: reserve_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for reserve_quantity (e.g., 'barrels', 'cubic_meters', 'tonnes', 'board_feet').

attributes.name: resource_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the resource type (e.g., 'softwood timberland', 'row crop farmland', 'gold mining', 'offshore oil', 'solar farm', 'wind farm').

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the natural resource asset by resource category.
attributes.references: GICS (Global Industry Classification Standard) Natural Resources Sector

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the resource asset based on operational, environmental, regulatory, and market risk factors.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or first-level administrative division where the resource asset is located.

attributes.name: total_area
attributes.description: Total physical area or acreage of the resource asset in the unit specified by area_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resource asset record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent independent valuation or appraisal of the resource asset.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Primary valuation methodology used to determine current_valuation (e.g., Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), comparable sales, income approach).
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, RICS Valuation Standards

products.name: resource_holding
products.description: SSOT for the pension fund's economic interest in each natural resource vehicle — both direct asset holdings and LP/fund commitments. Tracks committed capital, invested capital (PIC), remaining unfunded commitment (dry powder), ownership percentage
products.reference: Private Markets Holding / eFront Investment Record

attributes.name: resource_holding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the natural resource holding record. Primary key for the resource holding entity.

attributes.name: cash_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.cash_account. Business justification: Each resource holding has a dedicated cash account for holding-level cash flows and settlement.

attributes.name: general_partner_actor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.actor. Business justification: Links general partner legal entity for capital call, fee calculation, and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: gp_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general partner or fund manager responsible for managing this natural resource investment vehicle.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general partner or fund manager responsible for managing this natural resource investment vehicle.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio to which this resource holding is allocated.

attributes.name: resource_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the natural resource investment vehicle or fund in which the pension fund holds an economic interest.

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_tonnes
attributes.description: Estimated annual carbon footprint of the natural resource holding, measured in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent emissions.

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pension fund committed capital to this natural resource investment vehicle or asset, typically the Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA) signing date or acquisition agreement date.

attributes.name: committed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital amount committed by the pension fund to this natural resource holding, representing the maximum obligation under the investment agreement.

attributes.name: committed_capital_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the committed capital amount.

attributes.name: commodity_price_exposure
attributes.description: Primary commodity or commodities to which this natural resource holding has price exposure, such as timber, corn, gold, crude oil, or natural gas.

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost or book value of the natural resource holding, used for gain/loss calculation and accounting purposes.

attributes.name: cumulative_distributions_amount
attributes.description: Total distributions received by the pension fund from this natural resource holding since inception, including income, return of capital, and realized gains.

attributes.name: custodian_code
attributes.description: Reference to the custodian bank or fund administrator holding legal custody of the investment documents and assets.

attributes.name: depletion_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of natural resource extraction over the assets productive life: units of production, straight-line, declining balance, or not applicable for non-depleting assets.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: depletion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Annual depletion rate applied to the natural resource asset for accounting and valuation purposes, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: dpi_multiple
attributes.description: Cash-on-cash return metric calculated as cumulative distributions divided by paid-in capital, indicating realized return multiple.

attributes.name: economic_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of economic returns (distributions, profits, carried interest) to which the pension fund is entitled, which may differ from legal ownership percentage due to waterfall structures.

attributes.name: esg_rating
attributes.description: ESG rating assigned to this natural resource holding by internal or external ESG assessment, reflecting environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and governance quality.

attributes.name: expected_harvest_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date for major harvest or production event for the natural resource asset, such as timber harvest, crop harvest, or mine production commencement.

attributes.name: fund_term_years
attributes.description: Total term of the natural resource fund or investment vehicle in years, including any extension periods, as specified in the Limited Partnership Agreement.

attributes.name: geographic_focus
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or country where the natural resource assets are located, using three-letter ISO country codes or regional descriptors.

attributes.name: holding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the resource holding: active management, committed but not yet funded, partially funded with remaining capital calls expected, fully funded, in harvesting or production phase, under divestment process, or fully exited.

attributes.name: holding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the natural resource holding structure: direct ownership of physical assets, limited partner commitment to a fund, co-investment alongside a sponsor, fund of funds allocation, secondary market purchase, or joint venture participation.

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the investment strategy employed for this natural resource holding, such as sustainable forestry, organic farmland, precious metals exploration, renewable energy infrastructure, or commodity arbitrage.

attributes.name: irr_percentage
attributes.description: Annualized internal rate of return on the natural resource holding, calculated using cash flows and current NAV.

attributes.name: is_co_investment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this holding represents a co-investment alongside a general partner or lead investor, typically with reduced or no management fees.

attributes.name: last_capital_call_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent capital call or drawdown notice issued by the general partner for this natural resource holding.

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier for the investment vehicle or holding entity, enabling global entity identification.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Expected maturity or termination date of the natural resource investment vehicle or holding, after which final distributions and liquidation occur.

attributes.name: moic_multiple
attributes.description: Gross return multiple calculated as total value divided by total invested capital, synonymous with TVPI for most holdings.

attributes.name: nav_amount
attributes.description: Current net asset value of the pension funds holding in this natural resource investment, representing fair market value of the position.

attributes.name: nav_as_of_date
attributes.description: Valuation date for the reported NAV amount, typically quarter-end or month-end.

attributes.name: next_valuation_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal valuation of the natural resource holding, typically quarterly or annually.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage ownership interest held by the pension fund in the natural resource vehicle or asset, expressed as a decimal percentage.

attributes.name: paid_in_capital_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative capital actually drawn down and invested in the natural resource holding to date, also known as PIC.

attributes.name: production_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for production volume, such as board feet, metric tons, bushels, barrels, cubic meters, or troy ounces.

attributes.name: production_volume
attributes.description: Current or projected annual production volume from the natural resource asset, measured in asset-specific units such as board feet for timber, bushels for crops, ounces for precious metals, or barrels for oil.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resource holding record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resource holding record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: resource_asset_class
attributes.description: Primary natural resource asset class category for this holding: timberland, farmland, mining operations, energy assets, or commodity-linked investments.

attributes.name: resource_sub_class
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the resource asset class, such as softwood timberland, row crop farmland, precious metals mining, oil and gas upstream, or commodity futures strategy.

attributes.name: rvpi_multiple
attributes.description: Unrealized value metric calculated as current NAV divided by paid-in capital, indicating remaining value multiple.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental certification held by the natural resource asset, such as Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) for timberland, USDA Organic for farmland, or Responsible Mining Initiative certification.

attributes.name: total_value_amount
attributes.description: Sum of current NAV and cumulative distributions, representing the total value generated by the holding to date.

attributes.name: tvpi_multiple
attributes.description: Performance metric calculated as total value divided by paid-in capital, indicating the gross return multiple on invested capital.

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Remaining uncalled committed capital available for future capital calls, commonly referred to as dry powder. Calculated as committed capital minus paid-in capital.

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: Primary valuation approach used for this natural resource holding, such as discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable transactions, net asset value (NAV), or resource-specific models like stumpage value for timber or reserve-based valuation for mining.

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Year in which the initial capital commitment was made or the fund was established, used for cohort performance analysis and benchmarking.

products.name: production_record
products.description: Operational production data captured at the asset level on a periodic basis (monthly/quarterly). Records physical output volumes for each resource type: timber harvest volumes (m³/MBF), crop yields (bushels/tonnes), mineral extraction tonnage, oil & gas

attributes.name: production_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production record. Primary key for the production record entity.

attributes.name: resource_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific natural resource asset (timberland, farmland, mining site, oil/gas field) that generated this production output.

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when external audit or verification of the production record was completed. Marks transition to final status for NAV purposes.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm or independent verifier that validated the production data. Provides audit trail for compliance and investor reporting.

attributes.name: auditor_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the production record has been independently verified by external auditors. Required for final NAV calculation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GIPS Global Investment Performance Standards, IFRS Audit Standards

attributes.name: benchmark_commodity_price
attributes.description: Market benchmark price for the commodity during the reporting period (e.g., WTI crude, LME copper, regional timber index). Used for performance attribution and variance analysis.
attributes.references: Bloomberg Commodity Indices, Industry Benchmark Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of sustainability or responsible sourcing certification held by the asset (e.g., FSC for timber, organic certification for farmland, Equator Principles for mining). Enhances ESG profile and market access.
attributes.references: FSC Forest Stewardship Council, USDA Organic, Equator Principles

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: Quality classification or grade of the produced commodity. Affects pricing and marketability (e.g., timber grade, ore purity, crude oil API gravity, crop quality).

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the production or offtake contract governing this production activity. Links production data to contractual terms and pricing mechanisms.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score for the production data on a scale of 0.00 to 1.00. Reflects completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. Used to assess confidence in valuation inputs.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin of the production data. Indicates reliability and audit trail for NAV determination and performance reporting.

attributes.name: depletion_charge
attributes.description: Accounting charge representing the reduction in resource reserves due to extraction. Calculated using units-of-production method for natural resource assets.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, FASB ASC 932

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental incident (spill, contamination, habitat damage) occurred during the production period. Critical for ESG reporting and risk management.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, TCFD Climate Risk Disclosure

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_tonnes_co2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions in Tonnes Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e)

attributes.name: mandate_term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each mandate term record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the mandate_term data product.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (General Partner or sub-advisor) who is party to this mandate term.

attributes.name: manager_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (General Partner or sub-advisor) who is party to this mandate term.

attributes.name: manager_mandate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent mandate or investment agreement to which these economic and governance terms apply.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class covered by the mandate, used for SAA/TAA alignment and fee benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if additional classes added]
attributes.references: GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards); CFA Institute; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: audit_firm
attributes.description: Name of the independent external auditor engaged to audit the fund's financial statements under this mandate.
attributes.references: LPA; IFRS; FASB; the national pension regulator; SEC

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of profits allocated to the GP as carried interest (carry) above the hurdle rate. Typically 20% for private equity mandates.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Principles; eFront; the national pension regulator; IFRS 9

attributes.name: carry_split_lp_pct
attributes.description: LP share of profits in the carried interest waterfall after the GP catch-up phase. Typically 80% in a standard 80/20 carry structure.

attributes.name: clawback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a GP clawback provision exists, requiring the GP to return previously distributed carry if the fund underperforms over its life.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Principles; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: clawback_lookback_years
attributes.description: Number of years over which the clawback obligation is assessed. Defines the GP's liability window for returning excess carry distributions.

attributes.name: co_invest_carry_rate_pct
attributes.description: Carried interest rate applicable to co-investment transactions, typically lower than the main fund carry rate.
attributes.references: Co-Investment Side Letter; LPA; eFront; ILPA

attributes.name: co_invest_fee_rate_bps
attributes.description: Management fee rate in basis points applicable to co-investment capital deployed alongside the fund, often reduced or zero.
attributes.references: Co-Investment Side Letter; LPA; eFront; ILPA

attributes.name: co_invest_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the LP has negotiated co-investment rights alongside the fund, allowing direct participation in individual deals.
attributes.references: LPA; Co-Investment Side Letter; eFront; Dealpath/DealCloud

attributes.name: commitment_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the LP commitment and fee calculations are denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; LPA; IFRS 9; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: committed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital committed by the LP under this mandate, as stated in the LPA or SMA. Basis for fee calculations where fee_base is committed_capital.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA; eFront; GIPS; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mandate term record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the mandate terms become legally binding and operationally effective, as stated in the LPA or SMA agreement.
attributes.references: LPA; SMA; IFRS 9; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: esg_side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an ESG-specific side letter or addendum is attached to the mandate, imposing additional responsible investment obligations on the GP.
attributes.references: PRI (UN Principles for Responsible Investment); SFDR; TCFD; LPA Side Letter

attributes.name: excuse_right_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the LP has the right to excuse itself from specific investments (e.g., for regulatory, ESG, or conflict-of-interest reasons).
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Principles; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mandate terms expire or the fund reaches its scheduled end of term. Nullable for open-ended mandates.

attributes.name: extension_option_years
attributes.description: Number of additional years the GP may extend the fund term beyond the base term, subject to LP advisory committee or LP consent.

attributes.name: fee_base
attributes.description: The capital base on which management fees are calculated: committed capital, invested capital, NAV, GAV, or AUM. Critical for fee accrual and reconciliation.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; eFront; GIPS

attributes.name: fee_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which management fees are calculated and payable to the GP, as stipulated in the LPA or SMA.

attributes.name: fee_payment_timing
attributes.description: Specifies whether management fees are paid in advance (at the start of the period) or in arrears (at the end of the period).
attributes.references: LPA; SMA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; eFront

attributes.name: fund_administrator
attributes.description: Name of the third-party fund administrator responsible for NAV calculation, capital account maintenance, and investor reporting.
attributes.references: LPA; State Street/Northern Trust; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: fund_domicile
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the fund vehicle is legally domiciled.
attributes.references: LPA; ISO 3166-1; the national pension regulator; FATF; ESMA; SFDR

attributes.name: fund_term_years
attributes.description: Contractual life of the fund in years from the initial closing date, as specified in the LPA. Excludes extension options.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the mandate agreement (e.g., CYM for Cayman Islands, GBR, USA).
attributes.references: LPA; ISO 3166-1; the national pension regulator; FCA; SEC

attributes.name: gp_catch_up_rate_pct
attributes.description: Rate at which the GP receives profits during the catch-up phase after the LP preferred return is met, before the standard carry split applies.

attributes.name: high_water_mark_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a high-water mark provision applies, requiring the fund to recover prior losses before carry is charged again.

attributes.name: hurdle_rate_pct
attributes.description: Minimum annualized return (preferred return) that must be achieved before the GP is entitled to carried interest. Also known as the hurdle rate.

attributes.name: hurdle_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the hurdle is a hard hurdle (carry only on returns above hurdle) or soft hurdle (catch-up provision applies once hurdle is met).

attributes.name: ic_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Investment Committee formally approved the mandate terms and authorized the LP commitment.
attributes.references: IC (Investment Committee); Diligent/BoardEffect; Internal Governance Policy; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: investment_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund's investment period closes, after which new capital deployments are restricted and management fees may step down.

attributes.name: key_person_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandate includes a key person provision that suspends the investment period if named key individuals depart the GP.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the mandate term record, supporting amendment tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lp_advisory_committee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the LP has a seat or observer rights on the Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) for this fund mandate.

attributes.name: mandate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mandate structure governing these terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LPA|SMA|co_investment|FoF|sub_advisory|co_investment_side_letter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LPA (Limited Partnership Agreement); SMA (Separately Managed Account); eFront; Preqin

attributes.name: mgmt_fee_rate_bps
attributes.description: Annual management fee rate expressed in basis points (bps) applied to the fee base. Represents the primary tier or flat rate where tiered schedules are not applicable.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; GIPS; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: mgmt_fee_tier_schedule
attributes.description: Textual or structured description of tiered management fee breakpoints by AUM band (e.g., 100bps on first $500M, 75bps above). Stored as structured text pending normalization.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; eFront

attributes.name: monitoring_fee_offset_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of portfolio company monitoring, transaction, or advisory fees received by the GP that must be credited back to offset LP management fees.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; eFront; SEC

attributes.name: most_favored_nation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the LP has Most Favored Nation rights, entitling it to the most favorable economic terms offered to any other LP in the fund.
attributes.references: LPA; Side Letter; ILPA Principles; SEC

attributes.name: no_fault_divorce_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether LPs have the right to remove the GP without cause (no-fault divorce) by a supermajority vote.

attributes.name: organizational_expense_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of committed capital that the GP may charge as organizational and formation expenses to the fund.

attributes.name: post_investment_fee_rate_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Post-Investment Period Management Fee Rate (Basis Points)
attributes.description: Reduced management fee rate in basis points applicable after the investment period ends, typically applied to invested (not committed) capital.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Fee Transparency Template; eFront

tag_set.value: Post-Investment Period Management Fee Rate (Basis Points)

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the GP is contractually required to deliver fund performance, valuation, and portfolio reports to the LP.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Reporting Template; GIPS; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: term_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this version of the mandate term, used in LPA schedules, SMA agreements, and co-investment side letters.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the mandate term record, governing whether the economic terms are operationally binding.

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: Accounting and valuation standard used to determine NAV/GAV for the fund under this mandate (e.g., IPEV guidelines, IFRS 13, FASB ASC 820).
attributes.references: IPEV Guidelines; IFRS 13; FASB ASC 820; GIPS; eFront; the national pension regulator

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the fund's first capital call was made or the mandate became effective. Used for peer benchmarking and J-curve analysis.

attributes.name: waterfall_type
attributes.description: Distribution waterfall structure: deal-by-deal (American) allows carry on each deal; whole-fund (European) requires full capital return before carry.
attributes.references: LPA; ILPA Principles; eFront; the national pension regulator

products.name: mandate_amendment
products.description: Records each formal amendment to an existing mandate, capturing amendment date, amendment type (fee renegotiation, guideline change, term extension, side letter), the specific clause modified, prior value, revised value, and approval authority.
products.reference: LPA Amendment / Side Letter / Mandate Modification

attributes.name: mandate_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each formal amendment record to an external manager mandate. Primary key for the mandate_amendment product in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: actor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governance body or individual (e.g., Investment Committee, Board, CIO) that approved this amendment. Links to the governance authority entity.
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) whose mandate is being amended. Sourced from the manager master profile.

attributes.name: manager_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) whose mandate is being amended. Sourced from the manager master profile.

attributes.name: manager_mandate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent mandate (LPA, SMA, co-investment agreement, or FoF mandate) that this amendment modifies. Links to the mandate master record.

attributes.name: mandate_dealcloud_amendment_id
attributes.description: Native amendment record identifier from DealCloud (Deal Pipeline and Origination CRM), used for amendments originating from the deal pipeline or manager relationship management workflow.
attributes.references: Dealpath / DealCloud CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: mandate_efront_amendment_id
attributes.description: Native amendment record identifier from eFront (Private Markets Portfolio Monitoring system), the primary system of record for private market mandate amendments. Enables reconciliation.
attributes.references: eFront Private Markets Platform; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the amendment was formally agreed and signed by both parties. This is the legally binding execution date per the amendment agreement.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; IFRS 9; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: amendment_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for the amendment as documented in the IC memo or negotiation record. Captures the strategic or operational reason driving the change.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; ILPA Principles; Diligent / BoardEffect

attributes.name: amendment_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference code assigned to this amendment (e.g., AMD-MAND0042-2024-001). Used in legal correspondence, IC memos, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal Mandate Management Policy; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the amendment from drafting through execution. Controls downstream processing and reporting inclusion.
attributes.references: Internal Mandate Management Policy; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment by its primary business purpose. Drives workflow routing and legal review requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: LPA (Limited Partnership Agreement) Standard; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: amendment_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number for amendments to the same clause or provision within the same mandate. Enables tracking of iterative renegotiations over the mandate lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Governance tier at which the amendment was approved, reflecting the materiality and delegation of authority framework (e.g., CIO for minor fee adjustments, Board for material term changes).
attributes.references: Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; Internal Delegation of Authority Policy

attributes.name: clause_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of the clause or provision being amended, providing business context for the change beyond the clause reference number.

attributes.name: clause_reference
attributes.description: Specific section, article, or clause number within the original mandate agreement (LPA, SMA, or co-investment agreement) that is being modified by this amendment.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; SMA (Separately Managed Account) Agreement Template

attributes.name: counterparty_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the external manager (GP or sub-advisor) executed their signature on the amendment document. May differ from amendment_date if signing occurred in stages.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amendment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking per ISO 27001.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable when value_unit is currency (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Null for non-monetary clause amendments.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference or file path for the executed amendment agreement. Enables retrieval of the legal document from the document repository.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the amended terms take legal and operational effect. May differ from amendment_date if the amendment has a retroactive or future effective date.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; IFRS 9; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: esg_impact_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an ESG impact assessment was conducted for this amendment, particularly relevant for guideline changes affecting ESG constraints or responsible investment mandates.
attributes.references: PRI (UN Principles for Responsible Investment); TCFD; SFDR; Internal ESG Policy

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amended terms cease to apply, if the amendment is time-limited (e.g., a temporary fee waiver or a side letter with a sunset clause). Null for permanent amendments.

attributes.name: fee_type_amended
attributes.description: Specific fee component modified by this amendment when amendment_type is fee_renegotiation. Null for non-fee amendments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: management_fee|carried_interest|hurdle_rate|preferred_return|transaction_fee|monitoring_fee|setup_fee|clawback —
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: ic_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Investment Committee formally approved this amendment. May precede the amendment_date (execution date) by days or weeks.
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: ic_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or resolution identifier from the Investment Committee (IC) meeting minutes approving this amendment. Links to the governance record in Diligent/BoardEffect.
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: internal_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pension fund's authorized signatory executed the amendment on behalf of the fund. Completes the bilateral execution of the amendment.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; Internal Delegation of Authority Policy

attributes.name: investment_guideline_category
attributes.description: Category of investment guideline modified when amendment_type is guideline_change. Drives compliance monitoring updates in BlackRock Aladdin and Charles River IMS.
attributes.references: BlackRock Aladdin Compliance Module; Charles River IMS; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: is_material_amendment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment is classified as material under the fund's internal governance policy, triggering enhanced IC approval, legal review, and regulatory disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; prudential regulator guidance; MiFID II Article 25

attributes.name: is_side_letter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment is structured as a side letter (a separate bilateral agreement supplementing the main LPA or SMA) rather than a formal amendment to the primary document.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; ILPA Principles; ILPA Side Letter Guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this amendment record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: legal_counsel_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external legal counsel firm engaged to review and draft this amendment. Supports legal cost tracking and counsel relationship management.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Policy; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: legal_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the internal or external legal review of this amendment has been formally completed and signed off prior to execution.
attributes.references: Internal Mandate Management Policy; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: mfn_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Most Favoured Nation (MFN) clause applies to this amendment, entitling the pension fund to the most favourable terms granted to any other LP in the fund.
attributes.references: ILPA Principles; LPA Standard; ILPA Side Letter Guidance

attributes.name: negotiation_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the negotiation process, key concessions, and counterparty positions leading to the agreed amendment terms. Supports post-deal review and future renegotiations.
attributes.references: ILPA Principles; Internal Mandate Management Policy

attributes.name: prior_carry_rate
attributes.description: The carried interest (carry) rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.20 for 20%) in effect before this amendment. Populated when fee_type_amended includes carried_interest.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: prior_hurdle_rate
attributes.description: The preferred return / hurdle rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.08 for 8%) before this amendment. The threshold IRR the GP must exceed before earning carry.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: prior_management_fee_rate
attributes.description: The management fee rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.015 for 1.5%) in effect before this amendment. Populated only when fee_type_amended includes management_fee.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: prior_term_end_date
attributes.description: The original contractual end date of the mandate or fund term before this amendment. Populated for term extension amendments to document the change.

attributes.name: prior_value
attributes.description: The original contractual value, rate, limit, or text of the clause before this amendment. Stored as STRING to accommodate numeric, percentage, date, and free-text clause values.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; IFRS 9; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment triggers a regulatory disclosure obligation (e.g., SFDR, SEC reporting). Drives compliance workflow and regulatory reporting queue.
attributes.references: SFDR; Pension regulator Governance Guidelines; SEC; FCA; ESMA

attributes.name: revised_carry_rate
attributes.description: The carried interest (carry) rate as a decimal after this amendment. Tracks renegotiated economics for performance attribution and fee analysis.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: revised_hurdle_rate
attributes.description: The preferred return / hurdle rate as a decimal after this amendment. Impacts IRR and MOIC calculations for performance attribution.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: revised_management_fee_rate
attributes.description: The management fee rate (as a decimal) after this amendment. Enables fee savings tracking and benchmarking against Preqin/PitchBook market data.
attributes.references: ILPA Fee Transparency Template; LPA Standard

attributes.name: revised_term_end_date
attributes.description: The new contractual end date of the mandate or fund term after this amendment. Used in ALM, liquidity forecasting, and commitment scheduling.

attributes.name: revised_value
attributes.description: The new contractual value, rate, limit, or text of the clause after this amendment. Stored as STRING to accommodate numeric, percentage, date, and free-text clause values.
attributes.references: LPA Standard; IFRS 9; prudential regulator guidance

attributes.name: side_letter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the side letter if is_side_letter is true. MFN (Most Favoured Nation) clauses, co-investment rights, and fee discounts are common LP-negotiated side letter types.
attributes.references: ILPA Side Letter Guidance; LPA Standard

attributes.name: term_extension_years
attributes.description: Number of years by which the mandate or fund term is extended under this amendment. Populated when amendment_type is term_extension. Supports ALM and liquidity planning.

attributes.name: value_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for prior_value and revised_value (e.g., percentage for management fee rate, bps for spread, currency for hard cap). Enables correct interpretation of the change.
attributes.references: ILPA Principles; Internal Mandate Management Policy

products.name: manager_contact
products.description: Master record for key personnel at each external manager firm, including portfolio managers, investor relations contacts, compliance officers, and operations contacts.

attributes.name: manager_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a key personnel record at an external manager firm. Primary key for the manager_contact entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Internal employee ID of the pension fund staff member responsible for managing the relationship with this contact, used for accountability and coverage tracking.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external manager firm (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) that this contact is associated with. Links to the manager master record.

attributes.name: manager_firm_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external manager firm (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) that this contact is associated with. Links to the manager master record.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record, reflecting whether the individual is actively employed at the manager firm and available for engagement.

attributes.name: coverage_asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class covered by this contact within the external manager firm, aligning to the pension fund's asset allocation domains (e.g., private equity, infrastructure, credit).
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: coverage_strategy
attributes.description: Specific investment strategy or sub-strategy the contact oversees or represents (e.g., buyout, growth equity, core infrastructure, senior secured credit, value-add real estate).
attributes.references: Preqin Data Standard; PitchBook Contact Schema

attributes.name: data_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which data processing consent was obtained from this contact, used to track consent validity and trigger renewal workflows per GDPR and applicable privacy law requirements.

attributes.name: data_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consent for processing personal data has been obtained from this contact in jurisdictions where GDPR or equivalent privacy regulations apply.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and 7; applicable privacy law; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: date_joined_firm
attributes.description: Date the contact joined the external manager firm, used to calculate tenure and assess team stability as part of ongoing manager oversight and ODD.
attributes.references: third-party risk management guidance; Preqin Data Standard

attributes.name: departure_date

attributes.name: departure_reason

attributes.name: direct_phone

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has requested to be excluded from outreach, or has been flagged by compliance as restricted from contact due to regulatory or legal constraints.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CASL; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: educational_background
attributes.description: Summary of the contact's highest academic qualification and institution (e.g., MBA Harvard Business School), used in qualitative manager team assessment during ODD.
attributes.references: third-party risk management guidance; Preqin Data Standard

attributes.name: email

attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CASL; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the key personnel contact at the external manager firm, as recorded in Preqin, PitchBook, or direct firm communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: is_key_person
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated as a key person under the terms of an LPA or mandate agreement, triggering key-person event monitoring and notification obligations.
attributes.references: LPA Key Person Provisions; third-party risk management guidance; ILPA Principles

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is the designated primary point of contact for the pension fund's relationship with the external manager firm.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the contact at the external manager firm (e.g., Portfolio Manager, Chief Investment Officer, Investor Relations Director, Chief Compliance Officer).
attributes.references: Preqin Data Standard; PitchBook Contact Schema

attributes.name: key_person_mandate_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the LPA, SMA, or co-investment agreement in which this contact is named as a key person, enabling traceability to contractual key-person provisions.

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether KYC identity verification has been completed for this contact in accordance with AML/CTF obligations and FATF recommendations.

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which KYC verification was last completed for this contact, used to track compliance with AML/CTF refresh cycles and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; anti-money laundering guidance; the financial intelligence unit

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded interaction between the pension fund's team and this contact (e.g., LP advisory call, annual meeting, IC presentation), used for relationship health monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Relationship Management Standard; Dealpath/DealCloud CRM

attributes.name: last_interaction_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent recorded interaction with this contact, used to assess engagement quality and frequency as part of ongoing manager relationship management.
attributes.references: Internal Relationship Management Standard; Dealpath/DealCloud CRM

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name of the key personnel contact at the external manager firm, as recorded in Preqin, PitchBook, or direct firm communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn profile URL for the contact, used for background verification, professional history review during ODD, and ongoing key-person monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; third-party risk management guidance

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the contact in E.164 international format, used for time-sensitive communications such as capital call notices or NAV queries.

attributes.name: nda_expiry_date
