attributes.references: Internal Manager Domain SSOT; LPA / SMA Contractual Terms

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific SLA obligation that was breached, including the contractual clause reference and expected deliverable.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the contractual penalty or fee reduction applied as a result of this breach, denominated in the mandate currency. Null if no penalty triggered.
attributes.references: LPA / SMA Contractual Terms; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty amount. Aligns with the mandate base currency.

attributes.name: prior_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of prior breach events recorded for the same SLA obligation and manager within the current mandate term, used for escalation threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Risk and Oversight Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which this breach must be reported, if applicable. Populated only when is_regulatory_reportable is true.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; SEC; FCA; ESMA; IOSCO

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the breach was formally reported to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if not yet reported or not required.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Supervisory Guidance; FCA SYSC Rules; SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan agreed with the manager to address the breach, prevent recurrence, and restore SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; Pension regulator Supervisory Guidance

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Agreed target date by which the manager is expected to complete the remediation plan and restore full SLA compliance.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the breach was formally resolved, remediated, or waived. Null if the breach remains open or in progress.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause of the breach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: system_failure|process_failure|data_error|staffing|third_party|regulatory_change|force_majeure|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Operational Risk Framework; Pension regulator Operational Risk Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the root cause analysis conducted by the manager or internal oversight team explaining why the SLA obligation was not met.
attributes.references: Internal Operational Risk Framework; Pension regulator Operational Risk Guidance

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: Categorical severity rating assigned to the breach based on its impact on fund operations, regulatory obligations, or beneficiary interests.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Risk and Oversight Framework; Pension regulator Supervisory Guidance

attributes.name: sla_obligation_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date by which the manager was required to fulfil the SLA obligation that was subsequently breached.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this SLA breach record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: waiver_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the waiver of the breach was formally approved by the authorised internal governance body. Null if no waiver granted.

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification for waiving the breach without penalty or escalation, including approver details. Populated only when breach_status is waived.
attributes.references: Internal Governance and Compliance Standard; LPA / SMA Contractual Terms

products.name: watchlist
products.description: Tracks external managers placed on formal internal watch-list status due to performance concerns, key-man departures, regulatory investigations, ODD findings, or strategic misalignment.
products.reference: Manager Watch List / At-Risk Manager Register

attributes.name: watchlist_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a manager watchlist record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager or General Partner (GP) placed on the watchlist. Links to the manager master record.

attributes.name: manager_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager or General Partner (GP) placed on the watchlist. Links to the manager master record.

attributes.name: manager_mandate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific mandate (LPA, SMA, co-investment agreement) associated with this watchlist entry, if applicable.

attributes.name: approving_officer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the senior officer (e.g., CIO, Head of External Managers) who formally approved the watchlist placement decision.
attributes.references: Internal IC Governance Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The primary asset class of the manager's mandate under watchlist review. Enables asset-class-level watchlist analytics and risk aggregation.
attributes.references: Internal Asset Allocation Framework; eFront; SimCorp Dimension

attributes.name: aum_at_placement
attributes.description: The pension fund's total committed or invested capital with this manager (AUM) at the time of watchlist placement, in base currency. Used to assess financial exposure.
attributes.references: Internal Portfolio Accounting; SimCorp Dimension; eFront

attributes.name: aum_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the AUM at placement amount (e.g., USD, GBP).

attributes.name: watchlist_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the reason for watchlist placement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: performance|key_man|regulatory|odd_finding|strategic_misalignment|esg_concern|fee_dispute|legal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal ODD Policy; PRI Principles; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: consecutive_underperformance_quarters
attributes.description: Number of consecutive calendar quarters in which the manager has underperformed their agreed benchmark or hurdle rate, as recorded at the time of watchlist placement.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; Internal Performance Attribution Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this watchlist record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: engagement_log_summary
attributes.description: Summary of formal engagement activities with the manager since watchlist placement, including calls, meetings, and written correspondence. Full log maintained in DealCloud.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; Dealpath / DealCloud

attributes.name: esg_concern_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Concern Category
attributes.description: Classifies the ESG dimension driving the concern: environmental (E), social (S), governance (G), or a combination. Populated when esg_concern_flag is true.
attributes.references: PRI Principles for Responsible Investment; TCFD; SFDR

tag_set.value: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Concern Category

attributes.name: esg_concern_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Concern Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESG-related concerns (e.g., governance failures, environmental violations, social controversies) contributed to the watchlist placement.
attributes.references: PRI Principles for Responsible Investment; TCFD; SFDR; Internal ESG Policy

tag_set.value: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Concern Flag

attributes.name: ic_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal Investment Committee (IC) approval is required to resolve or close this watchlist entry, based on AUM exposure or severity level.
attributes.references: Internal IC Governance Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect

attributes.name: ic_decision
attributes.description: The formal decision recorded by the Investment Committee (IC) following review of the watchlist entry. Drives downstream mandate management actions.
attributes.references: Internal IC Governance Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect

attributes.name: ic_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Investment Committee (IC) formally reviewed this watchlist entry and issued a decision or deferred for further monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal IC Governance Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect

attributes.name: key_man_clause_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formal key-man clause in the Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA) or mandate has been contractually triggered, potentially suspending capital calls or enabling early redemption.
attributes.references: LPA Key-Man Clause; ISDA; Internal Legal Policy

attributes.name: key_man_departure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the watchlist placement was triggered by the departure or announced departure of a key investment professional covered under a key-man clause in the LPA or mandate agreement.
attributes.references: LPA Key-Man Clause; Internal ODD Policy

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal review of this watchlist entry, used to track review cadence compliance and identify overdue reviews.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this watchlist record, supporting audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: lead_analyst
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the internal investment analyst or portfolio manager responsible for monitoring and reporting on this watchlist entry.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: manager_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external manager formally responded to the watchlist notification. Populated when manager_response_received is true.

attributes.name: manager_response_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the external manager has formally responded to the watchlist notification and provided a remediation plan or explanation.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; Internal ODD Policy

attributes.name: manager_strategy
attributes.description: The specific investment strategy employed by the manager under the mandate (e.g., buyout, venture capital, core real estate, direct lending, long/short equity, infrastructure core-plus).
attributes.references: Preqin; PitchBook; eFront; Internal Manager Database

attributes.name: new_capital_deployment_suspended
attributes.description: Indicates whether new capital commitments or capital calls to this manager have been suspended as a result of the watchlist placement, pending resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; LPA; Internal IC Governance Policy

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled formal review of this watchlist entry by the internal manager oversight or risk team.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: odd_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a material finding from an Operational Due Diligence (ODD) review contributed to the watchlist placement, such as control failures, valuation concerns, or compliance gaps.
attributes.references: Internal ODD Policy; IOSCO Principles for Hedge Fund Oversight

attributes.name: odd_finding_summary
attributes.description: Concise summary of the material ODD findings that contributed to watchlist placement. Classified confidential due to sensitive operational assessment content.
attributes.references: Internal ODD Policy; IOSCO Principles for Hedge Fund Oversight

attributes.name: performance_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether underperformance relative to benchmark or hurdle rate is a contributing factor to the watchlist placement. Enables performance-driven watchlist analytics.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; Internal Performance Attribution Policy

attributes.name: placement_date
attributes.description: The formal date on which the manager was officially placed on the internal watchlist following Investment Committee or risk team approval.
attributes.references: model risk management guidance; Internal IC Governance Policy

attributes.name: portfolio_exposure_pct
attributes.description: The pension fund's exposure to this manager as a percentage of total fund AUM at the time of watchlist placement. Used for concentration risk assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Policy; model risk management guidance; BlackRock Aladdin

attributes.name: redemption_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal redemption or withdrawal notice was issued to the manager. Populated when redemption_notice_issued is true.

attributes.name: redemption_notice_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal redemption or withdrawal notice has been issued to the manager as a result of the watchlist review process.
attributes.references: LPA; Internal Legal Policy; Internal IC Governance Policy

attributes.name: reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this watchlist entry for cross-system referencing and audit trail purposes (e.g., WL-2024-000123).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority conducting the investigation or enforcement action against the manager (e.g., SEC, FCA, ESMA). Populated when regulatory_investigation_flag is true.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; SEC; FCA; ESMA; IOSCO

attributes.name: regulatory_investigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manager is subject to an active regulatory investigation by a governing body (e.g., SEC, FCA) that contributed to watchlist placement.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator; SEC; FCA; ESMA; IOSCO

attributes.name: remediation_plan_agreed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal remediation plan has been agreed between the pension fund and the external manager to address the watchlist concerns.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: remediation_plan_deadline
attributes.description: The agreed deadline by which the manager must demonstrate completion of remediation actions. Populated when remediation_plan_agreed is true.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the watchlist entry was formally resolved or closed, either through remediation, redemption, or termination of the mandate.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: The formal outcome decision upon closure of the watchlist entry. Indicates whether the manager relationship was retained, redeemed, or terminated following review.
attributes.references: Internal IC Governance Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency of formal internal review for this watchlist entry, determined by severity level and asset class. Drives the monitoring calendar.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Internal risk severity rating assigned to the watchlist entry, reflecting the urgency and potential impact on the pension fund portfolio. Drives escalation and review frequency.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Rating Framework; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: strategic_misalignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the watchlist placement is driven by a strategic misalignment between the manager's investment approach and the pension fund's evolving Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) or mandate objectives.
attributes.references: Internal SAA Policy; Internal Manager Selection Framework

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the watchlist concerns are expected to be resolved or a formal decision (retain, redeem, terminate) is required from the Investment Committee.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect IC Governance

attributes.name: trigger_date
attributes.description: The date on which the triggering event or finding occurred that led to watchlist placement. Distinct from the formal placement date.

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific event or finding that triggered placement of the manager on the watchlist (e.g., lead PM departure, SEC investigation opened, consecutive quarters of underperformance).
attributes.references: Internal Investment Risk Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: watchlist_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the watchlist entry. Active indicates ongoing monitoring; resolved indicates concerns addressed; closed indicates formal removal from watchlist.
attributes.references: model risk management guidance; Internal Investment Risk Policy

products.name: meeting
products.description: Records all formal interactions with external managers including annual reviews, quarterly update calls, on-site due diligence visits, LPAC meetings, and ad-hoc escalation meetings.
products.reference: Manager Interaction Log / GP Meeting Record

attributes.name: meeting_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each formal manager interaction record within the external manager oversight domain.

attributes.name: deal_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deal pipeline record if this meeting is linked to an active origination or due diligence process.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal investment professional (portfolio manager, analyst, or relationship manager) who led or organised this meeting on behalf of the pension fund.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) who is the primary subject of this meeting.

attributes.name: ic_governance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ic_governance_record. Business justification: IC meetings discussing managers (evaluations, mandate approvals) must link to formal IC governance records.

attributes.name: manager_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (GP, sub-advisor, or FoF manager) who is the primary subject of this meeting.

attributes.name: manager_mandate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific investment mandate (LPA, SMA, or co-investment agreement) that this meeting is associated with, if applicable.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deal pipeline record if this meeting is linked to an active origination or due diligence process.

attributes.name: action_items_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal action items or follow-up tasks recorded as outcomes of this meeting. Supports SLA and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the meeting actually took place. May differ from scheduled_date if rescheduled.

attributes.name: agenda_summary
attributes.description: Structured summary of the agenda items discussed, including key topics such as performance attribution, risk review, ESG updates, and operational matters.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class context of the meeting (e.g., private equity, real estate, infrastructure, credit, public equities). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: private_equity|real_estate|infrastructure|natural_resources|credit|public_equities|multi_asset|fund_of_funds —
attributes.references: Pension regulator Regulatory Reporting; CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meeting record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: dd_type
attributes.description: Type of due diligence conducted during or associated with this meeting: ODD (Operational), FDD (Financial), CDD (Commercial), ESG DD, Legal DD, or not applicable.
attributes.references: model risk management guidance; CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed duration of the meeting in minutes as recorded by the meeting organiser. Supports SLA monitoring and engagement analytics.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the meeting concluded, including timezone offset. Used alongside start_timestamp to derive meeting duration.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether issues raised in this meeting require escalation to the Investment Committee (IC) or senior management for further review or decision.
attributes.references: Internal IC Policy; Diligent / BoardEffect Governance Platform

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for escalation to the IC or senior management, if escalation_flag is true. Null if no escalation is required.
attributes.references: Internal IC Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: esg_topics_discussed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) topics were formally discussed during the meeting, supporting PRI and TCFD stewardship reporting.
attributes.references: PRI Reporting Framework; TCFD Recommendations; SFDR Article 8/9

attributes.name: esg_topics_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of ESG-related topics discussed, including climate risk, GHG targets, governance concerns, or social impact matters raised during the meeting.
attributes.references: PRI Reporting Framework; TCFD Recommendations; SFDR

attributes.name: external_attendee_count
attributes.description: Number of external manager representatives (GP principals, IR staff, portfolio managers) who attended the meeting.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Delivery format of the meeting: in-person, video conference, telephone, or hybrid. Relevant for travel cost attribution and engagement quality assessment.

attributes.name: ic_member_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a member of the internal Investment Committee (IC) attended this meeting, relevant for governance and escalation tracking.
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect Governance Platform; Internal IC Policy

attributes.name: internal_attendee_count
attributes.description: Number of internal pension fund staff members who attended the meeting. Used for engagement intensity and resource utilisation reporting.

attributes.name: key_risks_identified
attributes.description: Narrative summary of material risks identified during the meeting, including operational, market, liquidity, counterparty, or ESG risks flagged by either party.
attributes.references: model risk management guidance; Basel Committee Risk Principles

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City where the in-person or hybrid meeting took place (e.g., London, New York, Singapore). Null for fully remote meetings.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction where the meeting physically occurred (e.g., GBR, USA, CAN). Null for fully remote meetings.

attributes.name: location_venue
attributes.description: Name of the specific venue, office, or facility where the meeting was held (e.g., manager HQ, fund administrator office, pension fund offices).

attributes.name: manager_conviction_rating
attributes.description: Internal conviction rating assigned to the manager following this meeting: high, medium, low, or under review. Feeds into manager scoring and allocation decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; eFront Manager Monitoring

attributes.name: manager_senior_rep_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a senior representative (partner, CIO, or managing director) of the external manager was present. Relevant for escalation and governance quality assessment.

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the meeting record: scheduled, completed, cancelled, rescheduled, or pending minutes approval.

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal interaction: annual review, quarterly update call, on-site due diligence visit, LPAC meeting, ad-hoc escalation, or initial screening.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; PRI Reporting Framework

attributes.name: minutes_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formal meeting minutes have been reviewed and approved by the designated internal approver, completing the governance record.
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect Governance Platform; Internal IC Policy

attributes.name: minutes_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved. Null if minutes are pending or not yet approved.

attributes.name: minutes_document_ref
attributes.description: Document management system reference or URL pointing to the formal meeting minutes stored in the governance platform (e.g., Diligent / BoardEffect).
attributes.references: Diligent / BoardEffect Governance Platform; Pension regulator Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: next_meeting_date
attributes.description: Tentative or confirmed date for the next formal interaction with this manager, supporting engagement cadence planning and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: next_meeting_type
attributes.description: Anticipated type of the next scheduled meeting with this manager. Supports forward engagement planning and oversight cadence management.

attributes.name: open_action_items_count
attributes.description: Number of action items from this meeting that remain open or unresolved at the time of record update. Used for follow-up governance monitoring.

attributes.name: overall_sentiment
attributes.description: Internal qualitative assessment of the overall tone and outcome of the meeting: positive, neutral, negative, or cautionary. Supports manager scoring and watch-list decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; Preqin / PitchBook Manager Intelligence

attributes.name: performance_review_period
attributes.description: The reporting period covered in the performance discussion (e.g., Q3 2024, FY2023). Aligns with GIPS-compliant performance reporting cycles.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; Pension regulator Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Free-text description of the primary business objective of the meeting (e.g., annual ODD review, portfolio performance discussion, ESG integration assessment).
attributes.references: PRI Reporting Framework; CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric reference code assigned to this meeting, used in correspondence and governance records (e.g., MTG-2024-000123).

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the meeting was originally scheduled to occur, used for planning and SLA tracking purposes.

attributes.name: sla_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meeting was conducted within the required SLA engagement frequency for this manager tier (e.g., annual review within 12 months of prior).
attributes.references: Internal Manager Oversight Policy; model risk management guidance

attributes.name: source_system_ref_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this meeting record in the originating source system (e.g., DealCloud activity ID, eFront interaction ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the meeting commenced, including timezone offset. Used for duration calculation and audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this meeting record in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: The vintage year of the fund or mandate under discussion, representing the year of initial capital commitment. Key context for private markets performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS; Preqin / PitchBook Manager Intelligence

attributes.name: watch_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this meeting resulted in the manager being placed on or remaining on the internal watch list due to performance, operational, or ESG concerns.
attributes.references: model risk management guidance; Internal Manager Oversight Policy

products.name: co_invest_right
products.description: Master record of co-investment rights negotiated within each LP mandate, specifying the co-investment allocation right (percentage or dollar cap), notice period for co-invest opportunities, approval process, exclusivity window, and historical utilization.

attributes.name: co_invest_right_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a co-investment right record negotiated within an LP mandate. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific GP fund vehicle (e.g., private equity fund, infrastructure fund) within which this co-investment right is embedded.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (General Partner) who granted this co-investment right. Sourced from the manager master record in Preqin/PitchBook.

attributes.name: ic_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ic_decision. Business justification: Co-investment right exercise requires IC approval per fiduciary governance. Links co-invest rights to IC decisions that approved/modified them.

attributes.name: manager_gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external fund manager (General Partner) who granted this co-investment right. Sourced from the manager master record in Preqin/PitchBook.

attributes.name: manager_mandate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the LP mandate (LPA or SMA) under which this co-investment right was negotiated. Links to the parent mandate record in the manager domain.

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the co-investment allocation right is measured: as a percentage of deal size, percentage of LP commitment, a fixed dollar cap, or uncapped.

attributes.name: allocation_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the pension fund may invest per co-investment opportunity under this right. Applicable when allocation_basis is fixed_dollar_cap. Expressed in the mandate currency.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of each co-investment opportunity the pension fund is entitled to receive under this right. Applicable when allocation_basis is percentage-based. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%).

attributes.name: annual_utilization_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate amount (in mandate currency) the pension fund may deploy under this co-investment right within a single calendar or fiscal year.
attributes.references: LPA Side-Letter; Internal Portfolio Limits Policy

attributes.name: approval_process_type
attributes.description: Internal approval process required to exercise this co-investment right: Investment Committee (IC) approval, delegated authority, CIO approval, or committee approval.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class to which this co-investment right applies, aligned with the pension fund's SAA framework (e.g., private equity, infrastructure, real estate).

attributes.name: carry_rate
attributes.description: Carried interest (carry) rate applicable to co-investments under this right, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 = 20%). Zero for no-carry structures.

attributes.name: confidentiality_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terms of this co-investment right are subject to confidentiality obligations under the LPA or NDA, restricting disclosure to third parties.
attributes.references: LPA; NDA; GDPR Article 5; Internal Information Security Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this co-investment right record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
attributes.references: SOC 2; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary fields on this co-investment right (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: decision_deadline_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days within which the pension fund must communicate its investment decision (accept or decline) after receiving a co-investment opportunity notice from the GP.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this co-investment right becomes binding and exercisable, as stipulated in the LPA or side-letter agreement.

attributes.name: esg_screening_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether co-investment opportunities under this right must pass the pension fund's ESG screening and responsible investment assessment prior to acceptance.
attributes.references: PRI Principles for Responsible Investment; TCFD; Internal ESG Policy

attributes.name: exclusivity_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an exclusivity window applies to this co-investment right, preventing the GP from offering the same opportunity to other LPs during the pension fund's review period.

attributes.name: exclusivity_window_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the pension fund has exclusive right to evaluate and accept or decline a co-investment opportunity before the GP may offer it to other LPs.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this co-investment right expires or lapses. Null for rights that persist for the full fund term. Aligned with fund investment period end.

attributes.name: fee_structure_type
attributes.description: Fee and carried interest structure applicable to co-investments under this right. Common structures include no-fee/no-carry (preferred), reduced fee/no carry, or full fee/full carry.

attributes.name: geographic_focus
attributes.description: Geographic scope or region for which this co-investment right applies (e.g., North America, Global, Europe). Free-text to accommodate multi-region mandates.

attributes.name: hurdle_rate

attributes.name: last_calibration_date

attributes.name: limitations

attributes.name: lookback_window_days
attributes.description: Number of historical days used for model calibration and calculation.

attributes.name: methodology_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the model methodology, assumptions, and calculation approach.

attributes.name: model_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk model.

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quantitative risk model methodology.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, GIPS

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the risk model.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal model review and validation by the model governance committee.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about the model for operational or audit purposes.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or individual responsible for the model.

attributes.name: regulatory_approved_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_framework

attributes.references: the national pension regulator, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, EMIR

attributes.name: risk_measure
attributes.description: Primary risk metric calculated by this model (VaR = Value at Risk, CVaR = Conditional Value at Risk, DV01 = Dollar Value of 01).

attributes.name: simulation_count
attributes.description: Number of Monte Carlo simulations or scenarios executed per model run; applicable to Monte Carlo and scenario-based models.

attributes.name: stress_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the model is used for macroeconomic stress testing and scenario analysis.
attributes.references: FSB, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the model record was last modified.

attributes.name: vendor
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or system providing the model (e.g., BlackRock Aladdin, MSCI RiskMetrics, Barra, internal proprietary).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the model implementation for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stress scenario. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: Stress scenario approval is required for regulatory stress testing (ORSA, IORP II). Pension funds must document which employee approved each scenario for audit purposes.

attributes.name: climate_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esg.climate_scenario. Business justification: TCFD-mandated climate stress testing requires pension funds to apply standardized climate scenarios (RCP/SSP pathways) to financial stress tests.

attributes.name: economic_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.economic_scenario. Business justification: Pension fund stress testing requires linking risk stress scenarios to research economic scenarios.

attributes.name: macro_indicator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the macroeconomic indicator being shocked

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_authority. Business justification: Pension fund stress scenarios are mandated by specific regulators (PRA, EIOPA, local pension authorities). The regulatory_source field indicates this need.

attributes.name: superseded_by_scenario_stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stress scenario that supersedes this one if deprecated. Null if current.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the scenario was formally approved for use in stress testing.

attributes.name: asset_class_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes covered by this scenario (e.g., public equities, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, credit, natural resources).

attributes.name: commodity_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in commodity prices (e.g., oil, natural gas, metals). Positive for price increases, negative for decreases.

attributes.name: counterparty_default_rate_percent
attributes.description: Assumed percentage of counterparties that default under the scenario.
attributes.references: ISDA Credit Risk Framework, Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stress scenario record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_spread_shock_bps
attributes.description: Widening or tightening of credit spreads in basis points (bps). Positive for widening, negative for tightening.
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics Credit Models, Bloomberg Fixed Income Analytics

attributes.name: cvar_confidence_level_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) Confidence Level Percentage
attributes.description: Confidence level used for CVaR (Expected Shortfall) calculations under this scenario (e.g., 95.00, 99.00). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Basel III Market Risk Framework, MSCI RiskMetrics

tag_set.value: Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) Confidence Level Percentage

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this shock parameter specification is effective. Allows versioning of shock assumptions over time. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: equity_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change applied to equity markets in this scenario (e.g., -40.0000 for 40% decline). Positive for gains, negative for losses.
attributes.references: MSCI Barra Factor Models, BlackRock Aladdin

attributes.name: external_scenario_code
attributes.description: Identifier used by the external vendor or regulatory body for this scenario. Null for internal scenarios.
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics, BlackRock Aladdin, Regulatory Reporting Standards

attributes.name: fx_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in foreign exchange rates (e.g., domestic currency depreciation or appreciation). Positive for appreciation, negative for depreciation.
attributes.references: ISDA FX Risk Framework, Bloomberg Terminal

attributes.name: gdp_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in GDP growth rate under the scenario (e.g., -5.0000 for 5% contraction).
attributes.references: OECD Macroeconomic Models, Internal Macro Research

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries affected by the scenario (e.g., Global, North America, Europe, Emerging Markets). Use 3-letter ISO country codes where applicable.

attributes.name: historical_event_date
attributes.description: Date of the historical event if the scenario is based on a past crisis (e.g., 2008-09-15 for Lehman collapse). Null for hypothetical scenarios.

attributes.name: indicator_weight
attributes.description: Relative weight or importance of this indicator's shock in the overall scenario impact calculation. Used for weighted stress metrics. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: inflation_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage point change in inflation rate (e.g., +3.0000 for 3 percentage point increase in inflation).
attributes.references: Central Bank Models, OECD Inflation Forecasts

attributes.name: interest_rate_shock_bps
attributes.description: Parallel shift in interest rates expressed in basis points (bps). Positive for rate increases, negative for decreases (e.g., +300 for 3% hike).
attributes.references: ISDA Interest Rate Risk Framework, BlackRock Aladdin

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a baseline (no-stress) scenario used for comparison. True if baseline, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this scenario is mandated by a regulatory authority. True if required, False if discretionary.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Stress Testing Guidelines, EBA Stress Test Methodology

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the scenario was last reviewed for relevance and accuracy.

attributes.name: liquidity_shock_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of liquidity stress conditions (e.g., bid-ask spreads widen 10x, redemption surge 20%, funding markets freeze).
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) Liquidity Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified the stress scenario record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stress scenario record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of the scenario.

attributes.name: probability_assessment
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the likelihood of the scenario occurring: very low, low, medium, high, very high, or not assessed.

attributes.name: real_estate_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in real estate valuations. Positive for appreciation, negative for depreciation.
attributes.references: MSCI Real Estate Indices, Internal Valuation Models

attributes.name: recovery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Assumed recovery rate on defaulted exposures (e.g., 40.0000 for 40% recovery).
attributes.references: Basel III Advanced Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach

attributes.name: regulatory_source
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or framework that mandated this scenario (e.g., EBA, CCAR). Null for internal scenarios.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Stress Testing Guidelines, EBA Stress Test Methodology, Federal Reserve CCAR

attributes.name: scenario_category
attributes.description: Broad category of the stress event: market shock, credit event, liquidity crisis, macroeconomic downturn, geopolitical, operational, climate, pandemic, or cyber.
attributes.references: FSB Stress Testing Principles, TCFD Climate Scenario Analysis

attributes.name: scenario_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the stress scenario (e.g., GFC_2008, COVID_SHOCK, RATE_HIKE_300).
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics, BlackRock Aladdin Scenario Library

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the stress scenario (e.g., 2008 Global Financial Crisis, COVID-19 Market Shock, Oil Price Collapse).
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics, BlackRock Aladdin Scenario Library

attributes.name: scenario_narrative
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scenario storyline, including macroeconomic context, triggering events, and transmission channels.
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics, BlackRock Aladdin Scenario Documentation

attributes.name: scenario_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stress scenario: draft (under development), active (approved for use), archived (historical reference), deprecated (no longer used), or under review (pending approval).

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stress scenario: historical (actual past event), hypothetical (plausible future event), regulatory (mandated by regulator), custom (bespoke internal), or reverse stress (identifies breaking point).
attributes.references: Basel Committee Stress Testing Principles Stress Testing Guidelines

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Qualitative severity classification of the stress scenario: mild, moderate, severe, or extreme.
attributes.references: Basel III Stress Testing Framework Guidelines

attributes.name: shock_direction
attributes.description: Direction of the shock: increase (positive shock), decrease (negative shock), or unchanged (indicator held constant). Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: shock_magnitude
attributes.description: The magnitude of the shock applied to this indicator in this scenario, expressed in the indicator's native unit (percent, basis points, index points). Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: shock_magnitude_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the magnitude and nature of the stress shock (e.g., equity markets down 40%, credit spreads widen 500 bps, GDP contracts 5%).
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics, BlackRock Aladdin Scenario Documentation

attributes.name: time_horizon_months
attributes.description: Duration over which the stress scenario unfolds, expressed in months (e.g., 3, 6, 12, 24).

attributes.name: unemployment_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage point change in unemployment rate (e.g., +5.0000 for 5 percentage point increase).
attributes.references: OECD Labour Market Statistics, Internal Macro Research

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this scenario has been used in stress testing runs. Incremented with each execution.

attributes.name: var_confidence_level_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value at Risk (VaR) Confidence Level Percentage
attributes.description: Confidence level used for VaR calculations under this scenario (e.g., 95.00, 99.00). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Basel III Market Risk Framework, MSCI RiskMetrics

tag_set.value: Value at Risk (VaR) Confidence Level Percentage

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the scenario (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented when scenario parameters are updated.

attributes.name: volatility_shock_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in market volatility (e.g., VIX increase). Positive for volatility spike, negative for compression.
attributes.references: CBOE VIX Index, MSCI Barra Risk Models

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the stress scenario record.

products.name: var_calculation
products.description: Transactional record of each Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) calculation run performed against a portfolio or position set. Captures calculation date, portfolio scope, risk model used, confidence level (95%, 99%), holding period
products.reference: VaR / CVaR — Basel / Pension regulator Market Risk Capital

attributes.name: var_calculation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each VaR calculation run. Primary key for the var_calculation product.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: VaR calculations require approval sign-off for regulatory capital reporting. Pension funds must track approver for daily risk reporting governance and IC oversight.

attributes.name: calculation_run_id
attributes.description: Business identifier for the calculation batch or run, used for grouping related VaR calculations executed together.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio or position set against which this VaR calculation was performed.

attributes.name: risk_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the risk model configuration used for this VaR calculation, defining methodology and parameters.
attributes.references: MSCI RiskMetrics and Barra Risk Model Standards

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific stress test or market scenario applied during the VaR calculation, if applicable.
attributes.references: FSB - Financial Stability Board Stress Testing Principles

attributes.name: valuation_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.cycle. Business justification: VaR calculations must reference the valuation cycle ensuring risk metrics use consistent, audited asset values.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the VaR calculation result was formally approved for reporting and decision-making purposes.

attributes.name: asset_class_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes included in this VaR calculation, such as equities, fixed income, FX, commodities, alternatives.

attributes.name: backtesting_exceptions
attributes.description: Number of times actual losses exceeded the VaR estimate during the backtesting period, used to assess model accuracy.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: backtesting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the backtesting period used to validate the VaR model accuracy against actual portfolio returns.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: backtesting_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the backtesting period used to validate the VaR model accuracy against actual portfolio returns.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this VaR calculation was performed, representing the as-of date for the risk assessment.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: calculation_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time taken to complete the VaR calculation, measured in seconds, used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: calculation_engine
attributes.description: Name of the risk analytics platform or engine that performed the calculation, such as BlackRock Aladdin or MSCI RiskMetrics.

attributes.name: calculation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special circumstances, assumptions, or observations related to this VaR calculation.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the VaR calculation run, indicating whether it completed successfully or encountered issues.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the VaR calculation was executed, capturing the exact moment of computation.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level for the VaR calculation expressed as a decimal, typically 0.9500 for 95% or 0.9900 for 99%.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: correlation_matrix_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the correlation matrix used in parametric VaR calculations, tracking model updates over time.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VaR calculation record was first created in the system, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: cvar_amount
attributes.description: The calculated CVaR or Expected Shortfall, representing the expected loss given that the loss exceeds the VaR threshold.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score from 0 to 100 indicating the completeness and reliability of market data used in the VaR calculation.

attributes.name: decomposition_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed risk factor decomposition or contribution analysis is available for this VaR calculation.

attributes.name: diversification_benefit
attributes.description: Reduction in VaR due to portfolio diversification, calculated as the difference between sum of individual VaRs and portfolio VaR.

attributes.name: historical_lookback_days
attributes.description: Number of historical days of market data used in the VaR calculation, typically 250 to 500 trading days.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: holding_period_days
attributes.description: The time horizon in days over which the VaR is calculated, representing the period the portfolio is assumed to be held.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: incremental_risk_charge
attributes.description: Additional capital charge for default and migration risk in the trading book, complementing VaR measures.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: liquidity_horizon_days
attributes.description: Estimated time in days required to liquidate the portfolio positions without significant market impact, used for liquidity-adjusted VaR.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: market_data_source
attributes.description: Primary source of market data used for the VaR calculation, such as Bloomberg, Reuters, or internal pricing systems.

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: The statistical methodology applied for VaR calculation: historical simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, parametric, or hybrid approach.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VaR calculation record was last modified, tracking any updates or corrections to the calculation.

attributes.name: portfolio_value
attributes.description: The total market value of the portfolio at the calculation date, serving as the base for VaR percentage calculations.

attributes.name: position_count
attributes.description: Total number of positions or securities included in the portfolio for this VaR calculation.

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to VaR for regulatory capital calculation purposes, typically ranging from 3.0 to 4.0 based on backtesting results.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: risk_factor_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct risk factors or market variables considered in the VaR model, such as equity indices, interest rates, FX rates.

attributes.name: simulation_iterations
attributes.description: Number of simulation paths or iterations used in Monte Carlo VaR calculations, typically 10,000 or more.

attributes.name: stress_var_amount
attributes.description: VaR calculated using a stressed historical period, typically a 12-month period of significant financial stress.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: var_amount
attributes.description: The calculated VaR amount representing the maximum expected loss at the specified confidence level over the holding period.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: var_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the VaR amount is denominated.

attributes.name: var_percentage
attributes.description: VaR amount expressed as a percentage of total portfolio value, calculated as VaR amount divided by portfolio value.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: volatility_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Scaling factor applied to historical volatility estimates to account for current market conditions or regime changes.

products.name: risk_factor_exposure
products.description: Transactional record of a portfolio's or security's exposure to each systematic risk factor at a point in time, as computed by the risk model (MSCI Barra or BlackRock Aladdin).

attributes.name: risk_factor_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk factor exposure record. Primary key for this transactional snapshot of factor exposure at a point in time.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: Factor exposure approvals are required for governance. Pension funds must track who approved material factor exposures for risk committee oversight.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.instrument. Business justification: Factor risk models decompose returns at instrument level. Pension funds use Barra/Axioma models requiring instrument-to-factor mappings for risk attribution, tracking error analysis, and

attributes.name: listed_security_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual security for which this factor exposure is calculated. Nullable when exposure is at portfolio level only.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the portfolio for which this factor exposure is calculated. Links to the investment portfolio master.

attributes.name: risk_factor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the systematic risk factor to which exposure is measured (e.g., market factor, size factor, value factor, momentum, sector, country, currency).

attributes.name: risk_model_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the risk model used to compute this factor exposure (e.g., MSCI Barra Global Equity Model, BlackRock Aladdin Fixed Income Model).

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the stress test scenario applied to this factor exposure. Nullable for baseline (non-stressed) exposures.

attributes.name: active_exposure
attributes.description: The difference between the portfolios factor exposure and the benchmark factor exposure. Measures active risk positioning.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of this factor exposure record, particularly relevant when exposures breach limits and require IC or CRO approval.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this factor exposure or limit override was approved. Nullable for non-breach exposures.

attributes.name: as_of_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this factor exposure snapshot is calculated. Represents the valuation date of the underlying positions.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 base currency code of the portfolio for currency conversion and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: benchmark_exposure
attributes.description: The factor exposure of the portfolios benchmark index. Used to calculate active exposure and tracking error contribution.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The statistical method used to compute the factor exposure: regression, covariance matrix, Monte Carlo simulation, or historical analysis.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this factor exposure was computed by the risk system. Supports audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from risk analysts regarding this factor exposure, limit breach rationale, or model adjustments.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The confidence level associated with the factor exposure estimate, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00, 99.00).

attributes.name: contribution_to_risk_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of total portfolio risk attributable to this factor exposure. Sum across all factors equals 100%.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this risk factor exposure record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cvar_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this factor exposure to the portfolios Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR or Expected Shortfall), in base currency.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A quality score (0-100) indicating the completeness and reliability of the input data used for this exposure calculation.

attributes.name: exposure_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the exposure value is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: exposure_direction
attributes.description: The directional bias of the factor exposure: long (positive exposure), short (negative exposure), or neutral (near-zero exposure).

attributes.name: exposure_percentage
attributes.description: The factor exposure expressed as a percentage of total portfolio risk or NAV. Facilitates relative comparison across factors.

attributes.name: exposure_value
attributes.description: The numerical exposure of the portfolio or security to this risk factor. Typically expressed as a standardized beta or factor loading.

attributes.name: factor_category
attributes.description: The high-level category of the risk factor: style (value, growth, momentum), industry, country, currency, macro (interest rate, inflation), or custom.

attributes.name: factor_return
attributes.description: The return of the risk factor itself over the measurement period. Used to compute factor-driven performance attribution.

attributes.name: factor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the factor as systematic (common across securities), idiosyncratic (security-specific), or specific (custom defined).

attributes.name: factor_volatility
attributes.description: The historical or implied volatility of the risk factor. Expressed as annualized standard deviation in percentage terms.

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert exposure from exposure currency to base currency as of the calculation date.

attributes.name: is_material_exposure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this factor exposure exceeds the materiality threshold defined in the risk policy (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: limit_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this factor exposure breaches the defined risk limit (True) or is within limits (False).

attributes.name: limit_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the risk limit consumed by this factor exposure. Values over 100% indicate a breach.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: The number of historical days used in the factor exposure calculation (e.g., 252 for one-year daily returns).

attributes.name: marginal_contribution_to_risk
attributes.description: The marginal contribution of this factor exposure to total portfolio risk (VaR or volatility). Measures incremental risk impact.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: The market value of the position (security or portfolio) underlying this factor exposure, in base currency.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the risk model used for this calculation (e.g., MSCI Barra GEM3, Aladdin v8.2). Supports model change tracking.

attributes.name: notional_value
attributes.description: The notional value of derivative positions contributing to this factor exposure. Relevant for futures, swaps, and options.

attributes.name: stressed_exposure_value
attributes.description: The factor exposure value under the applied stress scenario. Nullable for baseline exposures.

attributes.name: t_statistic
attributes.description: The statistical significance measure of the factor exposure. Values above 2.0 typically indicate statistically significant exposure.

attributes.name: tracking_error_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this factor exposure to the portfolios tracking error versus its benchmark, expressed in basis points.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this risk factor exposure record was last modified. Supports change tracking and version control.

attributes.name: var_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this factor exposure to the portfolios total Value at Risk (VaR), in base currency.
