attributes.name: base_var
attributes.description: Value at Risk of the portfolio before applying the stress scenario, in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stress test result breached any defined risk limits or thresholds (True if breach occurred, False otherwise).

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of any risk limit breach identified by the stress test result.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this stress test calculation. Stress tests are run periodically (daily, weekly, monthly) and results are point-in-time.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate the stress test results (e.g., historical simulation, Monte Carlo, parametric VaR, hybrid approach).

attributes.name: concentration_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score measuring portfolio concentration risk under the stress scenario (higher values indicate greater concentration).
attributes.references: IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level used in the stress test risk calculations (e.g., 0.9500 for 95%, 0.9900 for 99%).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: counterparty_exposure_change
attributes.description: Change in aggregate counterparty credit exposure resulting from the stress scenario, in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Counterparty Credit Risk

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stress test result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this stress test result (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effectiveness_under_stress
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the hedging relationship would remain effective under the stress scenario conditions, per IFRS 9 hedge accounting requirements. Determines if hedge accounting treatment could be maintained.

attributes.name: factor_contribution_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key risk factor contributions to the stressed P&L (e.g., equity factor, interest rate factor, credit spread factor).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market focus of the portfolio subjected to the stress test (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Global).

attributes.name: liquidity_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of days required to liquidate the stressed positions under the scenario conditions, reflecting liquidity risk.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Liquidity Risk Framework

attributes.name: market_value_base
attributes.description: The market value of the position in base currency at calculation date, before stress is applied.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the risk model or stress testing engine used to generate this result.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stress test result record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, observations, or context regarding the stress test result.

attributes.name: position_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the instrument held at calculation date. Required to calculate stressed P&L from per-unit impact.

attributes.name: rebalance_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stress scenario would cause the hedge ratio to breach the permitted band (min/max hedge ratio) and trigger a mandatory rebalancing event for this hedge program.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement, guideline, or framework that mandated this stress test (if applicable).
attributes.references: the national pension regulator, Basel Committee, FSB Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_scenario_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stress test was performed to satisfy a regulatory requirement (True) or for internal risk management purposes (False).

attributes.name: result_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stress test result was calculated and recorded.

attributes.name: risk_system_source
attributes.description: Source system that performed the stress test calculation (e.g., BlackRock Aladdin, MSCI RiskMetrics, MSCI Barra, SimCorp Dimension, internal proprietary system).

attributes.name: scenario_impact_amount
attributes.description: The calculated mark-to-market or P&L impact of applying this stress scenario to this hedge program, expressed in the fund's base currency. Positive values indicate gains, negative values indicate losses under the stress scenario.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Primary economic sector or industry classification of the portfolio holdings subjected to the stress test.

attributes.name: sensitivity
attributes.description: The sensitivity of this instrument to the scenario shocks. For equities this may be beta, for bonds duration/convexity, for derivatives delta/gamma. Captures how the instrument responds to the scenario factors.

attributes.name: shock_value
attributes.description: The specific shock value applied to this instrument under this scenario. May differ from scenario-level defaults based on instrument characteristics (e.g., sector-specific equity shocks, credit-rating-specific spread shocks).

attributes.name: stressed_cvar
attributes.description: Conditional Value at Risk (expected shortfall) of the portfolio after applying the stress scenario, in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: stressed_market_value
attributes.description: The market value of the position in base currency after applying the scenario stress shocks.

attributes.name: stressed_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value of the portfolio after applying the stress scenario, in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: stressed_pnl
attributes.description: The calculated profit and loss impact for this instrument under this scenario, expressed in base currency. Represents the contribution of this position to total portfolio stress loss.

attributes.name: stressed_pnl_absolute
attributes.description: Absolute change in portfolio value resulting from the stress scenario (stressed NAV minus base NAV), in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: FSB Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices

attributes.name: stressed_pnl_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in portfolio value resulting from the stress scenario, expressed as a decimal (e.g., -0.1250 for -12.50%).
attributes.references: FSB Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices

attributes.name: stressed_var
attributes.description: Value at Risk of the portfolio after applying the stress scenario, in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: test_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which this stress test was executed. Required for audit trail and regulatory reporting of when stress tests were performed.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this stress test record, tracking progression from execution through review and approval for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: time_horizon_days
attributes.description: Time horizon in days over which the stress scenario is applied (e.g., 1-day, 10-day, 30-day).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Stress Testing Principles

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: As-of date for the portfolio valuation used as the baseline for stress testing.

products.name: limit_breach
products.description: Transactional record of each risk limit breach event detected during daily or intraday risk monitoring. Captures the breached limit, breach date and time, breached metric value vs limit threshold, breach severity (warning, soft breach, hard breach)

attributes.name: limit_breach_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the limit breach event record.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: Breach acknowledgment must be traceable for escalation procedures. Pension funds require documented accountability for who acknowledged each limit breach per risk governance.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty associated with the breach, if applicable for counterparty risk limits.

attributes.name: limit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the risk limit that was breached.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio associated with the breach, if applicable.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rule. Business justification: When risk limit breaches have regulatory implications (regulatory_breach_flag=true), compliance must assess which regulatory rule was violated.

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment strategy associated with the breach, if applicable.

attributes.name: triggering_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.order. Business justification: Pre-trade compliance and breach remediation require linking breaches to triggering orders. Risk teams must identify which orders caused limit violations for regulatory reporting (AIFMD, UCITS)

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was formally acknowledged by risk management.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Asset class associated with the breach such as public equities, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, natural resources, or credit.

attributes.name: breach_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the breach event, used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: breach_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes that the breach persisted before returning to compliance or being remediated.

attributes.name: breach_magnitude
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the breached metric value and the limit threshold.

attributes.name: breach_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by which the metric exceeded the limit threshold, calculated as magnitude divided by threshold times 100.

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the breach severity level based on magnitude and risk impact.

attributes.name: breach_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the breach event in the remediation workflow.

attributes.name: breach_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the limit breach was first detected by the risk monitoring system.

attributes.name: breached_metric_value
attributes.description: Actual value of the risk metric at the time of breach detection.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level used in the risk calculation, typically expressed as a percentage such as 95% or 99%.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for monetary breach values.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was identified and logged by the risk system, may differ from breach timestamp if detected retrospectively.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level to which the breach was escalated based on severity and escalation procedures.

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach was escalated to higher authority or governance body.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market associated with the breach for regional concentration limits.

attributes.name: ic_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the breach was reviewed by the Investment Committee, if applicable.

attributes.name: ic_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the breach requires formal review by the Investment Committee based on severity and governance policy.

attributes.name: intraday_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the breach occurred during intraday monitoring versus end-of-day monitoring.

attributes.name: limit_threshold_value
attributes.description: The threshold value of the limit that was breached, captured at time of breach for audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breach record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the breach event, remediation, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated notification was sent to stakeholders upon breach detection.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when breach notification was sent to stakeholders.

attributes.name: regulatory_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the breach violates a regulatory requirement and requires regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator, SEC, FCA, ESMA Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory requirement or rule that was breached, if applicable.
attributes.references: the national pension regulator, SEC, FCA, ESMA Guidelines

attributes.name: remediated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the portfolio manager or trader who executed the remediation action.

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the remediation action taken to address the breach and return to compliance.

attributes.name: remediation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when remediation action was completed and the breach was resolved.

attributes.name: risk_metric_type
attributes.description: Type of risk metric that breached the limit such as Value at Risk (VaR), Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR), Dollar Value of 01 (DV01), concentration, or liquidity.

attributes.name: risk_system_source
attributes.description: Source risk system that detected and reported the breach such as BlackRock Aladdin, MSCI RiskMetrics, or Barra.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the breach such as market movement, operational error, model failure, or limit misconfiguration.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Industry sector or GICS classification associated with the breach for sector concentration limits.

attributes.name: time_horizon_days
attributes.description: Time horizon in days over which the risk metric was calculated, such as 1-day or 10-day VaR.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the breached metric, such as basis points, percentage, currency, or other risk metric units.

products.name: risk_counterparty_exposure
products.description: Transactional record of gross and net credit exposure to each counterparty across all OTC derivatives, repo agreements, securities lending, and unsettled trades.
products.reference: Counterparty Credit Risk — ISDA / EMIR / Basel

attributes.name: risk_counterparty_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each counterparty exposure record in the risk management system.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity to which this exposure applies.

attributes.name: csa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.csa. Business justification: CSA terms (thresholds, minimum transfer amounts) directly impact collateral-adjusted exposure calculations.

attributes.name: netting_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.netting_agreement. Business justification: Netting agreements directly reduce counterparty exposure through close-out netting. Pension fund risk teams must calculate net exposure using actual netting agreement terms.

attributes.name: otc_derivative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.otc_derivative. Business justification: Counterparty credit exposure calculations must link to underlying OTC derivatives for CVA/DVA computation, EMIR reporting, and ISDA CSA margin calculations.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio holding positions that contribute to this counterparty exposure.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stress test scenario under which this exposure was calculated, if applicable.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The asset class of the underlying instruments contributing to the counterparty exposure.

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exposure breaches any established counterparty credit limit or concentration threshold.

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: The severity classification of any limit breach associated with this counterparty exposure.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the counterparty credit exposure.

attributes.name: ccp_name
attributes.description: The name of the central counterparty clearing house if the exposure is centrally cleared.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exposure is centrally cleared through a CCP or remains bilateral.

attributes.name: collateral_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a collateral support agreement is in place with the counterparty.

attributes.name: collateral_agreement_type
attributes.description: The type of collateral support agreement governing margin and collateral exchange with the counterparty.

attributes.name: collateral_held_amount
attributes.description: The market value of collateral held from the counterparty to mitigate credit exposure, in base currency.

attributes.name: collateral_posted_amount
attributes.description: The market value of collateral posted to the counterparty, in base currency.

attributes.name: concentration_limit_utilization
attributes.description: The percentage of the counterparty concentration limit currently utilized by this exposure, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: counterparty_credit_rating
attributes.description: The external credit rating assigned to the counterparty by a recognized rating agency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this counterparty exposure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_valuation_adjustment
attributes.description: The market value adjustment to reflect counterparty credit risk in OTC derivative valuations.

attributes.name: debit_valuation_adjustment
attributes.description: The market value adjustment to reflect own credit risk in OTC derivative valuations.

attributes.name: effective_maturity_years
attributes.description: The effective maturity of the exposure in years, used in regulatory capital calculations.

attributes.name: expected_credit_loss
attributes.description: The probability-weighted estimate of credit losses over the expected life of the exposure, calculated as EAD × PD × LGD.

attributes.name: expected_exposure
attributes.description: The mean of the probability distribution of exposure at a future date, used in credit valuation adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: exposure_at_default
attributes.description: The estimated exposure amount at the time of counterparty default, used in regulatory capital calculations.

attributes.name: exposure_currency
attributes.description: The base currency in which all exposure amounts are denominated, using ISO 4217 three-letter code.

attributes.name: exposure_type
attributes.description: The category of transaction or instrument giving rise to the counterparty credit exposure.

attributes.name: gross_exposure_amount
attributes.description: The total gross credit exposure to the counterparty before netting and collateral adjustments, in base currency.

attributes.name: independent_amount
attributes.description: The fixed collateral amount required to be posted regardless of mark-to-market exposure, providing additional credit protection.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: The specific financial instrument type contributing to the exposure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Swap|Forward|Option|Future|Repo|Reverse Repo|Securities Loan|Other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: The internal credit rating assigned to the counterparty by the funds credit risk team.

attributes.name: lei
attributes.description: The 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier of the counterparty.

attributes.name: loss_given_default
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of exposure that would be lost in the event of counterparty default, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: margin_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The exposure threshold below which no collateral is required to be posted under the collateral agreement.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The weighted average maturity date of the instruments contributing to this counterparty exposure.

attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: The minimum collateral amount that must be transferred in any single margin call under the collateral agreement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this counterparty exposure record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: net_exposure_amount
attributes.description: The net credit exposure after netting and collateral adjustments, representing the residual credit risk, in base currency.

attributes.name: netting_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a legally enforceable netting agreement is in place with the counterparty.

attributes.name: netting_agreement_type
attributes.description: The type of master netting agreement governing the exposure relationship with the counterparty.

attributes.name: netting_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The reduction in exposure achieved through legally enforceable netting agreements, in base currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional commentary or context regarding this counterparty exposure record.

attributes.name: potential_future_exposure
attributes.description: The estimated maximum exposure that could arise in the future due to market movements, calculated using simulation models.

attributes.name: probability_of_default
attributes.description: The estimated likelihood that the counterparty will default within a one-year horizon, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: risk_weight
attributes.description: The regulatory risk weight applied to this exposure for capital adequacy calculations, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: risk_weighted_exposure
attributes.description: The exposure amount multiplied by the applicable risk weight, used in regulatory capital calculations.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this counterparty exposure was calculated and valued.

attributes.name: wrong_way_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exposure exhibits wrong-way risk, where exposure increases when counterparty creditworthiness deteriorates.

products.name: concentration_exposure
products.description: Transactional record of portfolio concentration risk measurements across multiple dimensions: single issuer, sector/industry, geography, asset class, currency, and counterparty.

attributes.name: concentration_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the concentration exposure measurement record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: Concentration exposure approvals require documented accountability for prudent person rule compliance. Pension funds track approvers for diversification governance.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.counterparty. Business justification: Counterparty concentration monitoring is critical for pension fund risk management.

attributes.name: credit_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.credit_rating. Business justification: Adds a foreign key to the credit_rating master table, removing the redundant credit_rating string column and enabling referential integrity and efficient joins.

attributes.name: gp_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manager.gp_profile. Business justification: Manager concentration limits require tracking total exposure to each GP across all mandates. Regulatory large exposure reporting and internal risk limits mandate GP-level aggregation.

attributes.name: limit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable concentration risk limit framework or threshold against which this exposure is monitored.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio being measured for concentration risk.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to a macroeconomic stress scenario under which this concentration exposure was calculated, null for base case measurements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which an exception or remediation plan for a concentration breach was formally approved by risk governance authority.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The asset class category when concentration dimension is asset class: public equities, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, natural resources, credit, or fixed income.

attributes.name: breach_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary amount by which the exposure exceeds the limit threshold, null if within limit.

attributes.name: breach_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage points by which the exposure exceeds the limit threshold, null if within limit.

attributes.name: breach_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration exposure is within limits, has breached a soft threshold, breached a hard limit, or has been escalated for remediation.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to calculate the concentration exposure, including aggregation rules, netting conventions, and look-through approaches for fund investments.

attributes.name: concentration_dimension
attributes.description: The dimension along which concentration risk is being measured: single issuer, sector/industry, geography, asset class, currency, or counterparty.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level used for risk metric calculations, typically expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95% confidence).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this concentration exposure record was first created in the risk management system.

attributes.name: cvar_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this concentration exposure to the overall portfolio Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) or Expected Shortfall metric.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or platform from which the concentration exposure data was derived, such as BlackRock Aladdin, MSCI RiskMetrics, or SimCorp Dimension.

attributes.name: dimension_value
attributes.description: The specific value within the concentration dimension being measured, such as issuer name, sector code, country code, asset class name, currency code, or counterparty identifier.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the concentration exposure breach requires escalation to senior management or Investment Committee (IC) per governance policy.

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary exposure to the specified concentration dimension value, expressed in the portfolio base currency.

attributes.name: exposure_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the exposure amount is denominated.

attributes.name: exposure_percentage
attributes.description: The concentration exposure expressed as a percentage of total portfolio Net Asset Value (NAV) or Assets Under Management (AUM).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic region of concentration when dimension is geography.

attributes.name: limit_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum allowable concentration exposure percentage as defined by the risk limit framework for this dimension and value.

attributes.name: look_through_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the concentration calculation includes look-through analysis of underlying holdings in fund-of-funds or commingled vehicles.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the concentration exposure was calculated and recorded.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this concentration exposure record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this concentration exposure is monitored and reported to risk management and Investment Committee (IC).

attributes.name: nav_base
attributes.description: The total portfolio Net Asset Value (NAV) or Assets Under Management (AUM) used as the denominator for calculating exposure percentage.

attributes.name: netting_applied_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether long and short positions were netted in the concentration exposure calculation, or if gross exposure was used.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, commentary, or qualitative assessment related to the concentration exposure measurement.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this concentration exposure must be included in regulatory reporting to SEC, or other governing bodies.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of the action plan to reduce or mitigate the concentration exposure if a breach has occurred, including target reduction timeline and responsible party.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk assessment of the concentration exposure based on magnitude, volatility, and correlation characteristics.

attributes.name: sector_classification
attributes.description: The industry sector classification code or name applicable when concentration dimension is sector, using standard taxonomy such as GICS or BICS.

attributes.name: time_horizon_days
attributes.description: The time horizon in days over which the concentration risk metrics are calculated, commonly 1-day or 10-day for VaR.

attributes.name: var_contribution
attributes.description: The contribution of this concentration exposure to the overall portfolio Value at Risk (VaR) metric.

products.name: dv01_sensitivity
products.description: Transactional record of DV01 (Dollar Value of a Basis Point) and broader interest rate sensitivity measures for fixed income and rate-sensitive positions. Captures position or portfolio identifier, DV01 amount, duration (modified, effective, key-rate)
products.reference: DV01 / Duration Risk — Fixed Income Risk Management

attributes.name: dv01_sensitivity_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dollar Value of a Basis Point (DV01) Sensitivity ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DV01 sensitivity record.

tag_set.value: Dollar Value of a Basis Point (DV01) Sensitivity ID

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.employee. Business justification: Interest rate sensitivity approvals are critical for ALM governance. Pension funds must track who approved DV01 calculations for liability matching oversight.

attributes.name: discount_rate_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.discount_rate_curve. Business justification: LDI hedge ratio calculations require asset DV01 computed using the SAME discount curve as liabilities.

attributes.name: holding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific position or holding for which DV01 sensitivity is calculated.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.instrument. Business justification: DV01/duration calculations are instrument-specific for fixed income. Essential for liability-driven investing (LDI) where pension funds match asset duration to pension liabilities.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio containing the position or aggregate portfolio for which DV01 is measured.

attributes.name: research_yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_yield_curve. Business justification: DV01/duration calculations require yield curve inputs. The dv01_sensitivity table references yield_curve_source/date indicating dependency on curve data.

attributes.name: security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying security or instrument for which interest rate sensitivity is calculated.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific stress scenario under which this DV01 sensitivity was calculated.

attributes.name: aggregation_level
attributes.description: The level at which DV01 sensitivity is aggregated: individual position, portfolio, strategy, or total fund.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DV01 calculation was approved or validated.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The asset class category of the position for which DV01 is calculated.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DV01 sensitivity measure was calculated.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate DV01, such as analytical approximation or full revaluation.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the DV01 sensitivity calculation was performed, supporting intraday risk monitoring.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the DV01 calculation, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: convexity
attributes.description: Second-order measure of interest rate sensitivity, capturing the curvature of the price-yield relationship.

attributes.name: coupon_rate
attributes.description: The coupon rate of the fixed income instrument, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DV01 sensitivity record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the DV01 amount is denominated.

attributes.name: dv01_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dollar Value of a Basis Point (DV01) Amount
attributes.description: The dollar change in the value of the position or portfolio for a one basis point parallel shift in the yield curve.

tag_set.value: Dollar Value of a Basis Point (DV01) Amount

attributes.name: effective_duration
attributes.description: Effective duration accounting for embedded options, measuring interest rate sensitivity for bonds with optionality.

attributes.name: hedge_adjusted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DV01 calculation reflects hedging positions or is gross of hedges.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of financial instrument for which interest rate sensitivity is measured.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_10y
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 10-year point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_1y
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 1-year point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_2y
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 2-year point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_30y
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 30-year point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_3m
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 3-month point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_5y
attributes.description: Sensitivity to a one basis point change in the 5-year point of the yield curve, holding other points constant.

products.name: order

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the investment order record. Primary key for the order entity.

attributes.description: Reference to the external broker or dealer to whom the order was routed for execution. Links to counterparty entity.

attributes.name: custodian_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.custodian. Business justification: Orders specify which custodian will hold the securities. The existing custodian_code (BIGINT) appears to be an unlinked FK.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio manager or investment professional who originated the order. Links to employee or user entity.

attributes.name: esg_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esg.policy. Business justification: Orders must reference governing ESG policy for compliance audit trail. Pension funds track which responsible investment policy applies to each order for breach detection, regulatory reporting

attributes.name: exclusion_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esg.exclusion_list. Business justification: Pre-trade compliance workflow: pension fund orders must be validated against ESG exclusion lists before execution.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the security master record representing the instrument being traded. Links to security entity for ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, and pricing details.

attributes.name: natural_resource_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to naturalresource.resource_asset. Business justification: Trade order for a natural resource asset requires linking to the asset for trade reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to deal.opportunity. Business justification: Each trade order must be associated with the deal it executes; the pension fund’s trade execution reports and risk dashboards rely on this link.

attributes.description: Reference to the portfolio manager or investment professional who originated the order. Links to employee or user entity.

attributes.name: order_trader_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trader assigned to execute the order. May differ from portfolio manager. Links to employee or user entity.

attributes.name: parent_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order if this is a child order resulting from order splitting or algorithmic slicing. Null for top-level orders.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio for which this order is placed. Links to the portfolio master entity.

attributes.name: security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the security master record representing the instrument being traded. Links to security entity for ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, and pricing details.

attributes.name: trader_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trader assigned to execute the order. May differ from portfolio manager. Links to employee or user entity.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method for allocating fills across multiple portfolios when order is placed on behalf of multiple accounts: pro-rata, priority-based, manual, or average price.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order received final approval from compliance or investment committee. Null if approval not required or pending.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the security being traded: public equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, OTC derivatives, commodities, or alternative assets.

attributes.name: average_execution_price
attributes.description: Volume-weighted average price of all fills for this order. Calculated from execution records. Null until first fill occurs.

attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: Reference benchmark index used for performance comparison and execution quality measurement (e.g., S&P 500, MSCI World, Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the order was cancelled. Null if order was not cancelled. Captures user-provided reason or system-generated cause.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total brokerage commission charged for executing the order. Expressed in order currency. Null until execution occurs.

attributes.name: commission_basis_points
attributes.description: Commission rate expressed in basis points of notional value. One basis point equals 0.01%. Used for performance attribution and TCA.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order reached a terminal state (filled, cancelled, rejected, or expired). Null for active orders.

attributes.name: compliance_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the order has passed pre-trade compliance checks (position limits, restricted lists, concentration rules). True if approved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: compliance_override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any compliance rule override or exception granted for this order. Null if no override was required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp capturing when this order record was first inserted into the database. Distinct from order_timestamp which is the business event time.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the order is denominated. Typically matches the trading currency of the security.

products.name: treasury_fx_rate
products.description: Reference data table for official FX spot rates and forward points by currency pair and tenor, sourced from Bloomberg. Captures rate date, currency pair, spot rate, bid/ask spread, forward points by tenor (1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y), rate source, and rate type

attributes.name: treasury_fx_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FX rate record. Primary key for the treasury FX rate reference data table.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_treasury_fx_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the treasury FX rate record that supersedes this rate, enabling navigation through rate history and audit trail of rate changes.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the base currency in the currency pair (e.g., USD in USD/JPY).

attributes.name: bid_ask_spread_bps
attributes.description: The difference between ask and bid rates expressed in basis points, representing the transaction cost and market liquidity for the currency pair.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FX rate record was first created in the treasury system, supporting audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cross_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rate is a cross rate calculated from two USD pairs rather than a directly quoted market rate (e.g., EUR/JPY derived from EUR/USD and USD/JPY).

attributes.name: currency_pair
attributes.description: Standard currency pair notation combining base and quote currencies (e.g., USD/JPY, EUR/USD) following market convention for FX trading and hedging.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp until which this FX rate remains effective, after which it is superseded by a newer rate. Null for currently active rates, supporting temporal validity and rate history.

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp from which this FX rate becomes effective for valuation and hedge accounting purposes, supporting temporal validity and historical rate reconstruction.

attributes.name: fixing_time
attributes.description: The standard market fixing time for this rate (e.g., 4:00 PM London, 10:00 AM New York), used for benchmark rate determination and hedge accounting compliance.

attributes.name: forward_points_1m
attributes.description: Forward points for one-month tenor, used to calculate the one-month forward FX rate for hedging monthly cash flows, capital calls, and distributions.

attributes.name: forward_points_1w
attributes.description: Forward points for one-week tenor, representing the interest rate differential between the two currencies. Added to spot rate to derive the one-week forward rate for hedging short-term FX exposure.

attributes.name: forward_points_1y
attributes.description: Forward points for one-year tenor, used to calculate the one-year forward FX rate for hedging annual exposures and long-term strategic currency hedges.

attributes.name: forward_points_3m
attributes.description: Forward points for three-month tenor, used to calculate the three-month forward FX rate for hedging quarterly exposures and medium-term currency risk.

attributes.name: forward_points_6m
attributes.description: Forward points for six-month tenor, used to calculate the six-month forward FX rate for hedging semi-annual exposures and medium-term currency positions.

attributes.name: inversion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rate has been inverted from the source systems native quotation to match internal portfolio reporting convention (e.g., converting EUR/USD to USD/EUR).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this FX rate record, supporting change tracking and audit trail for data corrections or restatements.

attributes.name: market_convention
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate follows direct quotation (domestic currency per unit of foreign currency) or indirect quotation (foreign currency per unit of domestic currency) convention.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, explanations of unusual rate movements, data quality issues, or special handling instructions for this FX rate observation.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate was officially published or made available by the source provider, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: quote_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the quote currency in the currency pair (e.g., JPY in USD/JPY).

attributes.name: rate_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this FX rate is effective. Used for valuation, hedge accounting, and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: rate_quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality indicator for the FX rate: verified for confirmed rates, unverified for preliminary rates, estimated for interpolated or calculated rates, or stale for rates exceeding freshness threshold.

attributes.name: rate_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for this FX rate observation, typically combining currency pair, rate date, and source identifier for external reference and reconciliation.

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: The external data provider or central bank that published this FX rate (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, European Central Bank, Bank of Canada, Federal Reserve, or custom internal calculation).

attributes.name: rate_source_identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier or ticker symbol used by the source system to reference this FX rate (e.g., Bloomberg ticker USDCAD Curncy), enabling traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current status of the FX rate record: active for current use, superseded by a later rate, preliminary for initial publication, final for confirmed rate, or restated for corrected historical rate.

attributes.name: rate_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the FX rate was observed or published by the source system, including time zone information for intraday rate tracking.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the FX rate type: spot for immediate delivery, forward for future delivery, swap for simultaneous spot and forward, or cross for non-USD pairs.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate was received and ingested into the internal treasury system from the external source, used for latency monitoring and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rate is approved for use in regulatory reporting submissions to SEC, or other governing bodies, ensuring compliance with prescribed rate sources.

attributes.name: spot_ask_rate
attributes.description: The ask (offer) side of the spot FX rate, representing the rate at which the market maker will sell the base currency. Used for bid-ask spread analysis and transaction cost estimation.

attributes.name: spot_bid_rate
attributes.description: The bid side of the spot FX rate, representing the rate at which the market maker will buy the base currency. Used for bid-ask spread analysis and transaction cost estimation.

attributes.name: spot_mid_rate
attributes.description: The mid-point between bid and ask spot rates, calculated as the average of bid and ask. Commonly used for portfolio valuation and performance reporting.

attributes.name: spot_rate
attributes.description: The current market exchange rate for immediate delivery (typically T+2 settlement) of the currency pair, used for valuation and hedge ratio calculations.

attributes.name: triangulation_method

domains.name: actuarial
domains.description: Domain for actuarial liability matching and liability-driven investment (LDI) operations. Owns actuarial liability projections, ALM models, discount rate curves, mortality assumptions, funded status calculations, contribution rate modeling, and duration
domains.references: Actuarial Standards Board / IAS 19 / the national pension regulator

products.name: liability_projection
products.description: Core master record of actuarial liability projections for each contributor pool (one per participating plan). Captures projected benefit obligation (PBO), accumulated benefit obligation (ABO), projected cash flows by year
products.reference: Projected Benefit Obligation (PBO) / Actuarial Liability Projection

attributes.name: liability_projection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the actuarial liability projection record.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the comprehensive set of actuarial assumptions used in this projection, enabling traceability and scenario comparison.

attributes.name: contributor_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary contributor pool (one per participating plan) for which this liability projection is calculated.

attributes.name: economic_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.economic_scenario. Business justification: Liability projections must be stress-tested under multiple economic scenarios per regulatory requirements (e.g., PRA).

attributes.name: valuation_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.cycle. Business justification: ALM analysis timing: Liability projections must reference specific valuation cycles to ensure asset-liability matching uses synchronized measurement dates.

attributes.name: abo_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial present value of pension benefits earned to date based on current salary levels, without projection of future salary increases.

attributes.name: actuarial_gain_loss
attributes.description: The change in the PBO resulting from differences between actual experience and actuarial assumptions, or from changes in assumptions themselves.

attributes.name: actuary_firm
attributes.description: The actuarial consulting firm that prepared the liability projection, if applicable.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, Society of Actuaries (SOA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: actuary_name
attributes.description: The name of the qualified actuary responsible for preparing and certifying the liability projection.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, Society of Actuaries (SOA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: amortization_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years over which unfunded actuarial liabilities or surpluses are amortized through contribution adjustments.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: benefits_paid
attributes.description: The total pension benefits paid to retirees and beneficiaries during the projection period, reducing the liability.

attributes.name: cash_flow_year_1
attributes.description: Projected net benefit cash flow for year 1 of the projection horizon, used for liquidity planning and ALM.

attributes.name: cash_flow_year_10
attributes.description: Projected net benefit cash flow for year 10 of the projection horizon, used for long-term liquidity planning.

attributes.name: cash_flow_year_20
attributes.description: Projected net benefit cash flow for year 20 of the projection horizon, used for extended-term liquidity planning.

attributes.name: cash_flow_year_30
attributes.description: Projected net benefit cash flow for year 30 of the projection horizon, used for ultra-long-term liquidity planning.

attributes.name: cash_flow_year_5
attributes.description: Projected net benefit cash flow for year 5 of the projection horizon, used for medium-term liquidity planning.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the actuary certified the liability projection as complete and accurate.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, Society of Actuaries (SOA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for actuarial notes, qualifications, or explanations regarding the projection methodology or results.

attributes.name: contribution_rate_required
attributes.description: The actuarially determined contribution rate required from employers and members to fund the projected benefit obligation over time.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: convexity
attributes.description: The measure of the curvature in the relationship between liability values and discount rates, used for advanced ALM risk management.
attributes.references: interest rate risk management guidance, CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this liability projection record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disability_rate
attributes.description: The assumed annual rate at which active members become disabled and eligible for disability benefits.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The rate used to discount future benefit payments to present value, typically based on high-quality corporate bond yields or government bond yields for long-duration liabilities.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 19, FASB ASC 715, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: funded_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of plan assets to the projected benefit obligation, expressed as a percentage, a key solvency and health metric for the pension fund.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 19, FASB ASC 715, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: funded_status_amount
attributes.description: The difference between plan assets and the projected benefit obligation, indicating surplus or deficit position.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 19, FASB ASC 715, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: inflation_rate
attributes.description: The assumed annual inflation rate used to project cost-of-living adjustments and indexation of pension benefits.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: interest_cost
attributes.description: The increase in the projected benefit obligation due to the passage of time, calculated by applying the discount rate to the beginning PBO.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this liability projection is the current active version for the contributor pool and valuation date.

attributes.name: liability_duration_years
attributes.description: The weighted average duration of the liability cash flows, a key metric for Liability-Driven Investment (LDI) and duration matching strategies.
attributes.references: interest rate risk management guidance, CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the actuarial projection model used to generate this liability projection, supporting model governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: mortality_improvement_scale
attributes.description: The scale used to project future improvements in mortality rates over time, such as CPM-B or MP-2021.
attributes.references: Society of Actuaries (SOA) Mortality Improvement Scales, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: mortality_table
attributes.description: The mortality table used to estimate life expectancy and the duration of benefit payments, such as RP-2014 or Pri-2012.
attributes.references: Society of Actuaries (SOA) Mortality Tables, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: normal_cost_rate
attributes.description: The portion of the contribution rate attributable to benefits earned in the current year, excluding amortization of past service costs.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: pbo_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial present value of all future pension benefits earned to date, incorporating projected future salary increases and service credits.

attributes.name: projection_horizon_years
attributes.description: The number of years into the future for which cash flows and liabilities are projected, typically ranging from 30 to 75 years for pension funds.

attributes.name: projection_scenario
attributes.description: The scenario type under which the liability projection is modeled, supporting Asset-Liability Management (ALM) stress testing and Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) planning.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the liability projection was filed with the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_status
attributes.description: The status of the liability projection in the regulatory filing process with the national pension regulator or other pension regulators.

attributes.name: retirement_age_assumption
attributes.description: The average assumed retirement age for active members, used to project the timing of benefit commencement.

attributes.name: salary_growth_rate
attributes.description: The assumed annual rate of salary increase used to project future benefit obligations for active members.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 4, interest rate risk management guidance

attributes.name: service_cost
attributes.description: The present value of pension benefits earned by active members during the current period, a key component of pension expense.

attributes.name: turnover_rate
attributes.description: The assumed annual rate at which active members leave employment before retirement, affecting the projected benefit obligation.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that last modified this liability projection record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this liability projection record was last modified.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which the actuarial liability projection is calculated, typically aligned with fiscal year-end or interim valuation dates.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that created this liability projection record.

products.name: actuarial_valuation
products.description: Formal actuarial valuation record representing a full triennial or interim valuation of the pension fund AND the authoritative funded-status-at-date snapshot derived from it.
products.reference: Actuarial Valuation Report (actuarial standards of practice)

attributes.name: actuarial_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the actuarial valuation record.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Actuarial valuation uses a specific assumption set; FK provides reference and removes duplicate assumption_set_code.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.cycle. Business justification: Regulatory consistency: Actuarial valuations must use asset values from specific valuation cycles.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_authority. Business justification: Valuations are prepared for specific regulatory authorities (the national pension regulator for federally regulated plans, state regulators for public plans).

attributes.name: active_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of active contributing members included in the actuarial valuation as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: actuary_designation
attributes.description: The professional designation of the lead actuary, such as Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA).

attributes.name: actuary_firm_name
attributes.description: The name of the actuarial consulting firm that performed the valuation.

attributes.name: amortization_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years over which any unfunded liability or deficit is scheduled to be amortized through special payments.

attributes.name: asset_valuation_method
attributes.description: The method used to value plan assets for funding purposes, indicating whether market value, smoothed value, or fair value was applied.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Plan Reporting Standards, IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: average_active_member_age
attributes.description: The average age of active contributing members as of the valuation date, used for demographic analysis and liability projection.

attributes.name: average_pensioner_age
attributes.description: The average age of retired members receiving pension benefits as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the actuarial valuation report was finalized and signed by the actuary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this actuarial valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deferred_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of deferred vested members (former employees with preserved benefits) included in the actuarial valuation as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_rate
attributes.description: The recommended employer contribution rate as a percentage of pensionable payroll, derived from the actuarial valuation to fund ongoing benefit accruals and amortize any deficit.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the actuarial valuation was filed with the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: going_concern_discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate used to calculate the present value of future benefit payments on a going concern basis, typically based on expected long-term investment returns.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: going_concern_funded_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of plan assets to going concern liabilities, expressed as a decimal. A value of 1.0000 indicates 100 percent funded status.

attributes.name: going_concern_liability
attributes.description: The present value of all accrued pension benefits calculated on a going concern basis, assuming the plan continues to operate indefinitely.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Plan Reporting Standards, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: going_concern_surplus_deficit
attributes.description: The difference between plan assets and going concern liabilities, indicating the funded status on a going concern basis. Positive values represent surplus; negative values represent deficit.

attributes.name: inflation_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed long-term rate of inflation used in the actuarial valuation for projecting salary increases, benefit indexation, and cost-of-living adjustments.

attributes.name: lead_actuary_name
attributes.description: The name of the lead actuary who signed and is responsible for the valuation report.

attributes.name: liability_duration_years
attributes.description: The duration of the pension liabilities expressed in years, representing the weighted average time until benefit payments are made. Critical for Asset-Liability Management (ALM) and Liability-Driven Investment (LDI) strategies.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: member_contribution_rate
attributes.description: The member contribution rate as a percentage of pensionable payroll, representing the portion of pension funding contributed by plan members.

attributes.name: mortality_improvement_scale
attributes.description: The mortality improvement scale applied to the base mortality table to reflect expected future improvements in longevity, such as CPM-B or Scale MP-2021.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, Society of Actuaries

attributes.name: mortality_table
attributes.description: The mortality table used in the valuation to estimate life expectancy and the duration of benefit payments, such as RP-2014 or Pri-2012.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, Society of Actuaries

attributes.name: next_required_valuation_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline date by which the next actuarial valuation must be performed.

attributes.name: normal_cost_rate
attributes.description: The normal cost expressed as a percentage of pensionable payroll, representing the annual cost of benefits accruing in the current year.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Plan Reporting Standards, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business reference number assigned to this actuarial valuation for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: report_document_path
attributes.description: The file path or document management system reference to the full actuarial valuation report.

attributes.name: retired_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of retired members currently receiving pension benefits included in the actuarial valuation as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: retirement_age_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed average or normal retirement age used in the valuation for projecting when active members will commence pension benefits.

attributes.name: salary_increase_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed long-term rate of salary increases used to project future pensionable earnings for active members.

attributes.name: solvency_discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate used to calculate the present value of future benefit payments on a solvency basis, typically based on current annuity purchase rates or high-quality corporate bond yields.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice Pension Plan Reporting Standards

attributes.name: solvency_funded_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of plan assets to solvency liabilities, expressed as a decimal. A value of 1.0000 indicates 100 percent funded status on a solvency basis.

attributes.name: solvency_liability
attributes.description: The present value of all accrued pension benefits calculated on a solvency basis, representing the cost to settle all obligations if the plan were to wind up on the valuation date.
attributes.references: Pension regulator Plan Reporting Standards, actuarial standards of practice

attributes.name: solvency_surplus_deficit
attributes.description: The difference between plan assets and solvency liabilities, indicating the funded status on a solvency basis. Positive values represent surplus; negative values represent deficit.

attributes.name: special_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of special payments required to amortize any going concern or solvency deficit over the regulatory amortization period.

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of all plan members (active, deferred, and retired) included in the actuarial valuation as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: total_plan_assets_market_value
attributes.description: The total market value of all pension plan assets as of the valuation date, representing the investment portfolio available to meet future obligations.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19 Pension Plan Reporting Standards

attributes.name: total_plan_assets_smoothed_value
attributes.description: The smoothed or actuarial value of plan assets, which may differ from market value due to asset smoothing techniques used to reduce volatility in funding calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this actuarial valuation record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which the actuarial valuation was performed, representing the snapshot date for all assets, liabilities, and assumptions.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation IAS 19 Pension Plan Reporting Standards

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial cost method used in the valuation, such as Projected Unit Credit, Entry Age Normal, or Aggregate Cost Method.
attributes.references: actuarial standards of practice, IFRS Foundation IAS 19

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the actuarial valuation indicating its approval and filing state.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the actuarial valuation indicating whether it is a full triennial statutory valuation, interim update, special purpose, wind-up, or transfer valuation.

attributes.name: wind_up_liability
attributes.description: The estimated cost to fully settle all pension obligations through annuity purchases or lump-sum payments if the plan were terminated on the valuation date.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`actuarial_valuation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core actuarial valuation KPIs: funded ratios, surplus/deficit positions, liability magnitudes and demographic ratios used to steer funding policy and regulatory filing decisions."
  source: "`asset_management`.`actuarial`.`actuarial_valuation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "valuation_type"
      display_name: "Valuation Type"
      expr: valuation_type
      comment: "Type of actuarial valuation (e.g. going-concern, solvency, wind-up)."
    - name: "valuation_status"
      display_name: "Valuation Status"
      expr: valuation_status
      comment: "Workflow status of the valuation."
    - name: "valuation_method"
      display_name: "Valuation Method"
      expr: valuation_method
      comment: "Methodology used for the valuation."
    - name: "asset_valuation_method"
      display_name: "Asset Valuation Method"
      expr: asset_valuation_method
      comment: "Method used to value plan assets (market vs smoothed)."
    - name: "actuary_firm_name"
      display_name: "Actuary Firm"
      expr: actuary_firm_name
      comment: "External actuarial firm certifying the valuation."
    - name: "valuation_year"
      display_name: "Valuation Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', valuation_date)
      comment: "Valuation effective date bucketed to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "valuation_quarter"
      display_name: "Valuation Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', valuation_date)
      comment: "Valuation effective date bucketed to quarter."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "valuation_count"
      display_name: "Valuation Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of actuarial valuations."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_going_concern_funded_ratio"
      display_name: "Avg Going-Concern Funded Ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(going_concern_funded_ratio AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average going-concern funded ratio across valuations; key solvency health indicator."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_solvency_funded_ratio"
      display_name: "Avg Solvency Funded Ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(solvency_funded_ratio AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average solvency funded ratio; drives special-payment and de-risking decisions."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_going_concern_surplus_deficit"
      display_name: "Total Going-Concern Surplus/Deficit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(going_concern_surplus_deficit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate going-concern surplus (positive) or deficit (negative)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_solvency_surplus_deficit"
      display_name: "Total Solvency Surplus/Deficit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(solvency_surplus_deficit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate solvency surplus/deficit exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_solvency_liability"
      display_name: "Total Solvency Liability"
      expr: SUM(CAST(solvency_liability AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total solvency liability obligation under valuation basis."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_plan_assets_market_value"
      display_name: "Total Plan Assets (Market)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_plan_assets_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total market value of plan assets."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_liability_duration_years"
      display_name: "Avg Liability Duration (yrs)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(liability_duration_years AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average liability duration in years; drives LDI hedge targeting."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_member_count"
      display_name: "Total Members"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total plan membership covered by the valuation."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_active_member_age"
      display_name: "Avg Active Member Age"
      expr: AVG(CAST(average_active_member_age AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average age of active members; demographic maturity signal."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Core actuarial valuation KPIs: funded ratios, surplus/deficit positions, liability magnitudes and demographic ratios used to steer funding policy and regulatory filing decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`actuarial_de_risking_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "De-risking trigger breach events and hedge-ratio responses, used to monitor glidepath execution and governance action on funded-ratio thresholds."
  source: "`asset_management`.`actuarial`.`de_risking_event`"

      comment: "Type of de-risking trigger that fired."
    - name: "currency_code"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency context of the event."
    - name: "breach_month"
      display_name: "Breach Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', breach_timestamp)
      comment: "Breach timestamp bucketed to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day

  measures:
