      comment: "Number of de-risking breach events."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_funded_ratio_at_breach"
      display_name: "Avg Funded Ratio at Breach"
      expr: AVG(CAST(funded_ratio_at_breach AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average funded ratio at the moment of trigger breach."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_hedge_ratio_before"
      display_name: "Avg Hedge Ratio Before"
      expr: AVG(CAST(hedge_ratio_before AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average hedge ratio before the de-risking action."
      format:

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "avg_hedge_ratio_after"

      format:

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`actuarial_funded_status`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Point-in-time funded status measurements: funded ratio, asset/liability balances and asset-to-liability coverage for ongoing monitoring against de-risking triggers."
  source: "`asset_management`.`actuarial`.`funded_status`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "measurement_status"
      display_name: "Measurement Status"
      expr: measurement_status
      comment: "Status of the funded status measurement."
    - name: "scenario"
      display_name: "Scenario"
      expr: scenario
      comment: "Scenario label under which the funded status was computed."
    - name: "currency_code"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Reporting currency of the measurement."
    - name: "measurement_month"
      display_name: "Measurement Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', measurement_timestamp)
      comment: "Measurement timestamp bucketed to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "measurement_year"
      display_name: "Measurement Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', measurement_timestamp)
      comment: "Measurement timestamp bucketed to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "measurement_count"
      display_name: "Measurement Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of funded-status measurements."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_funded_ratio"
      display_name: "Avg Funded Ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(funded_ratio AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average funded ratio across measurements; primary funding health KPI."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_asset_to_liability_ratio"
      display_name: "Avg Asset/Liability Ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(asset_to_liability_ratio AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average asset-to-liability coverage ratio."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "closing_asset_market_value"
      display_name: "Closing Asset Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(asset_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Closing asset market value balance; use semi-additive closing for period-end snapshots."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: measurement_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "opening_asset_market_value"
      display_name: "Opening Asset Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(asset_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Opening asset market value balance at period start."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: measurement_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: first
    - name: "asset_growth_in_period"
      display_name: "Asset Growth in Period"
      expr: COALESCE(AGG(`closing_asset_market_value`),0) - COALESCE(AGG(`opening_asset_market_value`),0)
      comment: "Change in asset market value within the period (closing minus opening)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_liability_gross"
      display_name: "Total Gross Liability"
      expr: SUM(CAST(liability_gross AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross (going-concern) liability."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_liability_solvent"
      display_name: "Total Solvency Liability"
      expr: SUM(CAST(liability_solvent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total solvency-basis liability."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Point-in-time funded status measurements: funded ratio, asset/liability balances and asset-to-liability coverage for ongoing monitoring against de-risking triggers.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`beneficiary_benefit_payment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Pension benefit disbursement KPIs: gross/net payout, tax withholding, clawback and overpayment recovery, payment timeliness and dispute exposure. Core to Beneficiary Annual Statement and payment-integrity controls."
  source: "`asset_management`.`beneficiary`.`benefit_payment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Payment Status"
      display_name: "Payment Status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the benefit payment (e.g. paid, pending, failed, held)."
    - name: "Payment Approval Status"
      display_name: "Approval Status"
      expr: payment_approval_status
      comment: "Approval workflow state of the payment for controls segmentation."
    - name: "Payment Channel"
      display_name: "Payment Channel"
      expr: payment_channel
      comment: "Channel through which the payment was disbursed (e.g. EFT, cheque, wire)."
    - name: "Payment Method"
      display_name: "Payment Method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Settlement method used for the benefit payment."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "ISO currency code of the payment."
    - name: "Dispute Status"
      display_name: "Dispute Status"
      expr: payment_dispute_status
      comment: "Status of any dispute raised against the payment."
    - name: "Payment Month"
      display_name: "Payment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment date truncated to month for time-intelligence."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Payment Quarter"
      display_name: "Payment Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment date truncated to quarter."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Payment Year"
      display_name: "Payment Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment date truncated to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Payment Date"
      display_name: "Payment Date"
      expr: payment_date
      comment: "Raw payment date used as the order key for period-to-date windows."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Payment Count"
      display_name: "Payment Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of benefit payment records."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Members Paid"
      display_name: "Members Paid"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Distinct members who received a benefit payment — beneficiary reach."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Gross Paid"
      display_name: "Total Gross Paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross benefit amount disbursed — primary payout exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Net Paid"
      display_name: "Total Net Paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net benefit amount paid to beneficiaries after deductions."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Tax Withheld"
      display_name: "Total Tax Withheld"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_withholding_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax withheld on benefit payments — regulatory remittance exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Clawback"
      display_name: "Total Clawback"
      expr: SUM(CAST(clawback_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total clawback amount applied against payments — recovery activity."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Overpayment Recovery"
      display_name: "Total Overpayment Recovery"
      expr: SUM(CAST(overpayment_recovery_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total overpayment recovered via payment deductions."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Net Payment"
      display_name: "Avg Net Payment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net payment per record — benefit sizing signal."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Dispute Amount"
      display_name: "Total Dispute Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(payment_dispute_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monetary value under dispute — reputational and operational risk."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Effective Tax Withholding Rate"
      display_name: "Effective Tax Withholding Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(tax_withholding_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Tax withheld as a percentage of gross paid — remittance accuracy check."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Gross Paid CM"
      display_name: "Gross Paid (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross paid for the current month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Payment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Gross Paid PM"
      display_name: "Gross Paid (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross paid for the prior month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Payment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Gross Paid MoM"
      display_name: "Gross Paid MoM %"
      expr: (AGG(`Gross Paid CM`) - AGG(`Gross Paid PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Gross Paid PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in gross benefit disbursement."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Pension benefit disbursement KPIs: gross/net payout, tax withholding, clawback and overpayment recovery, payment timeliness and dispute exposure. Core to Beneficiary Annual Statement and payment-integrity controls.

    - name: "Remittance Type"

    - name: "Reconciliation Status"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Status"
      expr: reconciliation_status

    - name: "Remittance Channel"
      display_name: "Remittance Channel"
      expr: remittance_channel
      comment: "Channel used to submit the remittance."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "ISO currency code of the remittance."
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Remittance submission date truncated to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Year"
      display_name: "Submission Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', submission_date)
      comment: "Remittance submission date truncated to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Remittance Count"
      display_name: "Remittance Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of employer remittance records."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Employers Remitting"
      display_name: "Employers Remitting"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT participating_employer_id)
      comment: "Distinct participating employers that submitted remittances."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Remittance Amount"
      display_name: "Total Remittance Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_remittance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total contribution cash remitted by employers — core inflow."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Employer Contribution"
      display_name: "Total Employer Contribution"
      expr: SUM(CAST(employer_contribution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total employer-funded contribution portion."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Employee Contribution"
      display_name: "Total Employee Contribution"
      expr: SUM(CAST(employee_contribution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total employee-funded contribution portion within remittances."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Arrears"
      display_name: "Total Arrears"
      expr: SUM(CAST(arrears_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total arrears owed on remittances — compliance risk."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Late Penalty"

      expr: SUM(CAST(late_penalty_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total late-payment penalties levied on employers."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Total Variance Amount"

      comment: "Total reconciliation variance between expected and received amounts."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days Late"
      display_name: "Avg Days Late"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_late AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days remittances were submitted past due."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Late Submission Rate"
      display_name: "Late Submission Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_late_submission = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of remittances submitted late — employer compliance health."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Employer contribution remittance KPIs: total remittances, arrears, late submissions, penalties, reconciliation variance. Steers employer compliance and cash-inflow predictability.

      expr: country_code
      comment: "Member country of residence."
    - name: "Membership Start Month"
      display_name: "Membership Start Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', membership_start_date)
      comment: "Membership start date truncated to month (cohort entry)."
      format:

        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true

      display_name: "Membership Start Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', membership_start_date)
      comment: "Membership start date truncated to year."

      comment: "Average member age in years — actuarial population aging signal."

        decimal_places:

          places: 1
    - name: "Active Member Rate"
      display_name: "Active Member Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN membership_status = 'active' THEN member_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Active members as a percentage of total membership — engagement health."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Membership demographics and lifecycle KPIs: active membership base, status mix, plan-type distribution. Steers plan scale, actuarial population and engagement decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`beneficiary_overpayment_recovery`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Overpayment detection and recovery KPIs: gross overpayment, amounts recovered, outstanding balances, write-offs, hardship waivers, dispute rates. Steers financial leakage control and recovery operations."
  source: "`asset_management`.`beneficiary`.`overpayment_recovery`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Recovery Status"
      display_name: "Recovery Status"
      expr: recovery_status
      comment: "Current status of the recovery case."
    - name: "Overpayment Type"
      display_name: "Overpayment Type"
      expr: overpayment_type
      comment: "Classification of the overpayment (e.g. deceased, calculation error)."
    - name: "Overpayment Cause"
      display_name: "Overpayment Cause"
      expr: overpayment_cause
      comment: "Root cause category of the overpayment."
    - name: "Recovery Method"
      display_name: "Recovery Method"
      expr: recovery_method
      comment: "Mechanism used to recover funds (e.g. installment, lump sum, estate claim)."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "ISO currency code of the recovery case."
    - name: "Detection Month"
      display_name: "Detection Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', detection_date)
      comment: "Overpayment detection date truncated to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Detection Year"
      display_name: "Detection Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', detection_date)
      comment: "Overpayment detection date truncated to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Recovery Case Count"
      display_name: "Recovery Case Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of overpayment recovery cases."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Members Affected"
      display_name: "Members Affected"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Distinct members with an overpayment recovery case."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Gross Overpayment"
      display_name: "Total Gross Overpayment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_overpayment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross value of identified overpayments — financial leakage exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Recovered"
      display_name: "Total Recovered"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_recovered_to_date AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount recovered to date across cases."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Outstanding Balance"
      display_name: "Total Outstanding Balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unrecovered balance still outstanding — recovery backlog."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Write-Off"
      display_name: "Total Write-Off"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount written off as unrecoverable — permanent loss."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Hardship Waiver"
      display_name: "Total Hardship Waiver"
      expr: SUM(CAST(hardship_waiver_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount waived due to beneficiary hardship."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Recovery Rate"
      display_name: "Recovery Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(amount_recovered_to_date AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_overpayment_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of gross overpayment recovered to date — recovery effectiveness."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Write-Off Rate"
      display_name: "Write-Off Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_overpayment_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of gross overpayment written off — permanent leakage ratio."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Dispute Rate"
      display_name: "Dispute Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_raised = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of recovery cases that were disputed by beneficiaries."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Overpayment detection and recovery KPIs: gross overpayment, amounts recovered, outstanding balances, write-offs, hardship waivers, dispute rates. Steers financial leakage control and recovery operations.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`collateral_position`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Collateral inventory and valuation KPIs: market value, haircut-adjusted net value, eligibility and haircut severity by asset type. Used by Collateral Management to optimize collateral quality and funding cost."
  source: "`asset_management`.`collateral`.`collateral_position`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Asset Type"
      display_name: "Asset Type"
      expr: asset_type
      comment: "Asset class of the collateral position (govvie, corporate, equity, cash)."
    - name: "Collateral Type"
      display_name: "Collateral Type"
      expr: collateral_type
      comment: "Collateral classification of the position."
    - name: "Collateral Position Status"
      display_name: "Collateral Position Status"
      expr: collateral_position_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the collateral position."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency
      comment: "Currency denomination of the collateral position."
    - name: "Position Month"
      display_name: "Position Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', position_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the position date for balance trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Market Value"
      display_name: "Total Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate gross market value of collateral positions — headline collateral inventory."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Net Market Value"
      display_name: "Total Net Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate haircut-adjusted net collateral value — usable collateral after risk discounts."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Haircut Percent"
      display_name: "Avg Haircut %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(haircut_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average haircut applied across positions — collateral quality and funding-cost indicator."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Eligible Collateral Rate"
      display_name: "Eligible Collateral Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN eligible_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of positions that are eligible collateral — collateral-pool quality indicator."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Reportable Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of positions that are regulatory-reportable — compliance coverage monitoring."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Closing Net Market Value"
      display_name: "Closing Net Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Closing (period-end) net collateral value — semi-additive balance, never summed across time."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Position Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Opening Net Market Value"
      display_name: "Opening Net Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Opening (period-start) net collateral value — semi-additive balance for period change."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Position Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: first
$$
metric_views.description: Collateral inventory and valuation KPIs: market value, haircut-adjusted net value, eligibility and haircut severity by asset type. Used by Collateral Management to optimize collateral quality and funding cost.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`collateral_exposure`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Counterparty credit-exposure KPIs: gross/net exposure, collateralization, residual exposure after collateral, and risk metrics (VaR/CVaR/DV01). Used by Risk and CRO to monitor counterparty credit risk and collateral efficiency."
  source: "`asset_management`.`collateral`.`exposure`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Exposure Type"
      display_name: "Exposure Type"
      expr: exposure_type
      comment: "Type of exposure (derivative, repo, securities lending, etc.)."
    - name: "Exposure Status"
      display_name: "Exposure Status"
      expr: exposure_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the exposure record."
    - name: "Currency Code"
      display_name: "Currency Code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Reporting currency of the exposure."
    - name: "Risk Factor"
      display_name: "Risk Factor"
      expr: risk_factor
      comment: "Primary risk factor driving the exposure."
    - name: "Valuation Month"
      display_name: "Valuation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', valuation_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the exposure valuation date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Gross Exposure USD"
      display_name: "Total Gross Exposure (USD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_exposure_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate gross counterparty exposure in USD before netting/collateral — headline credit-risk magnitude."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Net Exposure USD"
      display_name: "Total Net Exposure (USD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_exposure_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate net exposure in USD after netting — post-agreement credit exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Collateral Held USD"
      display_name: "Total Collateral Held (USD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(collateral_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate collateral held in USD against exposures — mitigant coverage."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Residual Exposure After Collateral"
      display_name: "Residual Exposure After Collateral"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_exposure_after_collateral AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate uncollateralized residual exposure — the true unsecured credit risk requiring action."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Collateralization Ratio"
      display_name: "Collateralization Ratio"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(collateral_usd AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_positive_exposure AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Collateral held as a percentage of gross positive exposure — collateral coverage efficiency; low values trigger margin calls."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total VaR"
      display_name: "Total VaR"
      expr: SUM(CAST(var AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate value-at-risk across exposures — tail risk indicator for limit management."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total CVaR"
      display_name: "Total CVaR"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cvar AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate conditional value-at-risk (expected shortfall) — severe-tail risk steering metric."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total DV01"
      display_name: "Total DV01"
      expr: SUM(CAST(dv01 AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate interest-rate sensitivity (DV01) of exposures — rate-risk steering metric."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Margin Call Flag Rate"
      display_name: "Margin Call Flag Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN margin_call_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of exposures currently flagged for margin call — early-warning liquidity-demand indicator."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Counterparty credit-exposure KPIs: gross/net exposure, collateralization, residual exposure after collateral, and risk metrics (VaR/CVaR/DV01). Used by Risk and CRO to monitor counterparty credit risk and collateral efficiency.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`collateral_margin_call`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Margin call lifecycle KPIs: call volume, exposure amounts, settlement timeliness and dispute-prone activity. Used by Collateral Operations and Treasury to steer liquidity and operational SLA performance."
  source: "`asset_management`.`collateral`.`margin_call`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Call Direction"
      display_name: "Call Direction"
      expr: call_direction
      comment: "Direction of the margin call (Call / Return) indicating whether collateral is received or posted."
    - name: "Margin Type"
      display_name: "Margin Type"
      expr: margin_type
      comment: "Type of margin (initial / variation) driving the call."
    - name: "Margin Call Status"
      display_name: "Margin Call Status"
      expr: margin_call_status
      comment: "Processing status of the margin call (open, settled, disputed, cancelled)."
    - name: "Collateral Currency"
      display_name: "Collateral Currency"
      expr: collateral_currency
      comment: "Currency in which collateral for the call is denominated."
    - name: "Call Month"
      display_name: "Call Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', call_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the margin call date for time-intelligence trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Call Year"
      display_name: "Call Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', call_date)
      comment: "Year bucket of the margin call date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Margin Call Count"
      display_name: "Margin Call Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of margin calls — baseline activity volume for ops capacity planning."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Call Amount"
      display_name: "Total Call Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(call_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate gross margin call amount demanded — key liquidity-demand indicator."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Net Call Amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Call Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate net (post-offset) margin call amount — true net collateral movement."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Call Amount"
      display_name: "Avg Call Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(call_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average size of a margin call — detects outsized exposure events."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Collateral Amount"
      display_name: "Total Collateral Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(collateral_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total collateral delivered against calls — measures coverage of demanded margin."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Processed Call Count"
      display_name: "Processed Call Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN call_processed_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of margin calls successfully processed — basis for settlement-rate SLA."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Processed Call Rate"
      display_name: "Processed Call Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN call_processed_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of margin calls processed — operational throughput and SLA health."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Call Amount CM"
      display_name: "Total Call Amount (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(call_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Current-month total margin call amount for MoM trending."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Call Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Call Amount PM"
      display_name: "Total Call Amount (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(call_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month total margin call amount for MoM trending."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Call Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Call Amount MoM"
      display_name: "Call Amount MoM %"
      expr: (AGG(`Total Call Amount CM`) - AGG(`Total Call Amount PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total Call Amount PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in margin call demand — liquidity trend signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Margin call lifecycle KPIs: call volume, exposure amounts, settlement timeliness and dispute-prone activity. Used by Collateral Operations and Treasury to steer liquidity and operational SLA performance.

  comment: "Sanctions screening KPIs tracking match hit rates, false positive burden, and remediation of true matches to support AML/KYC suspicious activity reporting."

  dimensions:
    - name: "screening_result"
      display_name: "Screening Result"
      expr: screening_result
      comment: "Outcome of the sanctions screening (match/no-match/pending)."
    - name: "screening_list"
      display_name: "Screening List"
      expr: screening_list
      comment: "Sanctions/watchlist used for screening (OFAC, EU, UN, etc.)."
    - name: "screened_entity_type"
      display_name: "Screened Entity Type"
      expr: screened_entity_type
      comment: "Type of entity screened for segmentation."
    - name: "record_status"
      display_name: "Record Status"
      expr: record_status
      comment: "Processing status of the screening record."
    - name: "screening_month"
      display_name: "Screening Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', screening_timestamp)
      comment: "Month bucket of screening event for volume and hit-rate trends."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "screening_count"
      display_name: "Screening Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total sanctions screenings performed — operational throughput baseline."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "match_count"
      display_name: "Match Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN screening_result = 'Match' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of positive sanctions matches — direct regulatory and reputational risk events."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "false_positive_count"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_false_positive = TRUE THEN 1 END)

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

      comment: "Percentage of screenings that are false positives — efficiency KPI for calibrating screening thresholds."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "true_match_rate"
      display_name: "True Match Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN screening_result = 'Match' AND is_false_positive = FALSE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of screenings resulting in true sanctions matches — core AML risk exposure indicator."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_screening_risk_score"
      display_name: "Avg Screening Risk Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average risk score of screened entities — risk intensity gauge for AML resourcing."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Sanctions screening KPIs tracking match hit rates, false positive burden, and remediation of true matches to support AML/KYC suspicious activity reporting.

    - name: "Seniority"

    - name: "Notional Currency"

      comment: "Month the CDS was traded."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Notional"
      display_name: "Total Notional"
      expr: SUM(CAST(notional_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total CDS notional exposure — gross protection size."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Market Value"
      display_name: "Total Market Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(market_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total mark-to-market value of CDS positions."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total DV01"
      display_name: "Total DV01"
      expr: SUM(CAST(dv01 AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate spread DV01 — sensitivity to a 1bp credit-spread move."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

        decimal_places:

          places: 2

          type: all

      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Baseline count of CDS positions."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Credit default swap position semantic layer: notional exposure, mark-to-market, spread risk (DV01, market spread), collateral posting, and clearing status. Used by derivatives and credit hedging desks to monitor protection exposure and counterparty/collateral posture.

      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

          places: 2

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_capitalizable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Fee lines that are capitalizable — accounting treatment split."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Reimbursable Fee Count"
      display_name: "Reimbursable fee count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_reimbursable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Fee lines marked reimbursable."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Fee Spend MTD"
      display_name: "Fee spend mtd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Month-to-date fee spend in USD for current-period cost tracking."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Invoice Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Fee Spend Prior Month"
      display_name: "Fee spend prior month"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month fee spend in USD for MoM comparison."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Invoice Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Fee Spend MoM"
      display_name: "Fee spend mom"

      comment: "Month-over-month change in deal fee spend."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$

  source: "`asset_management`.`deal`.`opportunity`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Asset Class"

    - name: "Opportunity Status"

    - name: "Opportunity Type"
      display_name: "Opportunity type"
      expr: opportunity_type

    - name: "IC Decision"
      display_name: "Ic decision"
      expr: ic_decision

    - name: "Priority Tier"

    - name: "Risk Rating"

    - name: "Investment Currency"

    - name: "Vintage Year"

    - name: "ESG Exclusion Flag"

    - name: "Origination Month"
      display_name: "Origination month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', origination_date)
      comment: "Origination date bucketed to month for pipeline intake trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Origination Year"
      display_name: "Origination year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', origination_date)
      comment: "Origination date bucketed to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expected Close Month"
      display_name: "Expected close month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', expected_close_date)
      comment: "Expected close date bucketed to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Opportunity Count"
      display_name: "Opportunity count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of sourced opportunities — pipeline volume baseline."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Distinct Target Entities"
      display_name: "Distinct target entities"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT target_entity_id)
      comment: "Distinct target companies in the pipeline — origination breadth."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Opportunity Count"
      display_name: "Active opportunity count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of currently active (live) opportunities in the pipeline."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Closed Opportunity Count"
      display_name: "Closed opportunity count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_close_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Opportunities that reached a close — conversion numerator."

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN ic_decision = 'Approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Opportunities approved by the Investment Committee."

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Declined Count"
      display_name: "Declined count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN decline_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Opportunities declined — attrition signal."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Expected Investment Amount"
      display_name: "Total expected investment amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(expected_investment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate expected capital deployment across the pipeline."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Expected Investment Amount"
      display_name: "Avg expected investment amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(expected_investment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average expected ticket size per opportunity."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Target IRR Percent"
      display_name: "Avg target irr percent"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_irr_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average targeted internal rate of return across opportunities."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Target MOIC"
      display_name: "Avg target moic"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_moic AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average targeted multiple on invested capital."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Strategic Fit Score"
      display_name: "Avg strategic fit score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(strategic_fit_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average strategic fit score — portfolio alignment quality."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Expected Hold Period Years"
      display_name: "Avg expected hold period years"
      expr: AVG(CAST(expected_hold_period_years AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average expected holding period in years — duration profile."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "ESG Excluded Count"
      display_name: "Esg excluded count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN esg_exclusion_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Opportunities excluded on ESG grounds — responsible-investment screening volume."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Opportunities MTD"
      display_name: "Opportunities mtd"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Month-to-date count of sourced opportunities for intake trending."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Origination Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Opportunities Prior Month"
      display_name: "Opportunities prior month"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Prior month opportunity count for MoM comparison."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Origination Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Opportunity Intake MoM"
      display_name: "Opportunity intake mom"
      expr: (AGG(`Opportunities MTD`) - AGG(`Opportunities Prior Month`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Opportunities Prior Month`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in opportunity intake."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Deal pipeline KPIs over sourced investment opportunities — origination throughput, conversion, target economics and strategic fit. Core deal-funnel steering layer.

        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Initiation Year"
      display_name: "Initiation Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', initiation_date)
      comment: "Year the diligence engagement was initiated."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Engagement Count"
      display_name: "Engagement Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of diligence engagements in scope — baseline pipeline volume."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Proposed Commitment"
      display_name: "Total Proposed Commitment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(proposed_commitment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate proposed commitment capital flowing through diligence — measures capital-at-stake in the pipeline."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Proposed Commitment"
      display_name: "Avg Proposed Commitment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(proposed_commitment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average proposed commitment per engagement — indicates typical deal size reaching diligence."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

          type: exact
          places: 1

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "withholding_tax_base"
      display_name: "Withholding Tax (Base)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(withholding_tax_amount_base AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total withholding tax in base currency — tax drag on dividend income."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "tax_reclaim_recoverable_local"
      display_name: "Tax Reclaim Recoverable (Local)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_reclaim_amount_local AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reclaimable tax (local) — value recoverable via tax-treaty reclaim; drives recovery operations."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_withholding_tax_rate_pct"
      display_name: "Avg Withholding Tax Rate %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(withholding_tax_rate_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average withholding tax rate — tax-efficiency indicator across jurisdictions."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "reinvested_dividend_income_base"
      display_name: "Reinvested Dividend Income (Base)"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reinvestment_flag = TRUE THEN CAST(net_dividend_amount_base AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Net dividend income flagged for reinvestment — compounding/DRIP monitoring."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "reclaim_eligible_income_base"
      display_name: "Reclaim-Eligible Income (Base)"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN tax_reclaim_eligible_flag = TRUE THEN CAST(gross_dividend_amount_base AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Gross income eligible for tax reclaim — targets recovery pipeline."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "distinct_dividend_payers"
      display_name: "Distinct Dividend Payers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT listed_security_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct dividend-paying securities — income diversification."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "gross_dividend_income_cm"
      display_name: "Gross Dividend Income CM"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_dividend_amount_base AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Current-month gross dividend income for MoM time intelligence."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: payment_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "gross_dividend_income_pm"
      display_name: "Gross Dividend Income PM"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_dividend_amount_base AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month gross dividend income for MoM comparison."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: payment_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "gross_dividend_income_mom"
      display_name: "Gross Dividend Income MoM %"
      expr: (AGG(`gross_dividend_income_cm`) - AGG(`gross_dividend_income_pm`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`gross_dividend_income_pm`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in gross dividend income — income trend signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Dividend income analytics: gross/net income, withholding tax drag, tax-reclaim recovery and reinvestment behaviour. Supports income forecasting and tax-efficiency steering for pension cash flows.

AS $$

  comment: "Issuer engagement and active-ownership analytics: engagement volume, escalation, outcomes and follow-up discipline across ESG pillars. Supports stewardship effectiveness reporting."
  source: "`asset_management`.`equity`.`engagement_log`"
  dimensions:

      comment: "Engagement topic category."
    - name: "escalation_level"
      display_name: "Escalation Level"
      expr: escalation_level
      comment: "Escalation level reached in the engagement."
    - name: "engagement_month"
      display_name: "Engagement Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', engagement_date)
      comment: "Engagement month for activity time series."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "engagement_year"
      display_name: "Engagement Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', engagement_date)
      comment: "Engagement year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_engagements"
      display_name: "Total Engagements"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total engagements logged — active-ownership activity volume."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "distinct_issuers_engaged"
      display_name: "Distinct Issuers Engaged"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT listed_security_id)
      comment: "Distinct issuers engaged — stewardship reach."

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "escalated_engagements"

      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN escalation_level IS NOT NULL AND escalation_level <> 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

        type: number
        decimal_places:

      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_engagement_duration_minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Engagement Duration (min)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(engagement_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average engagement duration — engagement depth/resource intensity."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "collaborative_engagements"
      display_name: "Collaborative Engagements"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN collaborative_partner_names IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Engagements conducted collaboratively with partners — collective-influence indicator."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

          places: 2

    - name: "distinct_securities_priced"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`esg_controversy`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "ESG controversy analytics covering incident volume, severity, financial penalties, escalation and divestment recommendations. Drives risk mitigation, exclusion and divestment decisions."
  source: "`asset_management`.`esg`.`controversy`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "severity_level"
      display_name: "Severity Level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity band of the controversy."
    - name: "controversy_status"
      display_name: "Controversy Status"
      expr: controversy_status
      comment: "Current status of the controversy case."
    - name: "controversy_type"
      display_name: "Controversy Type"
      expr: controversy_type
      comment: "Type/category of the controversy."
    - name: "sector_classification"
      display_name: "Sector"
      expr: sector_classification
      comment: "Sector of the investee involved in the controversy."
    - name: "geographic_location"
      display_name: "Geographic Location"
      expr: geographic_location
      comment: "Geographic location of the controversy incident."
    - name: "identification_month"
      display_name: "Identification Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', identification_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the controversy identification date for trend analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Controversies"
      display_name: "Controversies"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT controversy_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct controversies; headline ESG-risk incident volume."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Financial Penalties"
      display_name: "Total Financial Penalties"
      expr: SUM(CAST(financial_penalty_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total financial penalties linked to controversies; quantifies regulatory and reputational cost."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Escalated Controversies"
      display_name: "Escalated Controversies"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN escalation_flag = TRUE THEN controversy_id END)
      comment: "Count of escalated controversies requiring investment-committee or leadership attention."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Divestment Recommended %"
      display_name: "Divestment Recommended %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN divestment_recommendation IS NOT NULL AND divestment_recommendation <> 'None' THEN controversy_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT controversy_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of controversies with a divestment recommendation; signals portfolio exit pressure."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "UNGC Violation Controversies %"
      display_name: "UNGC Violation %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN un_global_compact_violation = TRUE THEN controversy_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT controversy_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of controversies involving UN Global Compact violations; flags the most severe norms breaches."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Action %"
      display_name: "Regulatory Action %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regulatory_action_flag = TRUE THEN controversy_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT controversy_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of controversies that triggered regulatory action; compliance-risk escalation signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: ESG controversy analytics covering incident volume, severity, financial penalties, escalation and divestment recommendations. Drives risk mitigation, exclusion and divestment decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`esg_ghg_emission_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Financed and attributed greenhouse-gas emissions analytics across scopes, asset classes and reporting periods. Central to TCFD climate-risk reporting, carbon-budget steering and Paris alignment monitoring."
  source: "`asset_management`.`esg`.`ghg_emission_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "asset_class"
      display_name: "Asset Class"
      expr: asset_class
      comment: "Asset class of the emitting holding for carbon segmentation."
    - name: "sector_classification"
      display_name: "Sector"
      expr: sector_classification
      comment: "Sector classification of the issuer for carbon hot-spot analysis."
    - name: "geographic_scope"
      display_name: "Geographic Scope"
      expr: geographic_scope
      comment: "Geographic scope of the emissions record."
    - name: "verification_status"
      display_name: "Verification Status"
      expr: verification_status
      comment: "Verification status of the emissions data for data-quality governance."
    - name: "measurement_month"
      display_name: "Measurement Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', measurement_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the emissions measurement date for carbon trend analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "measurement_year"
      display_name: "Measurement Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', measurement_date)
      comment: "Year bucket of the emissions measurement date for YoY decarbonization tracking."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Emission Records"
      display_name: "Emission Records"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT ghg_emission_record_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct emission records; coverage base for carbon KPIs."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Attributed Emissions tCO2e"
      display_name: "Total Attributed Emissions (tCO2e)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(attributed_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total financed/attributed emissions in tCO2e; headline financed-emissions figure for TCFD and net-zero tracking."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Scope 1 Emissions tCO2e"
      display_name: "Scope 1 (tCO2e)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scope_1_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Scope 1 direct emissions in tCO2e."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Scope 2 Market Based Emissions tCO2e"
      display_name: "Scope 2 Market-Based (tCO2e)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scope_2_market_based_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Scope 2 market-based emissions in tCO2e."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Scope 3 Emissions tCO2e"
      display_name: "Scope 3 (tCO2e)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scope_3_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Scope 3 value-chain emissions in tCO2e; largest and highest-uncertainty component of financed emissions."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Carbon Footprint per Million Invested"
      display_name: "Avg Carbon Footprint / $M"
      expr: AVG(CAST(carbon_footprint_per_million_invested AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average carbon footprint per million invested; normalized intensity metric for comparing holdings."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Avg Emissions Intensity"
      display_name: "Avg Emissions Intensity"
      expr: AVG(CAST(emissions_intensity_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average emissions intensity value; used for weighted-average carbon intensity decomposition."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Paris Aligned Records %"
      display_name: "Paris Aligned %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN paris_alignment_flag = TRUE THEN ghg_emission_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ghg_emission_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Share of emission records flagged Paris-aligned; climate-alignment steering KPI for the investment committee."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Data Quality Score"
      display_name: "Avg Data Quality Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(data_quality_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average emissions data-quality score; reliability guardrail for carbon reporting decisions."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Attributed Emissions CY"
      display_name: "Attributed Emissions CY"
      expr: SUM(CAST(attributed_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Current-year total attributed emissions used for YoY decarbonization comparison."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: measurement_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Attributed Emissions PY"
      display_name: "Attributed Emissions PY"
      expr: SUM(CAST(attributed_emissions_tco2e AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-year total attributed emissions used for YoY decarbonization comparison."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: measurement_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 year
    - name: "Attributed Emissions YoY"
      display_name: "Attributed Emissions YoY"
      expr: (AGG(`Total Attributed Emissions CY`) - AGG(`Total Attributed Emissions PY`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total Attributed Emissions PY`), 0)
      comment: "Year-over-year change in attributed emissions; directly tracks decarbonization progress against net-zero commitments."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Financed and attributed greenhouse-gas emissions analytics across scopes, asset classes and reporting periods. Central to TCFD climate-risk reporting, carbon-budget steering and Paris alignment monitoring.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`fee_calculation_run`
WITH METRICS

AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Fee calculation engine outputs — gross/net fee amounts, offsets and adjustments by period and fee type; the authoritative view of fees actually computed against AUM/NAV."
  source: "`asset_management`.`fee`.`fee_calculation_run`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Fee Type"
      display_name: "Fee Type"
      expr: fee_type
      comment: "Type of fee computed in the run (management, performance, etc.)."
    - name: "Run Status"
      display_name: "Run Status"
      expr: run_status
      comment: "Processing status of the calculation run."
    - name: "Calculation Methodology"
      display_name: "Calculation Methodology"
      expr: calculation_methodology
      comment: "Methodology applied in the calculation run."
    - name: "Fee Currency"
      display_name: "Fee Currency"
      expr: fee_currency_code
      comment: "Currency the fee amount is denominated in."
    - name: "Calculation Month"
      display_name: "Calculation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', calculation_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the fee calculation date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Calculation Year"
      display_name: "Calculation Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', calculation_date)
      comment: "Year bucket of the fee calculation date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Gross Fee Amount"
      display_name: "Gross Fee Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross fees computed — top-line cost before offsets, key to total expense ratio."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Net Fee Amount"
      display_name: "Net Fee Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net fees after offsets/adjustments — the amount actually payable, drives fund cost."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Offset Amount"
      display_name: "Offset Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(offset_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fee offsets applied — measures value recaptured from transaction/monitoring fees."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Adjustment Amount"
      display_name: "Adjustment Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total manual adjustments to computed fees — flags recurring calculation corrections."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg AUM Basis"
      display_name: "Avg AUM Basis"
      expr: AVG(CAST(aum_basis_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average AUM basis used for fee calculation — denominator context for effective fee rate."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Hurdle Met Count"
      display_name: "Hurdle met count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN hurdle_met_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Runs where the performance hurdle was met — triggers performance-fee accrual."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Net Fee CM"
      display_name: "Net Fee (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net fee for the current month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Calculation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Net Fee PM"
      display_name: "Net Fee (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net fee for the prior month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Calculation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Net Fee MoM"
      display_name: "Net Fee MoM"
      expr: (AGG(`Net Fee CM`) - AGG(`Net Fee PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Net Fee PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in net fees — tracks fee cost trajectory for steering reviews."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Fee calculation engine outputs — gross/net fee amounts, offsets and adjustments by period and fee type; the authoritative view of fees actually computed against AUM/NAV.

    - name: "Is Emergency Call"
      display_name: "Emergency Call"
      expr: is_emergency_call
      comment: "Whether the call was an emergency/short-notice call (True/False)."
    - name: "Call Notice Month"
      display_name: "Call Notice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', call_notice_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the call notice date for liquidity trend analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Capital Call Count"
      display_name: "Capital Call Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of capital calls in scope. Baseline activity volume."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Called Amount"
      display_name: "Total Called Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(call_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate amount called from the fund. Core cash outflow commitment measure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Funded Amount"
      display_name: "Total Funded Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(funded_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate amount actually funded. Compared against called amount to detect shortfalls."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Investment Amount"
      display_name: "Total Investment Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(investment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate portion of calls applied to investment deployment."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Management Fee"
      display_name: "Total Management Fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(management_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate management fees called. Cost transparency KPI for fee oversight."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Late Payment Penalty"
      display_name: "Total Late Payment Penalty"
      expr: SUM(CAST(late_payment_penalty AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate late payment penalties incurred. Operational-risk indicator that triggers process review."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Emergency Call Count"
      display_name: "Emergency Call Count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_emergency_call = TRUE THEN infrastructure_capital_call_id END)
      comment: "Number of emergency capital calls. Signals unplanned liquidity demands requiring treasury attention."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Notice Period Days"
      display_name: "Avg Notice Period (Days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(notice_period_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average notice period in days. Measures how much lead time treasury receives for funding."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Capital call execution KPIs: amounts called/funded, management fee and expense breakdown, late payment penalties and emergency calls. Used by treasury and operations to manage liquidity, funding timeliness and operational risk.
