CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`portfolio_capital_commitment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Private-markets capital commitment semantic layer — committed/funded/unfunded capital, dry-powder, and target return/MOIC. Drives pacing and liquidity planning."
  source: "`asset_management`.`portfolio`.`portfolio_capital_commitment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Asset Class"
      display_name: "Asset Class"
      expr: asset_class
      comment: "Asset class of the commitment."
    - name: "Commitment Status"
      display_name: "Commitment Status"
      expr: commitment_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the commitment."
    - name: "Commitment Type"
      display_name: "Commitment Type"
      expr: commitment_type
      comment: "Type of commitment (fund/co-invest/direct)."
    - name: "Geographic Focus"
      display_name: "Geographic Focus"
      expr: geographic_focus
      comment: "Geographic focus of the commitment."
    - name: "Investment Strategy"
      display_name: "Investment Strategy"
      expr: investment_strategy
      comment: "Investment strategy of the commitment."
    - name: "Vintage Year"
      display_name: "Vintage Year"
      expr: vintage_year
      comment: "Vintage year of the commitment — pacing cohort."
    - name: "Commitment Month"
      display_name: "Commitment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', commitment_date)
      comment: "Commitment date bucketed to month."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Committed Capital"
      display_name: "Committed Capital"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_currency_committed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total committed capital in base currency — scale of private-markets program."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Funded Capital"
      display_name: "Funded Capital"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_currency_funded_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Capital drawn/funded to date in base currency."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Unfunded Capital"
      display_name: "Unfunded Capital (Dry Powder)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_currency_unfunded_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Undrawn commitment (dry powder) in base currency — future funding obligation."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Funded Ratio"
      display_name: "Funded Ratio %"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_currency_funded_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(base_currency_committed_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Funded as a share of committed — program drawdown progress. Single-aggregate-per-call ratio composed of two SUMs only (allowed: one division of two aggregates)."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Target IRR"
      display_name: "Avg Target IRR %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_irr_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target IRR across commitments — expected return profile."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Target MOIC"
      display_name: "Avg Target MOIC"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_moic AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target MOIC across commitments — expected multiple."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Management Fee"
      display_name: "Avg Management Fee %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(management_fee_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average management fee rate — cost of external management."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Responsible Investment Rate"
      display_name: "Responsible Investment %"
      expr: AVG(CASE WHEN responsible_investment_flag = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
      comment: "Share of commitments flagged responsible-investment — ESG mandate adherence (SFDR)."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Private-markets capital commitment semantic layer — committed/funded/unfunded capital, dry-powder, and target return/MOIC. Drives pacing and liquidity planning.

      comment: "Reporting currency of the NAV record."
    - name: "NAV Status"
      display_name: "NAV Status"
      expr: nav_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the NAV (e.g. draft/final)."
    - name: "Reconciliation Status"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Status"
      expr: reconciliation_status
      comment: "Whether the NAV has been reconciled to custodian/administrator."
    - name: "Valuation Day"
      display_name: "Valuation Day"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', valuation_date)
      comment: "NAV valuation date bucketed to day."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Valuation Month"
      display_name: "Valuation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', valuation_date)
      comment: "NAV valuation date bucketed to month for time-intelligence."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Valuation Year"
      display_name: "Valuation Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', valuation_date)
      comment: "NAV valuation date bucketed to year."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Closing NAV"
      display_name: "Closing NAV"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nav_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Closing net asset value (semi-additive: take the last value in the period, never summed across dates)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Valuation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Closing NAV PM"
      display_name: "Closing NAV (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nav_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month closing NAV for month-over-month comparison."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Valuation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "NAV MoM Growth"
      display_name: "NAV MoM Growth %"
      expr: (AGG(`Closing NAV`) - AGG(`Closing NAV PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Closing NAV PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month NAV growth rate — headline AUM trajectory for the board."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Gross Asset Value"
      display_name: "Gross Asset Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gav_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross asset value before liabilities — gross exposure of the book."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Net Contributions"
      display_name: "Contributions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(contributions AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Capital contributions into portfolios in the period — drives funding of pension liabilities."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Distributions"
      display_name: "Distributions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(distributions AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Capital distributed out of portfolios in the period."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Unfunded Commitments"
      display_name: "Unfunded Commitments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unfunded_commitments AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Outstanding capital commitments not yet called — key liquidity planning metric for private markets."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg NAV Change Pct"
      display_name: "Avg NAV Change %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(nav_change_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average period NAV change percentage across records — performance pulse."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Reconciled NAV Rate"
      display_name: "Reconciled NAV %"
      expr: AVG(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'RECONCILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
      comment: "Share of NAV records fully reconciled — operational data-quality control for IFRS reporting."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: NAV / AUM semantic layer over portfolio NAV records — supports IFRS financial statements, NAV growth tracking, and AUM steering. Semi-additive balances (NAV is a point-in-time stock, never summed across time).

  source: "`asset_management`.`privateequity`.`capital_account`"
  dimensions:

      display_name: "Account Status"
      expr: account_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of the LP capital account (active, closed, etc.) for portfolio segmentation."
    - name: "Reporting Currency"
      display_name: "Reporting Currency"
      expr: reporting_currency
      comment: "Currency the capital account statement is reported in."
    - name: "Is Final Statement"
      display_name: "Is Final Statement"
      expr: is_final_statement
      comment: "Flag indicating whether this is the final statement for the account (fund wind-down tracking)."
    - name: "Statement Month"
      display_name: "Statement Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', statement_date)
      comment: "Statement date bucketed to month for time-series trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Statement Year"
      display_name: "Statement Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', statement_date)
      comment: "Statement date bucketed to year for annual performance reporting."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Commitment"
      display_name: "Total Commitment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(commitment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate committed capital across LP accounts — drives fundraising and pacing decisions."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Paid In Capital"
      display_name: "Total Paid In Capital"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_in_capital AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate capital actually drawn/paid-in — denominator for TVPI/DPI performance."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Unfunded Commitment"
      display_name: "Total Unfunded Commitment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unfunded_commitment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Dry powder outstanding — critical for liquidity planning and capital-call pacing."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Cumulative Distributions"
      display_name: "Total Cumulative Distributions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cumulative_distributions AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Lifetime cash returned to LPs — feeds DPI realization monitoring."

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Closing NAV"

      comment: "Net asset value closing balance across accounts (semi-additive — take latest per period)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Statement Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Avg TVPI"
      display_name: "Avg TVPI"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tvpi AS DOUBLE))

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Avg DPI"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`privateequity_distribution`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "LP distribution layer: amounts, withholding tax, recallable flags and realization ratios with time-intelligence. Drives realization monitoring, tax planning and LP reporting."
  source: "`asset_management`.`privateequity`.`distribution`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Distribution Type"
      display_name: "Distribution Type"
      expr: distribution_type
      comment: "Type of distribution (return of capital, gain, income)."
    - name: "Distribution Status"
      display_name: "Distribution Status"
      expr: distribution_status
      comment: "Processing status of the distribution."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency
      comment: "Distribution currency."
    - name: "Recallable Flag"
      display_name: "Recallable"
      expr: recallable_flag
      comment: "Whether the distribution is recallable."
    - name: "Vintage Year"
      display_name: "Vintage Year"
      expr: vintage_year
      comment: "Vintage year cohort of the distribution source."
    - name: "Payment Month"
      display_name: "Payment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment date bucketed to month for realization trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Payment Year"
      display_name: "Payment Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment date bucketed to year for annual realization reporting."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Distribution Amount"
      display_name: "Total Distribution Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross distribution amount — realized cash to LPs."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Net Distribution Amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Distribution"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_distribution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net distribution after deductions — actual cash received by LPs."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Withholding Tax"
      display_name: "Total Withholding Tax"
      expr: SUM(CAST(withholding_tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Withholding tax deducted — tax leakage monitoring and treaty optimization."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Distribution Amount CM"
      display_name: "Distribution (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_distribution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net distribution for the current month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Payment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Distribution Amount PM"
      display_name: "Distribution (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_distribution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net distribution for the prior month bucket (one month offset)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Payment Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Distribution MoM"
      display_name: "Distribution MoM"
      expr: (AGG(`Distribution Amount CM`) - AGG(`Distribution Amount PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Distribution Amount PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in net distributions — realization momentum."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Distribution Count"
      display_name: "Distribution Count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT distribution_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct distribution events — operational throughput."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: LP distribution layer: amounts, withholding tax, recallable flags and realization ratios with time-intelligence. Drives realization monitoring, tax planning and LP reporting.

  source: "`asset_management`.`privateequity`.`privateequity_cash_flow`"

  dimensions:

      display_name: "Cash Flow Type"
      expr: cash_flow_type
      comment: "Type of cash flow (capital call, distribution, fee, etc.)."
    - name: "Cash Flow Status"
      display_name: "Cash Flow Status"
      expr: cash_flow_status
      comment: "Processing status of the cash flow event."
    - name: "Currency"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency
      comment: "Transaction currency."
    - name: "Recallable Flag"
      display_name: "Recallable"
      expr: recallable_flag
      comment: "Whether the distribution is recallable — affects true liquidity available."
    - name: "Effective Month"
      display_name: "Effective Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_date)
      comment: "Effective date bucketed to month for cash-flow trending."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Effective Year"
      display_name: "Effective Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', effective_date)
      comment: "Effective date bucketed to year for annual pacing."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Net Amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net cash-flow amount across events — core liquidity flow metric."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Gross Amount"
      display_name: "Total Gross Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross cash-flow amount before deductions."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Investment Amount"
      display_name: "Total Investment Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(investment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Capital deployed into investments via these flows — deployment pacing."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Management Fees"
      display_name: "Total Management Fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(management_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Management fees paid — fee drag monitoring on net returns."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Carried Interest"
      display_name: "Total Carried Interest"
      expr: SUM(CAST(carried_interest_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Carried interest paid to GP via cash flows — cost-of-performance monitoring."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Preferred Return"
      display_name: "Total Preferred Return"
      expr: SUM(CAST(preferred_return_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Preferred return (hurdle) amounts in flows — waterfall tracking."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Recallable Amount"
      display_name: "Total Recallable Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recallable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Recallable distribution amount — contingent liquidity exposure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Net Amount CM"
      display_name: "Net Amount (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net cash flow for the current month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Effective Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Net Amount PM"
      display_name: "Net Amount (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net cash flow for the prior month bucket (one month offset)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Effective Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Net Amount MoM"
      display_name: "Net Amount MoM"
      expr: (AGG(`Net Amount CM`) - AGG(`Net Amount PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Net Amount PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth in net cash flow — pacing trend signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Cash Flow Event Count"
      display_name: "Event Count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT privateequity_cash_flow_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct cash-flow events — operational throughput."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: PE cash-flow movement layer: capital calls, distributions, fees, carry and preferred return flows with time-intelligence. Drives liquidity management, pacing and net-return analysis.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`realestate_noi_record`

AS $$

  source: "`asset_management`.`realestate`.`noi_record`"
  dimensions:

      display_name: "Reporting Month"

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Reporting Period Year"
      display_name: "Reporting Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', reporting_period_end_date)
      comment: "Year of the NOI reporting period."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "NOI Status"
      display_name: "NOI Status"
      expr: noi_status
      comment: "Status of the NOI record (e.g. draft, approved)."
    - name: "Reporting Frequency"
      display_name: "Reporting Frequency"
      expr: reporting_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of the NOI reporting cycle."
    - name: "Calculation Method"
      display_name: "Calculation Method"
      expr: calculation_method
      comment: "Method used to calculate NOI (accrual, cash)."
  measures:
    - name: "NOI Record Count"
      display_name: "NOI Record Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of NOI records in scope."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Effective Gross Income"
      display_name: "Total EGI"
      expr: SUM(CAST(effective_gross_income AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate effective gross income — top-line revenue for operating assets."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Operating Expenses"
      display_name: "Total OpEx"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_operating_expenses AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate operating expenses — cost base for operating efficiency."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total NOI"
      display_name: "Total NOI"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_operating_income AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate net operating income — core operating profitability metric."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "NOI Margin Pct"
      display_name: "NOI Margin %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(net_operating_income AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(effective_gross_income AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "NOI / EGI — operating margin reflecting cost efficiency of the asset base."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Expense Ratio Pct"
      display_name: "Expense Ratio %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(total_operating_expenses AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(effective_gross_income AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "OpEx / EGI — operating expense ratio flagging cost control issues."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Vacancy Loss"
      display_name: "Total Vacancy Loss"
      expr: SUM(CAST(vacancy_loss AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate vacancy loss — income leakage from unoccupied space."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Occupancy Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Occupancy %"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(occupancy_rate_percent AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average occupancy across NOI records — leasing performance signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total NOI CM"
      display_name: "NOI (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_operating_income AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Current-month NOI for time-intelligence trending."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Reporting Period Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total NOI PM"
      display_name: "NOI (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_operating_income AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month NOI for MoM comparison."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Reporting Period Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "NOI MoM Growth Pct"
      display_name: "NOI MoM %"
      expr: (AGG(`Total NOI CM`) - AGG(`Total NOI PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total NOI PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month NOI growth — momentum in operating income."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Net operating income performance: income, expenses, NOI margin and occupancy from periodic NOI records. Drives asset operating performance review.

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Regulatory Breach Count"
      display_name: "Regulatory Breach Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_breach_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of breaches flagged as regulatory; drives mandatory reporting and remediation."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Intraday Breach Count"
      display_name: "Intraday Breach Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN intraday_breach_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Breaches detected intraday; indicator of real-time control effectiveness."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Breach Percentage"
      display_name: "Avg Breach Percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(breach_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average percentage by which limits were exceeded; sizing of control failures."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Breach Magnitude"
      display_name: "Total Breach Magnitude"
      expr: SUM(CAST(breach_magnitude AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate magnitude of limit excesses; exposure impact of breaches."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Breach Duration Minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Breach Duration Minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(breach_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average time a breach remained open; remediation responsiveness KPI."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "IC Review Required Count"
      display_name: "IC Review Required Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN ic_review_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Breaches requiring Investment Committee review; governance workload indicator."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Breach Count CM"
      display_name: "Breach Count CM"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Current-month breach count for trend analysis."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Breach Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Breach Count PM"
      display_name: "Breach Count PM"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Prior-month breach count for trend analysis."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Breach Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month

      display_name: "Breach Count MoM"
      expr: (AGG(`Breach Count CM`) - AGG(`Breach Count PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Breach Count PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month change in breach frequency; control-trend steering KPI."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Limit breach KPIs for risk governance — frequency, severity, regulatory breaches and remediation timeliness. Single-source over risk.limit_breach.

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Calculation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total VaR PM"
      display_name: "Total VaR PM"
      expr: SUM(CAST(var_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior-month VaR for month-over-month trend."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Calculation Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "VaR MoM"
      display_name: "VaR MoM"
      expr: (AGG(`Total VaR CM`) - AGG(`Total VaR PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total VaR PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month change in VaR; escalation trigger when rising sharply."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Value-at-Risk and CVaR KPIs used by the CRO and Investment Committee to monitor portfolio tail risk, diversification benefit, and regulatory capital. Single-source over risk.var_calculation.

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      display_name: "Total gross amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross transacted amount before fees."

        type: currency

        decimal_places:

    - name: "Net Cash Flow CM"
      display_name: "Net cash flow cm"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_currency_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net cash flow in the current month bucket."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Event Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Net Cash Flow PM"

      comment: "Net cash flow in the prior month bucket."

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:

      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

      expr: SUM(CAST(nav AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total NAV across valued assets. Headline measure of managed portfolio value."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Gross Asset Value"
      display_name: "Total GAV"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gav AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross asset value before liabilities, used to analyse leverage against NAV."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Fair Value"
      display_name: "Total Fair Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fair value (mark-to-market) across valued assets."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Book Value"
      display_name: "Total Book Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(book_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total carrying/book value across valued assets, baseline for fair-value variance analysis."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fair Value to Book Value Ratio"
      display_name: "Fair Value / Book Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(book_value AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Ratio of fair value to book value. Signals unrealised gains (>1) or impairment risk (<1) across the book."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Average Fair Value per Asset"
      display_name: "Avg Fair Value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fair value per valuation record, used to spot outsized single-asset exposures."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total NAV CM"
      display_name: "Total NAV (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nav AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total NAV for the current month bucket (time-intelligence base)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: valuation_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total NAV PM"
      display_name: "Total NAV (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nav AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total NAV for the prior month bucket (time-intelligence base)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: valuation_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "NAV MoM Growth"
      display_name: "NAV MoM Growth"
      expr: (AGG(`Total NAV CM`) - AGG(`Total NAV PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total NAV PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month percent change in total NAV. Key steering signal for portfolio value movement."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Core semantic layer over asset-level valuations. Supports NAV, GAV, fair value and book-value analytics across asset class, portfolio, currency and valuation cycle. Primary steering layer for portfolio valuation quality, mark-to-market exposure and fair-value vs book-value variance.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`valuation_nav_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Fund-level NAV reporting layer. Supports GIPS/IFRS/Beneficiary reporting with total NAV, NAV per unit, gross asset value and liabilities by fund and valuation cycle. Steering layer for official fund valuations."
  source: "`asset_management`.`valuation`.`valuation_nav_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "fund_name"
      display_name: "Fund Name"
      expr: fund_name
      comment: "Name of the fund the NAV record applies to."
    - name: "currency_code"
      display_name: "Currency"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Reporting currency of the NAV record."
    - name: "valuation_status"
      display_name: "Valuation Status"
      expr: valuation_status
      comment: "Status of the NAV calculation (e.g. draft, final, published)."
    - name: "valuation_cycle_frequency"
      display_name: "Cycle Frequency"
      expr: valuation_cycle_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of the NAV valuation cycle."
    - name: "valuation_month"
      display_name: "Valuation Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', valuation_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the NAV valuation date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "valuation_quarter"
      display_name: "Valuation Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', valuation_date)
      comment: "Quarter bucket of the NAV valuation date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "NAV Record Count"
      display_name: "NAV Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of fund NAV records produced. Reporting completeness baseline."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Net Asset Value"
      display_name: "Total NAV"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_asset_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fund net asset value across records. Headline AUM-style measure."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Gross Asset Value"
      display_name: "Total GAV"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_gross_asset_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross asset value across fund NAV records."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Liabilities"
      display_name: "Total Liabilities"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_liabilities AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total liabilities deducted in the NAV calculation."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Average NAV per Unit"
      display_name: "Avg NAV per Unit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(nav_per_unit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average NAV per fund unit, tracked for per-unit value movements driving beneficiary statements."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Liability to GAV Ratio"
      display_name: "Liability / GAV"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_liabilities AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_gross_asset_value AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Liabilities as a share of gross asset value. Leverage/gearing indicator for fund valuations."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total NAV CM"
      display_name: "Total NAV (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_asset_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fund NAV for current month bucket (time-intelligence base)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: valuation_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total NAV PM"
      display_name: "Total NAV (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_asset_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fund NAV for prior month bucket (time-intelligence base)."
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: valuation_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Fund NAV MoM Growth"
      display_name: "Fund NAV MoM Growth"
      expr: (AGG(`Total NAV CM`) - AGG(`Total NAV PM`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Total NAV PM`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month change in total fund NAV. Core fund performance steering signal."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Fund-level NAV reporting layer. Supports GIPS/IFRS/Beneficiary reporting with total NAV, NAV per unit, gross asset value and liabilities by fund and valuation cycle. Steering layer for official fund valuations.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`valuation_review`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Valuation governance and review-cycle layer. Steers approval throughput, review coverage and control effectiveness over the valuation process. Supports SOX internal-controls attestation."
  source: "`asset_management`.`valuation`.`valuation_review`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "review_type"
      display_name: "Review Type"
      expr: review_type
      comment: "Type of valuation review performed."
    - name: "review_status"
      display_name: "Review Status"
      expr: review_status
      comment: "Status of the review (e.g. in-progress, completed)."
    - name: "approval_status"
      display_name: "Approval Status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval outcome of the review (e.g. approved, rejected, pending)."
    - name: "outcome"
      display_name: "Outcome"
      expr: outcome
      comment: "Resulting outcome of the valuation review."
    - name: "review_month"
      display_name: "Review Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the review date."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Review Count"
      display_name: "Reviews"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of valuation reviews performed. Control-activity baseline."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approved Review Count"
      display_name: "Approved Reviews"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of reviews that reached approval."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Rejected Review Count"
      display_name: "Rejected Reviews"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of reviews rejected, signalling valuation quality or control issues."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Share of reviews approved. Key valuation-governance throughput and quality KPI."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Distinct Valuations Reviewed"
      display_name: "Valuations Reviewed"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT valuation_asset_valuation_id)
      comment: "Count of unique asset valuations subject to review, measuring review coverage."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Valuation governance and review-cycle layer. Steers approval throughput, review coverage and control effectiveness over the valuation process. Supports SOX internal-controls attestation.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`equity_earnings_announcement`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Semantic KPI layer over earnings announcements for listed securities. Tracks EPS surprise, consensus accuracy, and earnings cadence to support fundamental equity research, portfolio positioning decisions, and earnings season monitoring for the pension fund's public equity book."
  source: "`asset_management`.`equity`.`earnings_announcement`"
  parameters:
    - name: p_eps_basis_filter
      data_type: STRING
      default: "'gaap'"
    - name: p_surprise_threshold_pct
      data_type: DOUBLE
      default: 5.0
  dimensions:
    - name: "EPS Basis"
      display_name: "EPS Basis"
      expr: eps_basis
      comment: "Accounting basis for EPS figures — GAAP or adjusted. Allows analysts to compare like-for-like earnings across securities."
    - name: "Fiscal Year"
      display_name: "Fiscal Year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year of the earnings announcement. Used to group and trend annual earnings performance."
    - name: "Fiscal Quarter"
      display_name: "Fiscal Quarter"
      expr: fiscal_quarter
      comment: "Fiscal quarter (1–4) of the earnings announcement. Enables quarterly earnings cadence analysis."
    - name: "Announcement Date"
      display_name: "Announcement Date"
      expr: announcement_date
      comment: "Exact date the earnings were publicly announced. Used for event-driven analysis and earnings calendar tracking."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Announcement Month"
      display_name: "Announcement Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', announcement_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the announcement date. Supports monthly aggregation of earnings events and surprise trends."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Announcement Quarter"
      display_name: "Announcement Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', announcement_date)
      comment: "Quarter bucket of the announcement date. Supports quarterly earnings season analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Announcement Year"
      display_name: "Announcement Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', announcement_date)
      comment: "Year bucket of the announcement date. Supports annual earnings trend analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "EPS Beat Flag"
      display_name: "EPS Beat / Miss"
      expr: CASE WHEN actual_eps > consensus_eps THEN 'Beat' WHEN actual_eps < consensus_eps THEN 'Miss' ELSE 'In-Line' END
      comment: "Categorical label indicating whether the company beat, missed, or met consensus EPS expectations. Core dimension for earnings quality segmentation."
    - name: "Significant Surprise Flag"
      display_name: "Significant Surprise (>Threshold%)"
      expr: CASE WHEN ABS(100.0 * (actual_eps - consensus_eps) / NULLIF(ABS(consensus_eps), 0)) >= p_surprise_threshold_pct THEN 'Significant' ELSE 'Normal' END
      comment: "Flags announcements where the EPS surprise magnitude exceeds the analyst-defined threshold parameter (default 5%). Useful for screening high-conviction earnings events."
  measures:
    - name: "Total Announcements"
      display_name: "Total Earnings Announcements"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of earnings announcements in the selected period and filters. Baseline volume metric for earnings calendar coverage."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Distinct Securities Reporting"
      display_name: "Distinct Securities Reporting"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT listed_security_id)
      comment: "Number of unique listed securities with at least one earnings announcement. Measures breadth of earnings coverage in the portfolio universe."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Avg Actual EPS"
      display_name: "Average Actual EPS"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual earnings per share across all announcements in scope. Tracks the central tendency of realized earnings for the covered universe."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Avg Consensus EPS"
      display_name: "Average Consensus EPS"
      expr: AVG(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average consensus (analyst estimate) EPS across all announcements in scope. Benchmarks analyst expectations against realized outcomes."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Total Actual EPS"
      display_name: "Total Actual EPS (Sum)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of actual EPS across all announcements. Used as the numerator in portfolio-level EPS aggregation and YoY growth calculations."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Total Consensus EPS"
      display_name: "Total Consensus EPS (Sum)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of consensus EPS across all announcements. Used as the denominator baseline for aggregate surprise calculations."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Avg EPS Surprise Pct"
      display_name: "Average EPS Surprise %"
      expr: AVG(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0))
      comment: "Average percentage by which actual EPS exceeded or missed consensus estimates. Positive values indicate beats; negative values indicate misses. Core metric for assessing analyst forecast accuracy and earnings quality across the equity universe."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Absolute EPS Surprise Pct"
      display_name: "Average Absolute EPS Surprise %"
      expr: AVG(ABS(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0)))
      comment: "Average magnitude of EPS surprise regardless of direction. Measures overall forecast dispersion and analyst uncertainty. High values signal volatile or hard-to-predict earnings."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "EPS Beat Count"
      display_name: "EPS Beat Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_eps > consensus_eps THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of announcements where actual EPS exceeded consensus. Used to compute beat rate and assess systematic analyst conservatism or optimism."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "EPS Miss Count"
      display_name: "EPS Miss Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_eps < consensus_eps THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of announcements where actual EPS fell short of consensus. Tracks downside earnings risk and analyst over-optimism."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "EPS Beat Rate"
      display_name: "EPS Beat Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_eps > consensus_eps THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of earnings announcements where actual EPS beat consensus. A key signal of portfolio quality and analyst forecast bias. Executives use this to assess the earnings reliability of held positions."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Max EPS Surprise Pct"
      display_name: "Max EPS Surprise %"
      expr: MAX(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0))
      comment: "Largest positive EPS surprise in the selected universe and period. Identifies the most significant upside earnings event — relevant for post-earnings attribution and position sizing review."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Min EPS Surprise Pct"
      display_name: "Min EPS Surprise % (Worst Miss)"
      expr: MIN(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0))
      comment: "Largest negative EPS surprise (worst miss) in the selected universe and period. Flags the most severe downside earnings shock — critical for risk review and stop-loss evaluation."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Announcements This Month"
      display_name: "Announcements (Current Month)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of earnings announcements in the current calendar month. Supports real-time earnings season monitoring."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
      window:
        - order: Announcement Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Announcements Prior Month"
      display_name: "Announcements (Prior Month)"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of earnings announcements in the prior calendar month. Used as the baseline for MoM earnings volume comparison."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
      window:
        - order: Announcement Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Announcements MoM Growth"
      display_name: "Announcements MoM Growth %"
      expr: (AGG(`Announcements This Month`) - AGG(`Announcements Prior Month`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`Announcements Prior Month`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month percentage change in earnings announcement volume. Tracks earnings season acceleration or deceleration."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg EPS Surprise Pct This Quarter"
      display_name: "Avg EPS Surprise % (Current Quarter)"
      expr: AVG(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0))
      comment: "Average EPS surprise percentage for the current earnings quarter. Provides a real-time read on how the current earnings season is tracking versus analyst expectations."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Announcement Quarter
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Avg EPS Surprise Pct Prior Quarter"
      display_name: "Avg EPS Surprise % (Prior Quarter)"
      expr: AVG(100.0 * (CAST(actual_eps AS DOUBLE) - CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(ABS(CAST(consensus_eps AS DOUBLE)), 0))
      comment: "Average EPS surprise percentage for the prior earnings quarter. Baseline for QoQ earnings quality comparison."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Announcement Quarter
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -3 months
    - name: "EPS Surprise QoQ Change"
      display_name: "EPS Surprise QoQ Change (pp)"
      expr: AGG(`Avg EPS Surprise Pct This Quarter`) - AGG(`Avg EPS Surprise Pct Prior Quarter`)
      comment: "Quarter-over-quarter change in average EPS surprise percentage (in percentage points). Signals whether earnings quality is improving or deteriorating across the covered universe."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Beat Rate This Year"
      display_name: "EPS Beat Rate % (Current Year)"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_eps > consensus_eps THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "EPS beat rate for the current calendar year. Tracks the annual earnings quality trend for the covered equity universe."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Announcement Year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Beat Rate Prior Year"
      display_name: "EPS Beat Rate % (Prior Year)"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_eps > consensus_eps THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "EPS beat rate for the prior calendar year. Baseline for YoY earnings quality comparison."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: Announcement Year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 year
    - name: "Beat Rate YoY Change"
      display_name: "EPS Beat Rate YoY Change (pp)"
      expr: AGG(`Beat Rate This Year`) - AGG(`Beat Rate Prior Year`)
      comment: "Year-over-year change in EPS beat rate (in percentage points). A key strategic signal: sustained improvement indicates rising earnings quality; deterioration may prompt portfolio review."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Announcements YTD"
      display_name: "Announcements Year-to-Date"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Cumulative count of earnings announcements from the start of the current year to the current date. Tracks earnings season progress against the full-year calendar."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
      window:
        - order: Announcement Date
          range: cumulative
          semiadditive: last
        - order: Announcement Year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Securities Reporting in Segment"
      display_name: "Securities Reporting per EPS Basis"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT listed_security_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct securities reporting within each EPS basis segment (GAAP vs adjusted). Supports cross-basis coverage analysis and ensures the pension fund's equity universe is consistently tracked under both reporting standards."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
      partition:
        include: [EPS Basis]
        outer_aggregate: sum
$$
metric_views.description: Semantic KPI layer over earnings announcements for listed securities. Tracks EPS surprise, consensus accuracy, and earnings cadence to support fundamental equity research, portfolio positioning decisions, and earnings season monitoring for the pension fund's public equity book.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `asset_management`.`_metrics`.`performance_active_return_attribution`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Semantic KPI layer over Barra-style active return attribution records. Decomposes active return into factor, sector allocation, and security selection components — the primary tool for the investment team to understand the sources of alpha and risk-adjusted outperformance at the portfolio, sector, and factor level."
  source: "`asset_management`.`performance`.`active_return_attribution`"
  parameters:
    - name: p_min_factor_return_bps
      data_type: DOUBLE
      default: -10000.0
  dimensions:
    - name: "Portfolio"
      display_name: "Portfolio ID"
      expr: portfolio_id
      comment: "Foreign key to the portfolio entity; primary slicer for attribution analysis by portfolio."
    - name: "Factor"
      display_name: "Factor ID"
      expr: factor_id
      comment: "Foreign key to the risk factor entity; used to slice attribution by systematic risk factor (e.g. value, momentum, quality)."
    - name: "AttributionModel"
      display_name: "Attribution Model ID"
      expr: attribution_model_id
      comment: "Foreign key to the attribution model; allows comparison of results across different Barra model versions or custom factor models."
    - name: "SectorName"
      display_name: "Sector"
      expr: sector_name
      comment: "GICS sector name; used to decompose attribution by sector for sector rotation and allocation analysis."
    - name: "PeriodEndDate"
      display_name: "Period End Date"
      expr: period_end_date
      comment: "Exact period end date of the attribution record; used for point-in-time filtering."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "PeriodEndMonth"
      display_name: "Period End Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', period_end_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of the attribution period end date; primary time-intelligence dimension for MoM attribution analysis."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "PeriodEndQuarter"
      display_name: "Period End Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', period_end_date)
      comment: "Quarter bucket of the attribution period end date; used for quarterly investment committee attribution reviews."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "PeriodEndYear"
      display_name: "Period End Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', period_end_date)
      comment: "Year bucket of the attribution period end date; used for annual board-level attribution reporting."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "PeriodStartDate"
      display_name: "Period Start Date"
      expr: period_start_date
      comment: "Start date of the attribution period; used alongside period end date to define the measurement window."
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "TotalFactorReturnBps"
      display_name: "Total Factor Return (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total factor return contribution in basis points across selected portfolios, factors, and periods. Quantifies how much of active return is explained by systematic factor exposures (e.g. value tilt, momentum)."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "TotalSectorAllocationReturnBps"
      display_name: "Total Sector Allocation Return (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total sector allocation return contribution in basis points. Measures the value added (or destroyed) by overweighting or underweighting sectors relative to the benchmark."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "TotalSecuritySelectionReturnBps"
      display_name: "Total Security Selection Return (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total security selection return contribution in basis points. Measures the value added by picking individual securities within each sector; the purest measure of fundamental research quality."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "AvgFactorReturnBps"
      display_name: "Avg Factor Return (bps)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average factor return contribution per attribution record. Used to compare factor effectiveness across different portfolios and time periods on a normalized basis."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "AvgSectorAllocationReturnBps"
      display_name: "Avg Sector Allocation Return (bps)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average sector allocation return per attribution record. Normalized view of sector allocation skill across portfolios and periods."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "AvgSecuritySelectionReturnBps"
      display_name: "Avg Security Selection Return (bps)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average security selection return per attribution record. Normalized measure of stock-picking skill; used to evaluate individual portfolio managers."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "TotalActiveReturnBps"
      display_name: "Total Active Return (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total active return (sum of all three attribution components) in basis points. The headline active return figure used in board and client reporting."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SecuritySelectionShareOfActiveReturn"
      display_name: "Security Selection Share of Active Return (%)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE)), 0) * 100
      comment: "Proportion of total active return attributable to security selection. High values indicate the portfolio is driven by fundamental stock-picking rather than factor or sector bets; used to validate active management mandate."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "FactorReturnShareOfActiveReturn"
      display_name: "Factor Return Share of Active Return (%)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE)), 0) * 100
      comment: "Proportion of total active return attributable to systematic factor exposures. High values may indicate the portfolio is taking unintended factor bets; triggers factor exposure review."
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "AttributionRecordCount"
      display_name: "Attribution Record Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of attribution records in the selection. Used to validate attribution model coverage and data completeness."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "DistinctPortfolioCount"
      display_name: "Distinct Portfolio Count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct portfolios with attribution data in the selection. Used to assess attribution model coverage breadth."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "DistinctFactorCount"
      display_name: "Distinct Factor Count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT factor_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct risk factors contributing to attribution in the selection. Indicates the dimensionality of the factor model being applied."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "TotalFactorReturnBpsCM"
      display_name: "Total Factor Return Current Month (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total factor return in basis points for the current month. Base measure for MoM factor attribution time-intelligence."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: PeriodEndMonth
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "TotalFactorReturnBpsPM"
      display_name: "Total Factor Return Prior Month (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total factor return in basis points for the prior month. Used to compute MoM factor attribution change."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: PeriodEndMonth
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "FactorReturnMoMChange"
      display_name: "Factor Return MoM Change (bps)"
      expr: AGG(`TotalFactorReturnBpsCM`) - AGG(`TotalFactorReturnBpsPM`)
      comment: "Month-over-month change in total factor return contribution in basis points. Tracks whether factor exposures are becoming more or less beneficial; triggers factor model review when materially negative."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "TotalSecuritySelectionReturnBpsCQ"
      display_name: "Total Security Selection Return Current Quarter (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total security selection return in basis points for the current quarter. Base measure for QoQ stock-picking performance time-intelligence."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: PeriodEndQuarter
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "TotalSecuritySelectionReturnBpsPQ"
      display_name: "Total Security Selection Return Prior Quarter (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total security selection return in basis points for the prior quarter. Used to compute QoQ stock-picking performance change."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: PeriodEndQuarter
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -3 months
    - name: "SecuritySelectionQoQChange"
      display_name: "Security Selection QoQ Change (bps)"
      expr: AGG(`TotalSecuritySelectionReturnBpsCQ`) - AGG(`TotalSecuritySelectionReturnBpsPQ`)
      comment: "Quarter-over-quarter change in security selection return in basis points. Primary metric for quarterly investment committee review of fundamental research quality."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "TotalActiveReturnYTD"
      display_name: "Total Active Return YTD (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(factor_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Year-to-date cumulative active return in basis points. Tracks progress toward annual alpha targets; used in monthly investment committee reporting."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: PeriodEndDate
          range: cumulative
          semiadditive: last
        - order: PeriodEndYear
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "TotalSecuritySelectionBpsBySector"
      display_name: "Total Security Selection Return by Sector (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(security_selection_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total security selection return partitioned by sector. Enables the CIO to identify which sectors are driving or detracting from stock-picking alpha simultaneously across all sectors."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      partition:
        include: [SectorName]
        outer_aggregate: sum
    - name: "TotalSectorAllocationBpsBySector"
      display_name: "Total Sector Allocation Return by Sector (bps)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(sector_allocation_return_bps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total sector allocation return partitioned by sector. Identifies which sector overweight/underweight decisions are adding or destroying value; drives tactical asset allocation decisions."
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      partition:
        include: [SectorName]
        outer_aggregate: sum
$$
metric_views.description: Semantic KPI layer over Barra-style active return attribution records. Decomposes active return into factor, sector allocation, and security selection components — the primary tool for the investment team to understand the sources of alpha and risk-adjusted outperformance at the portfolio, sector, and factor level.
